review_title: Small, fun to fly, easy to use.
review_text: Very fun either indoors or outdoors. Can't stop playing with this little quad. Been flying it non stop here because the weather outside has been too windy to fly. I did get to fly it outside the first day getting it and it performed great. This isn't a drone to fly in any wind whatsoever. It will handle a very small breeze, but any significant wind will make it a chore to fly. It is very lightweight and can get pushed around easily in wind over 1 or 2 miles per hour. It does have decent range for a smaller quad. Wi-Fi fpv gets ok range, about as average as Wi-Fi fpv gets. Don't expect long range with it. Flying inside the house is another story. Using the Wi-Fi fpv inside is awesome. Flying and avoiding and dodging everything is so much fun. This little thing can take some light abuse. I flew it into many things while using the Wi-Fi fpv before actually getting used to using it. Still rather new to fpv flying. Used to flying by line of sight. Other than a few minor crashes into the fridge and a couple walls it's been a blast to be able to fly indoors when the weather isn't great. Not too big to fly indoors at all. Roughly the size of a dinner plate. The controls are pretty easy to learn and pretty basic. The same as most quads out there now. Two speeds, flips, auto takeoff/landing. Now the app is a different story. Controlling using that is odd because it's foreign to me, but I'm learning it. It's a little more sensitive and touchy to fly with it. I'm used to using transmitters so it's been a learning experience to say the least, but it's been fun learning a new way to fly. Is has two batteries, extra props, prop guards, camera, phone holder and screwdriver with it. Does not come with a micro sd card for the camera, but you can record video to the app or take pictures. They will only be in 480p and not 720p. To record in 720p, you will need to have a micro sd card inserted into the camera.

review_title: First real drone, pleasantly surprised with the features and controls
review_text: This is my first "real" drone, the rest have been $30 toys that flew ok but weren't something I came back to very much. That being said, it is still under $100 so I did not expect it to live up to the pricey Phantom drones that cost a grand. That being said, this is an excellent introductory drone that is worth the price. The key features included are the camera and stunts. There is a surprising amount of flexibility for control...either use the remote, smartphone, or combination of both (one for video and the other for control). It took a while to figure out how to use both at the same time but I was glad to get it working. The stunts are something I've never used before and boy are they fun. Press a button and the drone launches 10 feet in the direction you choose, very quickly too which was surprising. DO NOT DO THIS INSIDE! I got cocky once and it slammed into the ceiling. A propeller guide fell off but I snapped it back on and everything works fine still. Other features are nice like "headless mode" (no turning left/right, just control with one joystick) and multidirectional trim to adjust the drift. You will need to adjust trim often, so be sure to memorize these settings. My kit came with two batteries, which is nice because each one only lasts about 10 minutes. Not sure what batteries typically last but 20 minutes of flying time is plenty for me. Times will probably vary depending on settings (e.g. camera and speed). I usually keep the speed on "low" but the fast mode is fun to play with. Much faster than I expected a drone at this level could get, but I'm not used to the controls enough to sustain this speed without crashing into a tree. To summarize, this drone has a lot of advanced features and is very affordable. Mine has suffered a few crashes but still works fine. The box comes with spare parts, so the propellers would be easy to replace if they break. The drone is light and will offer about 20 minutes of flying time with two batteries. Controlling it is still difficult for me, but that's because drones add another dimension compared to RC cars. The only negative I can think of is the instructions are not always clear, but if you play around with it like I did you should figure everything out after a few goes. Also, there is not a "killswitch" on the remote to shut the drone down (it takes a few seconds to power down the propellers). Bad if you're losing control, but once you learn the movements better it shouldn't be an issue if you're flying safely. The smartphone app DOES have a killswitch button, so there's alway the option there. If you want a professional drone that will last 20 years, has modular parts, and can perform in tournaments...spend $1000 and get a Phantom. If you want a fun toy/hobby that can take videos and has a lot of features to play around with you would do well to buy this Syma!

review_title: Beware of 5 star reviews that make this product better than it is.
review_text: I have to say I had decently high hopes for this drone after reading the reviews on it. I decided to pull the trigger on it on Prime Day and I am feeling a great sense of buyers remorse after it failed to live up to my, already low, expectations. First, the instructions were usable, but no help whatsoever. In order to start flying, you should assemble the quadracopter's blade guards. For testing purposes, I did this, but I have to say, they fall out much easier than they do going in. In fact, one of the blade guards came loose on a test flight and became jammed up in the rotor causing it to crash (more on that later). Second, the camera did not work at all. I read every instruction, pressed every conceivable button on the controller associated with the camera, connected it to wifi on my phone, nothing. To add insult to injury, the app is a joke. The instructions default to chinese, but have poorly translated instructions that simply say "connect to xyz_WIFI" and press this button to connect to camera. I connected to the camera wifi but could not get any action out of it. Not only was the app useless on getting any feedback from the camera, it wouldn't even connect to the drone to control it. Useless gimmick only made to try to make it look like a premium item. Third, the drone would not calibrate it's leveling pattern. It took me about 20 minutes (which is the combined flight time on both batteries) and I managed to get it to calibrate once, until the guard became jammed in the rotor and caused it to plummet nearly 10 feet to the ground which promptly caused the battery to come out. Ironic considering the battery is extremely difficult to remove otherwise. When I inserted the battery, I checked the blades, reinstalled the guard, and fired it up. It would not calibrate. I replaced the blades on it with the included blades thinking the fall caused blade damage, still no calibration. Last, battery life and controller is horrible. You only get 5-7 minutes of actual flight time, provided you can get it calibrated. You can squeeze another minute or two if you remove the camera (which I did because mine didn't work), but then it becomes an expensive toy. The batteries are a laughable 500mAh with no extended battery available. To add insult to the 5 minute flying time, it takes 130 minutes for them to fully charge. The controller buttons on the right shoulder did not work at all. Supposedly it's capable of one touch hover and 360 flip, buttons did nothing. Again another gimmick to make it appear to be a premium product. Overall, I had low expectations to begin with for this and the 5 star ratings that this product receives vs my experience make me very skeptical of them. Had this worked the way it, I certainly would not have given 5 stars simply due to the high cost vs. return on the battery life. 2 hours of charging for 5 minutes of play time is not a 5 star product.

When I was a kid, I designed and built my own model airplanes and rockets, so I have always been interested in flight. However, the technologies I used were positively stone age compared with a quadcopter, and the Tenergy Syma X5UW is my first experience with this type of device, so my comments are from the perspective of a complete novice. If you have never used one of these things, READ THE MANUAL. Then read it again. It's clearly written and illustrated, but my initial efforts still resulted in a lot of hard landings. Eventually, I realized that orientation is critical: when you launch, the yellow battery cap must be facing you; otherwise, the steering controls from the right stick won't work intuitively. If necessary, use the left stick to rotate the copter so that the battery cap is always visible. Alternatively, and perhaps better for the complete novice, engage "headless mode" so that the onboard flight computer always aligns the drone movements to be relative to the controller, and it does not matter which way the drone forward direction is pointing — sort of like training wheels on a bicycle. In headless mode, when you push a steering stick, the drone moves forward relative to *your* direction, not the heading of the drone. With that out of the way, I would suggest that the best way to start, just as with a real aircraft, is to practice takeoffs and landings, preferably in an open space outdoors, on a quiet day, with no trees nearby. With practice, you can get very soft touchdowns. Without practice, parts may fly, and if you are lucky, you will find them (four spare propellers are included). Fortunately, the X5UW design is very popular, and many parts kits are readily available, including propellers, guards, gears, and motors. If you have never flown one of these things before, consider including a set of spare parts with your order. Once you have mastered the basics of takeoffs and landings, orientation, pitch and yaw, it's quite easy to fly, and without any inputs hovers almost in place. Trim can be fine tuned to reduce drift. This quadcopter has FPV (First Person View) capabilities, which allow you to "see" through the camera, using an android device or heads up display. It will be a while before I get to that skill level, but I can imagine that the effect is very much like a pilot's cockpit view. Two batteries are an asset, as flying time is only ~7 minutes, which goes by very quickly. When battery power starts running low, the lights will blink — land immediately! Recharging a fully depleted battery takes about 2 hours; the head of the USB charging cable is red while charging, and goes out when fully charged.

Seeing this on sale for Prime Day I had to snag one seeing as I've never owned a drone/quadcopter before. I'm starting to wish I hadn't. For starters the little bugger is quite sturdy I will give them that. It's scuffed up a little now thanks to some crashes and the blades are a tiny bit beat up because trying to hit the throttle (Which REALLY doesn't seem to work that well. If a blade is caught that should send an alarm to the drone immediately to shut itself off, not mindlessly beat itself into the ground for a good several seconds.) to stop it doesn't work right away but it's still going strong. But that's where it more or less ends for me. Despite reading the manual over and over and repeated calibrations the drone is insistent on drifting to the left even upon takeoff. I've tried the process of "trimming" (Holding down the right joystick then pressing the left one in the opposite direction it tries to drift.) multiple times and it has had no effect. Upon close inspection when I first start it up it seems the front right propeller isn't spinning as fast as the rest of them. What's more, the propeller caps are terrible. One single bump or crash and they come right off. I already lost one in a crash thanks to this. Unfortunately due to the minor scuffs and the missing cap it's unlikely I'll be able to send it back for a replacement now. This seems like it could be a nice drone for entry-level fliers and I'm sure it is, but the one I was given has turned what should have been an enjoying experience into annoyance and frustration to where I just want to throw it away.

review_text: I followed the instructions but could not get the drone to bind with the controller. The lights flashed continuously never stopping to indicate that the binding process was completed. What could be wrong? The instruction manual was no help. I scoured the internet for others having a similar problem. Voila! I discovered that others did share my problem and realized that there is a simple solution. Some models are more finicky than others. If the controller is too close or too far from the drone it will not bind. Previously I read somewhere that if you were not close enough it would not bind- so I was right beside the drone with the controller! Ideally you should be 6-8 feet (at least that is what was recommended on the internet post and what was successful with my drone). Now, after actually getting the drone to bind, the fun can begin. I launched the drone. It went up nicely. You have to be ready in your head with how you will fly it, what direction and how to make it do that on the controller because it will ascend quickly. I was able to make it go forward, left, reverse, right and land. It does not respond to the controller immediately. There seems to be a few seconds delay so you have to account for that. It would take some real practice if you planned to land it on a dime!! When it does land and you turn off the controller the blades will continue to spin for a bit (again the delay). I did not attempt to use the camera so I can’t comment on its quality or ease of operating. (I just wanted to see how well the drone would fly and how difficult it would be to control.) There is a QR code you can scan and download the app to control the drone instead of using the controller. This would allow manual control with your thumbs instead of using the controller sticks, gravity control by turning your phone to control the drone, or by using your finger for a flight plan. Looks like more fun for those who want to try other options but not a necessity. I like that the drone is lightweight while at the same time it is very sturdy to accomodate some crash landings. It comes with an extra battery pack, USB charger, screw driver, and even extra replacement blades in case they get damaged. There is also a phone holder to attach to the controller if desired. I can see how this will give hours of enjoyment for those who are able to successfully fly it. I can also see frustration and disappointment for those who encounter operating issues. For this reason I can only give it 4 stars. I would suggest that the manufacturers give much more detailed instructions in the manual for those who need “the beginners guide for dummies” and also a card with the basics to carry in your pocket to the flying field. In addition or instead, there could be markings on the controller itself with basic operating symbols. While learning it is easy to panic and forget what to do. A symbol would be very helpful in those moments! For geeky or experienced flyers that would all be unnecessary but this model has been advertised for the beginner. Also, there needs to be more clear information and instructions in the manual about headless mode. And I was not immediately aware that there is an option to select a normal or fast flying speed. So many things to learn make this a fascinating toy to master for the right type of person. Once the basics are under control you can try flips, take pictures or shoot video. While there could be some glitches to get it all together, once you get going it is a lot of fun. Also, I need to point out that the spinning blades could hurt so I wouldn’t recommend letting a small child near while you fly it and it is very important to have a wide open space to master how to control a drone safely.

This drone is so much fun and so easy to use! The hover ability makes maneuvering the drone so quick and simple. It also gives you the ability to stay still and take some amazing photos with the 720 pixel camera. The 1 key return is great and the flashing lights are a blast. The 360 flips are so simple to do, my 8 year old can play with the drone. The app control is a great feature as well. I prefer the app control actually. Overall, this is an amazing, easy to use, fun and high quality drone.

review_title: Easy to fly and easy to manuever.
review_text: The Tenergy Syma X5UW Quadcopter Drone HD 720P Camera with Smart Phone is great for beginners and older kids who want to learn to fly a drone. The extra modular battery, built-in 720P HD camera, real-time FPV, auto hovering and being able to control the drone by using your smartphone (must download app first) are great features.

This is a GREAT mini FPV quadcopter. In this review, I will be talking about several aspects that are impressive about this mini quadcopter. First off, upon opening the package, you are greeted with a nicely packaged quadcopter. However, more importantly the quadcopter itself is quite protected which is great. FPV/Phone Functions: The FPV on this quadcopter is super simple to set up. All I had to do was turn on the quadcopter which is done by pressing a button, then simply downloading the app on my phone (android/apple phones both work) and connecting to the drone's WIFI. Then I had a had a livefeed of the drone's camera. Another thing to mention is that the FPV on this quadcopter is smooth and the colors are nice. When the quadcopter is connected to your phone, you can control the quadcopter through the phone which can actually replace the transmitter. Quite a nice feature, however, I personally like flying with the transmitter. The phone clamp that is on the transmitter is really nice and will not damage your phone in anyway. It fits any phone as the clamp opens quite a nice amount for those who have larger phones. Through the app, you can set a really cool flight plan, which you can actually draw with your finger. Then it'll simulate the way the drone will fly. It's a neat feature, and when trying it, it worked flawlessly inside. It's basically makes the quad automated. Some other cool features in the app are headless mode, which is a really good aid for those who are brand new to flying quadcopters. It means that you no longer have to rotate the drone to fly a different direction. Setting the quadcopter up: Setting the quadcopter up is super simple, all I had to do was slide the battery into the slot and press the button on the top of the quad. Then after turning on the transmitter it was ready to fly. After activating the motors, I could then slowly make the quadcopter hover. From there all that was left was to have fun. The quadcopter lasted roughly 8 minutes in the air, and then took around 90 minutes to charge the battery full. Flying: Flying on this quad is super smooth and easy. The quadcopter hovers above the ground when you add some throttle to it. A super cool feature is that if the transmitter turns off then the quadcopter will actually land by itself. I experienced this first hand when I dropped the transmitter and the off button got hit and the quadcopter automatically hovered in one place then slowly landed. I thought this was great and will definitely prevent any fly aways. Along with this, the quadcopter actually has a one button press return where pressing a specific button on the transmitter will bring back the quadcopter. This worked great, but it landed a few inches away from where it took off. Battery: Finally, one of the most important factors when it comes to flying quadcopters. The battery on this quadcopter is relatively good for all the features it has. As mentioned earlier, I got it to stay up in the air for roughly 8 minutes. It also charged in about an hour and a half on a fast charger. The battery life could be better but it's what I expected from a quadcopter so small with so many features. Overall this quadcopter is a really good entry-level quadcopter, it's very similar to more expensive quadcopters such as DJI's and others that are just as expensive however this is a much smaller and way cheaper one. This is definitely a really fun toy to play with. Feel free to ask me any questions about the quadcopter in the comments.

review_title: Easy to fly and really stable
review_text: This Drone was my 3rd attempt at owning one and like the saying goes, "3rd time is the charm"! I couldn't be happier. From right out of the box I was easily able to assemble, charge, install app, and FLY. It seems easy, but as I stated this was my 3rd time trying different Drones. The Tenergy Syma worked just as it stated, and did even better than I was expecting. Ok, aside from the excitement about finally getting to fly, let me tell you about my experience with this Drone. First off, once you do start flying the system is very stable and extremely responsive. It has some great features, it's a lot like playing a real life video game. However, I bought it with the purpose of mapping property I own in the mountains. Lots and Lots of trees, but she is still flying like a champ. The videos and photos have allowed me to plan installations as well as find some hidden treasures on the property we had never noticed before. I would highly recommend this Drone, especially if you're a beginner like I was!

As a flyer the X5UW felt really good. It feels responsive and zippy, and can even fight some winds (5-10mph). Having the altitude hold is also very helpful. Each battery really gets you about 7mins, so with both batteries you get 14 mins which is awesome. (I had some mini drones that would die after about 4-5 mins, and you had to plug in to charge and wait... So having the ability to have 2 batteries, that you can swap out, and that give you a good amount of fun flying time is fantastic) And for the beginners out there, I suggest using the remote controller with the prop guards on, and do it outdoors in a wide open space! Learn the controls slowly, TAKE YOUR TIME, this will lower or eliminate you crash count as a newbie. And as you feel more comfortable flying then you can play around with all the other functions and FPV. (Just a suggestion, but if you want your toy to last as you learn it should be taken well into consideration) The X5UW also has WiFi FPV. You download the Syma Go app and use it to connect to the drone, you then mount your phone to the controller to give you a FPV view of where you are flying. The app also allows you to record to your phone in 480p, but you can also record directly to the drone in 720p. As for the 720p quality, it is decent, albeit a little shaky, but you cant expect to much from a toy grade drone. The app also give you the option to control the drone with on screen controls, but one thing to note is that you do lose some flying range in FPV mode and/or using the on screen controls because you are using a Wifi signal. So stay in a wide open area to get the best WiFi range. On the flip side. If you dont want to use WiFi FPV, you can still record in 720p directly to the drone's micro SD slot, and using thecontroller alone will about double the range! Overall I am very happy with it so far. This Syma is a good option ff your looking for a beginner toy grade drone, with a camera, and wifi FPV with app control.

review_title: It's a bird, it's a plane, no it's crazy drone...

I turned the drone on, controller on, paired with wifi and set it on a flat wide open spot in my back yard and carefully started the rotors spinning. Then i started to move the control stick to the up position and it took off like a bat out of hell. Immediately pulled the stick down where it was supposed to stop and land. That's not how it went. As i tried to shut off the controller I watched the drone continue up and to the right. Easily clearing my garage roof and disappear toward my neighbor's house. And crash landed on his roof. review_title: cheap drone, don't rely on a camera working, not an FPV like advertised...
review_text: Pros: it was cheap, it gets off the ground Cons: it doesn't fly well, even after doing all the recommended tilt and altitude resets and calibrations. I've tried flying in my front room and it cannot hover... it constantly has issues with staying in one spot no matter what mode the drone is in. The controls are not good for beginners (slow is okay) Camera doesn't work AT ALL... it won't take pictures to the phone, even though the light is on, and it keeps saying insert sd card when I connect over wifi. I put an SD card in and used the photo picture ... it flashes like it takes something but there's no picture taken.

For the price I got this at, I would recommend it! You will have to sink some time into the controls before you try out the camera, unless you already have experience with drones. Also, the camera quality is pretty terrible, and the drones battery life is BAD. For every minute of playing with the drone, you will spend 20 minutes waiting for it to charge. For the price, I would say this is a great beginner drone. It can survive crashes and still run fine - although major crashes are likely to ruin the product... Yeah - funny story with how I came to realize that (Which it should be common sense...) Anyways, for the price this is a fun little drone to whir around with - but don't use this as a professional drone. The camera quality also knocks it off from even being something to record with, as the video it captures is blurry, jumpy, and not fun to watch. The time spent charging the batteries compared to the time spent actually flying is also pretty pathetic. Thus concludes my review - unless you would like to read my stupid story about flying this thing into its deathbed.. Because I was so eager to test this thing out, I didn't have the time to truly think about what I was doing. The drone arrived on a nice autumn day and sometime in the afternoon. I immediately charged the batteries and took it outside. I was so young and stupid back then - I didn't take the time to think about how windy it was outside... Anyways, I fire the thing up and take off. As a first time drone operator, I was preetttyyy terrible. I was just beginning to get a hang of it when I decided to test how high off the ground the drone could fly! The drone got pretty high, about 20-40 feet above my head I would wager... But then the controls stopped responding (the drone was out of range.) The drone itself automatically hovers, so it simply hovered there out of my range to use. I began to panic when suddenly a HUGE gust of wind stole the drone and pushed it far far away... I was using the camera at the time, so I helplessly watched the feed as the drone flew further and further away. Eventually it stopped, and through the broken video feed (now even THAT was far out of range) I could see my drone had come to lay in a tree out in the country. I ran inside and threw on some boots, warmer clothes, and grabbed a machete. (Where I live there are NASTY stinging needles, and this time of year they are TALL!) After 25 minutes of hacking through needles, climbing around dirt mounds, and searching for this drone, I finally stumble across what appears to be the drones last transmitted picture. After some 5 minutes of looking at the last picture, and using the landmarks within that picture to triangulate the position of the drone, I finally lay eyes on the ugly yellow color - residing in a tree some 35 feet off the ground. The drone had parked itself on top of the tallest tree around, and I had no way to get it down. At this point I checked my phone, and I had roughly 10 minutes to get back to my house to get ready for work. Panicking, I decide to use my machete to hack down some smaller, dead trees, and use the 'sticks' to throw at the drone. After some thirty throws, I finally knock the dang thing down. I run back to my house, and make it to work in time. The next morning comes, and I decide to try using the drone INSIDE, rather than outside in the wind. To my dismay, the drone seemed to have sustained damage to the back left rotor, and it would not fly properly. It would constantly drift in that direction. (I assume the rotor must've taken enough damage to not entirely kill it, but severely weaken it.) Because of this, the drone had been rendered useless, and I decided to toss it in the trash. I do not remember how much I paid for this drone, but I remember it was on sale and the price was nice enough to convince me to try it out. And for what it is worth - I think that price was WELL worth the story I am now able to tell my friends and family. Thanks for reading! Hope this helped :) Save flying.

review_title: Very Good Receiver & Transmitter with Some Limitations!
review_text: No Bluetooth receiver is perfect. Being said that I came across this beautiful combo device which claimed to function as I expected. I was thinking of setting it up as BT receiver for my home theatre stereo system which doesn’t require many features as media playback is controlled through my iPhone anyway. After using it for more than a week, I am quite satisfied with its performance and met most of my expectations. Receiver (RX) Mode: It works fine when paired with smartphone and car audio system or home stereo via AUX jack. Sound quality is very good for the price. It works as described, pairing is as simple as other Bluetooth adapters and pairs to last connected device automatically. I had no problems pairing with my iPhone and MacBook, however, for some reason I couldn’t pair it with my another Bluetooth V3.0 transmitter. Center button acts as multifunction button but it doesn’t support make/receive call, or play/pause music playback. Since it is Bluetooth v3.0, iOS notification screen doesn’t show battery percentage, however multifunction button displays how much juice is left in the device. Transmitter (TX) Mode: BT transmitter transmit audio from your TV, PC (without BT function), CD player, MP3 player and all other devices which has Aux/headphone audio output. It’s easy to pair with two wireless headphones or with home stereo via additional BT receiver. I did notice some static noise when transmitting audio from my MacBook through aux output, however, it was okay and unnoticeable with car stereo setup. I tested with my other transmitter on same setup and that was working perfectly fine. I have notified the seller about the issue. Pros: - Automatic power on/off. - Build quality and sleek design. Cons: - Static noise in transmitter mode. - No dedicated power button. - Wish multifunction button had more functions. Overall, a good Bluetooth receiver for home stereo system. For 2 in 1 Bluetooth adapter with above mentioned limitations, the price is little expensive ($27.99 as of 05/13/2016).

Super easy to setup with your Bluetooth phone, turns any device into a Bluetooth transmitter which means you can turn any device into a Bluetooth audio source and also converts any device into a Bluetooth receiver meaning you can play songs from your phone via Bluetooth to any device this is connected to it. For example, I have connected this to my car AUX input and paired up with my iPhone to play songs. Sound is crystal clear with amazing high amplification which I didn't expect. Overall sound quality is very impressive. I have plugged this with my car so when car starts, this also powers up by itself and connects to phone automatically. It works seamlessly as if your car has Bluetooth. Pros: Easy to Setup Auto Power On when aux cable plugged Inbuilt Battery Crystal Clear Sound High Amplification USB Charging Sturdy Aluminum Casing Extra Audio Cable Cons: To power off need to unplug aux cable Verdict: Highly Recommended

review_title: One of the Nicest Bluetooth RX/TX Devices
review_text: If you have (generally older) equipment that doesn't have Bluetooth, a receiver lets you stream music (such as Pandora music) wirelessly from a phone or tablet to a stereo system, while a transmitter allows you to stream music from a device, such as an older iPad, to Bluetooth headphones. The Lumsing also supports NFC (Near Field Communication), although I'm not sure I see the value of this. In the box: Wireless Bluetooth 3.0 Car Receiver Transmitter with NFC (66mm x 41mm x 9mm) 3.5mm patch cord (4" long) RCA male to 3.5mm cable, micro-USB cord (36" long Illustrated user manual The manual, is printed in a small, but still readable type size, no magnifier required, and covers everything necessary for operation. Most of the case is matte finish aluminum, with a black section at the top that identifies the RX and TX ports. Unlike many devices of this type, this one is actually pleasant to both the eye and hand. Charging is by the usual USB micro port Plugging a 3.5mm patch cord into either the RX or TX port activates the corresponding function — not switching or restart required. Pairing was straightforward with both a Remix tablet (RX/TX) mode, Android 4.4.4) and my favorite Nakamichi Bluetooth headphones. Claimed battery life is up to 11 hours TX; up to 6 hours RX (not yet tested), and most notably, the device can be used while it is charging. In receive mode, the 3.5mm patch cord provides output to another device (such as a radio); in transmit mode, it provides input from another device, such as an MP3 player, to a BT headphone or speaker. Somewhat to my surprise, when plugged in to an old iPod (without BT), the device paired transparently with my BT headphones, so for the first time I could use my old iPod without having to use a wired headset. I was unable to pair successfully using NFC (using either a 2012 or 2013 Nexus 7 tablet), but this is a feature that does not interest me, as NFC requires close proximity, which negates much of the convenience of a wireless connection, and it's possible that . Bluetooth connectivity indoors met the minimum distance requirement of ~10 meters, including intervening walls. +++Pro+++ + Bluetooth Receiver *and* Transmitter in one small device + Very easy to use: no switching required; just plug the 3.5mm patch cord into the RX or TX port, depending on need + The manual covers everything that needs to be covered for general operation, but it's so simple to use that reading the instructions really isn't necessary + Inserting/removing the 3.5mm patch cord turns the device on/off + Battery powered, can be used without an external power source, but can also be used when plugged in ---Con--- - Bluetooth 3.0 not 4.0 (more energy efficient), but supports A2DP/ apt-X, an audio codec designed for CD-quality audio transfer over Bluetooth Disclaimer : This product was provided by the manufacturer for a fair and balanced review.

What I like about this mouse (other than the $9.99 price). 1- THUMB BUTTONS and a scroll wheel! I browse the internet, read scholarly articles, and yes … I play video games. You can easily change the DPI without having to go through your computer’s mouse settings, and you can just go back and forth between settings as needed (which is nice with gaming vs word or excel. It’s a single button that cycles through 800,1200 and 2000 DPI. 3- This has a simple On/Off switch. This is pretty standard with most mice, however some of the switches or poorly designed in my opinion. This Lumsing M08 Wireless Mouse is simply on or off. The switch is easy to grip. However, I have one gaming mouse that has the off position in the middle between “on with lights” and “on without lights.” Often when I try to switch to the off position I inadvertently switch all the way to “on without lights.” My wife has another mouse that she loves, but leaves in the on position all the time because she simply cannot grip the switch to move it to off. The teeth are simply too smooth and her finger won’t grip it at all. 4- It takes two AAA batteries. May not be a bid deal to most ppl, but I like to have everything to come with rechargeable batteries, not require batteries, or require batteries I already have. I always seem to have lots of re-chargeable AAA batteries, so this was appealing to me. I cannot think of any other reasons I like it… For the price I wouldn’t expect it to be fancy looking, or have color changing lights, though this does fit my palm more comfortably that some of the $15 mice I have used in the past.

review_title: Great for selfies great for life.

This function is 100% needed because i the light does not function like a traditional flash that you would mount on a traditional camera, where the light would flash when the picture was being taken this operates more like a voice activated flashlight that utilizes the phone as a stand. This light can also be turned on using a button on the side which you use to cycle through it's 3 power settings (low, medium and High). the light is also recharged via a usb cord. Completely lightweight and the with the ability to fit almost anywhere without being noticed gives this light a serious bonus just to have on you at all times for reasons other than for use with a cell phone. anywhere that you want more lighting and this will deliver. One not so great aspect is the fact that the back of the light is in the shape of a sea shell. Which is fine, However, it's not the most masculine of all looks. If the could have just made it a 1 1/2 inch square it would be more unisex, but that's not that important. Due to the overall size the power output and the build quality(so far) I have to give this a 5-star rating. My only problem is the sea shell aspect. Seeing as that is a personal preference and one that might, infact, be a bonus for many people I won't take any points off. Well done YEYIZU. There is a ridge around the metal tray, so that items do not roll off while they a being weighed - a nice little feature. The blue backlit LCD screen is easy to read in my kitchen, and it turns off automatically after a period of time. The scale is accurate (as pictured), allows weight to be measured in a variety of methods, and I cannot find any fault or issue with it. I plan to hang on to this one! Overall, this scale will make a great addition to anyone's kitchen. And, batteries are INCLUDED - a nice bonus!

review_text: The color I bought is called "Green". It's more like a mixture of teal and gray. Really pretty. Doesn't look baby blue, it's more on the gray side with a hint of blue/green. Sophisticated color similar to that of high end designer bags on the market today. Not bright or cheap looking. I bought this for my mom for Xmas and she was really happy about the pockets. She wanted a purse with 200 pockets, so this was a good choice for her because you can't tell that it has so many pockets, which is good, because i'm guessing most people don't want their purse to look like a tactical bag. I usually purchase the higher end genuine leather bags, and I was surprised at how well this purse is made considering the price. For those of you that don't know, PU leather is not real leather. It is synthetic, made of polyurethane, but it looks and feels exactly like genuine leather. Polyurethane is widely used in the majority of accessories, belts, handbags, wallets, and jackets that you see in stores. It is more expensive and harder to find genuine leather items these days. Because of the good workmanship and quality put into this bag, it should last you just as long, if not longer, then a genuine leather handbag. PU leather is also easier to clean. My mother ruined her other lovely genuine lambskin purse because she is very careless. I replaced it for her this Xmas, and I made her agree to switch back and forth between the lambskin and this one, so she doesn't completely destroy the lambskin one by dragging it through the rain lol.

review_title: This Dark Pewter AngelKiss crossbody bag is much darker in ...
review_text: This Dark Pewter AngelKiss crossbody bag is much darker in person. Nearly black when I put with a black purse. I checked the color on 3 monitors. There is a tear in the front zippered pocket - so that there is a big hole in that pocket. It was either not stitched or the stitching came out. I wanted to add that I like these Angel Kiss bags very much. I ordered this again in Dark Gray which appears much lighter than the Dark Pewter according to the website. Now hopefully this purse will hold up with daily use.

review_title: Angelkiss Satchel Handbag is roomy, stylish and has lots of places to stash necessities!
review_text: I received the Angelkiss handbag in a timely manner and was pleasantly surprised to find it so roomy. I carry an oxygen concentrator for running errands and had been looking for a handbag large enough to keep a spare battery so that my time away from home can last up to 8 hours instead of 4 hours on the battery in use on the unit. This purse has room for my necessary grooming and makeup supplies, wallet and keys but it also allows me to take the extra battery, cannula tubing and a supply of charging cords in addition. The two handles are long enough to use as a shoulder strap and when I attach the included clip-on handle, I can use the Angelkiss as a cross body bag, making having both the concentrator and a purse less awkward when walking with a cane. Thank you for simplifying my life in a stylish way. I did have only one complaint. When I removed the purse from the plastic wrapping - one of the two front outside pockets had the zipper pull missing. it was gone up to the last link which is long enough to allow me to grip the small element left and move the slider up and down the teeth. I am wishing there was more of the pull to grip - or even that there was a replacement available.

This is the second one of these I've purchased as gifts. The first was purple and now this caramel color. It is a beautiful, sensibly priced handbag and the recipient absolutely loves them. Plenty of room, sturdy, lots of storage spaces, and easy on the shoulder. I'm paraphrasing ... I don't personally use them ... not that there's anything wrong with that (said in my best Seinfeld voice). Anyway,quality materials and the first one I purchased has been used daily since Christmas 2017. Guys, this makes a great gift. Trust me.

I ordered a black and grey bag for my Aunt and this BRIGHT GREEN bag came to her house as a birthday gift! Great birthday surprise! Not really, she is not going to wear this bag and besides that, I contacted the manufacture and they said they were going to make it right by sending the right bag and Never did. Im very disappointed in the customer service. As a business owner we always try to make a mistake a good experience (or try to) for the customer as weird as that sounds but it possible to make right!

This is a great sized purse, and very well thought out. The dual top zippers isn't anything I was actively looking for, but I've since come to appreciate. The outside pockets on either side are big enough for immediate necessities like chapstick or breath mints. My cell phone fits perfectly in the back pocket. I really like the light-colored interior On the beige purse, the interior is a kind of funny light green color, but I like it lots better than if it was dark. The beige color is fabulous for spring/summer, and the faux leather is very soft and supple. If you're a person who needs structure in a purse, be advised this purse is an unstructured, frameless soft-sided purse. I love the aesthetics of this style with the shoulder straps because it sort of folds in on itself and makes it more comfortable, in my opinion, as it rides against my body. I haven't tried the cross-body strap because the bag is a bit on the large size for wearing it that way - again, in my opinion. I like the detail on the front in this light color It isn't flashy but it has a good bit of interest to it, visually. I'm very pleased with my purchase.

Beautiful soft leather purse! I chose Kaki, but there are numerous colors to choose from. 2 large compartments that zip with one compartment having an inner zip compartment as well, & the other compartment having pockets to place items in. Nice outer zipper on one side & 2 pouches on both outside ends of purse that snap close. It has all the compartments I look for in a purse & more including a long shoulder strap if desired. Thank you Angel Kiss Leather for a purse I know will last & carry every thing I need without being cumbersome or bulky!

Cute, cute bag, I love the color! Will be using it on my trip. Angelkiss bags are better quality than some of the cheaper bags on Amazon that look the same online. I've ordered several and have returned them all. This one I'll keep. Gobs of room, I carry a lot of stuff and it all fit with one empty pocket left over! And, it doesn't look stuffed like some bags do. Love the lighter color lining, I hate dark linings that you can't see into.

I love the design of this handbag. Shoulder strap is comfortable and the perfect width and length. Nice to have front and side pockets for those extra accessories. Also has a back zippered pocket which I choose to use for easy access to my cell phone. Inside is divided into two divisions which is nice for organization of accessories. Well made inside and out. Good working zippers. Beautiful handbag. However, I must say that it is very soft and floppy. I am a gal that carries my life in my handbag..lol. It will be a good thing to fill up this handbag because if not, it’s gonna just flop. Update....January 2019: With time, this bag has annoyed me soooo much with how floppy it is. The less you have in it, the worse it is. If i only had known, I never would of had purchased it. My next bag will definitely be one which is made with a more durable material which has structure. Great design and looks though! Minus two stars for floppy annoyance

My new favorite company and best style of purses!I especially love the two main separate zipper compartments ,they can fit plenty in each side ,I carry alot of things ,always on the go ,so it came in handy I can fit almost everything ,water bottle , magazine , tablet ,it also had a bunch of inside compartments that I use for makeup ,pens ,ect.,the design is just perfect ,not over the top ,the material is really soft which is what I also look for ,it came with a really cute blue bag ,and a strap if preferred ,it's really a great quality purse ,alot of different colors and styles ,which is why it was hard to choose just one ,I will definitely be buying another ,and highly recommend!

review_title: HUGE disappointment! I based my purchase on everyone's comments
review_text: HUGE disappointment! I based my purchase on everyone's comments, BIG mistake! This is NOT a large purse. Large should not have been in the description...that's relative to what one thinks. Plus, the bag was torn at the handle, at the seam and was already unraveling. What a bummer this is going back.

review_title: A Beautiful Addition To A Purse Wardrobe!
review_text: This bag is very attractive. The only problem is there are actually too many pockets which makes it more difficult in having more than one central compartment to easily dig out keys etc. But it is a great size and you have to make yourself be organized in loading it up. I carry this one at least once to every other week depending on what I’m wearing going out. And so despite of the pockets it is one of my favorite bags and am thinking about a second in a different color

review_title: The sewing in the seam work was not complete
review_text: I really like this purse. It has the room I need and I love the way it feels, however when I received it the seaming was not intact. I am not going to send it back but I wanted to make you aware. I am in the process of finding someone who has the equipment to sew it up for me.

review_title: A real nice handbag that I plan on carrying a lot
review_text: The write-up for this handbag says it's pink. But, it's a very pretty, soft light mauve color to me. I like all the compartments. The handbag itself doesn't look that large but it should hold all my things and I carry a lot stuff. I thank Angelkiss Leather for providing this handbag and for Amazon for making it available for purchase. I think this might land up being one of my favorite handbags.

I'm so disappointed. I read the reviews for this purse and thought it was going to be perfect. Which don't get me wrong I love the purse but it took a week to get here and it was eligible for prime and I ordered a black purse and what I got was blue. So now I have to return it. I accidentally had originally ordered this purse using my debt card instead of my gift card and it was to late to cancel it so I have another one coming on Saturday that I also have to return so I don't know yet if I will be ordering another one. Also the zipper on the front pocket was stuck in the middle and wouldn't close, it would open the rest of the way but wouldn't close. So yeah pretty disappointed :( oh and it also didn't come with a strap like in the picture!

When I tore open the package and looked at my new bag, I wasn't sure if I liked it. I took it out of the box and still wasn't sure. I removed the small "things" attached to the front pockets (cheap looking) and transfered all my "stuff" from the old to the new. Every thing fit with room left over. My phone has its own special place so I took my new handbag out for a test. !. Straps are wide enough to carry on my shoulder. 2. Not a problem with weight, stuffed and comfortable. 3. Attached my keys to a hook I install in all my bags. The first time out was good and I now have decided that I do like the bag! And last but not least, Amazon delivered the bag 2 days after I ordered it. I have told my grown children, my grand children and my great grands, if Amazon doesn't have what you need, it doesn't exist!! Lovely!

I was intrigued by the colors of the handbag and bought the "green" one which I was pleased to find is not really green but more bluish green, as is pictured. The zippers work well, and the bag, being soft, should work well as far as being flexible enough to carry all I want it too. I also like the extra strap for carrying the bag over the shoulder. A few cons: 1. The top zippers leave small openings at the sides where they start and stop- so the bag is not sealed, and very small items could drop out if the bag is tipped over. A minor problem. 2. There is only a week to inform the company if there is a problem with the bag that you would like fixed. 3. The bag is not structured, it is very soft and floppy. This is good if you want to pack it in a suitcase. For every day use it is a minor nuisance since with the things I carry in it, some support happens. 4. The BIGGEST complaint/ concern I have is that the lining is loose. The lining is pretty, but it is only attached at the top, and the rest of it is not attached to the bag, in either main compartment. I have had bags before with loose lining and found them quite a nuisance to use, since reaching in to get something, sometimes the lining lifts out also- the lining remains attached- but only at the top, not throughout the bag. If the linings weren't loose, I would feel much better about the bag.

review_title: Quality leather handbag at a great price!
review_text: I've been using this handbag for about a month now and am very happy with it. It's made from a very soft leather and has many pockets for the various different things I tend to carry for my family at all times. I got the red, and it is a true, bright RED. Thanks to a lightening deal, I've now also ordered it in an additional three other colors. I think the only two minor complaints I would have is that the lining gets caught in the zippers sometimes if you're not careful, and I'd like to have the option of gold or brass colored hardware instead of just the silver. Clearly those issues didn't keep me from ordering more of these bags! I can see myself getting years of use out of this purse, and would recommend it.

Love this bag. The size and pockets are perfect for my use. It is not too heavy. I got the gray which is a warm neutral color. Perfect for all year. It will hold an iPad easily. It's easy to carry and retains its shape.
This bag stank to high heaven when I first opened it.

review_title: Great, soft, cuddly bag. Pink is a bit off.
review_text: i absolutely love this bag. It is soft and slouchy and has lots of pockets and zippers, just the way i wanted. my only complaint is that the pink is not anything like the photo. It's more of a tan/sandy pink but the bag is so wonderful that i bought another one in blue. I've gotten a ton of compliments on it. It holds everything in the world and somehow it all fits. One of my favorite bags ever.
I've had this purse for less than a week and one of the zippers broke already! I love the purse but will have to return it. Very disappointed.

review_title: A beautiful and comfortable bag to carry but for me it's ...
review_text: A beautiful and comfortable bag to carry but for me it's too floppy.. it won't stand up on it's own and the two zippers make it a task to open each time as opposed to opening with one hand. It's not practical for me. I flat plastic insert should be sewed into the bottom and only one zipper that can easily be opened with one hand should be considered. Most of us have kids in the car and need access to a wallet right away.

review_title: Lots of room, stylish and functional
review_text: I like the soft leather feel of this purse. It looks stylish and it has many pockets that are great for organizing things. I like the hardware that sets it off as well. I also like that it comes with a shoulder strap if you want that as well as the 2 straps. The quality appears to be good as well. I would recommend this if you are looking for a purse that looks good and is functional as well.

So many pockets and storage space. The reason for four stars is because the two zippered pockets on the front of the bag had the zipper pulls come off when I tried unzipping them. Seems they were not properly closed. Easy fix, I slipped them back on and used pliers to close them up. They are still a little rough to zip but will probably loosen with time. All in all a great bag that my daughter loves! Would buy again.

I bought this bag in blue. I was very pleased with the color. It is a little brighter than the picture, but still navy. It's a great size with lots of pockets. It should hold almost anything I want to carry. The shipping was very rapid, however, I didn't care for the way it was shipped. It wasn't in a box. It was in a plastic mailing bag. As a result, the mailman folded the package to fit it in the mailbox. It was a little more wrinkled than if it had been boxed. Other than that, I am very happy with my purchase. Update: I talked to the seller regarding the way the bag was shipped. They were very responsive and,their handling of the matter pleased me so much, I changed my rating from 4 to 5 stars. I will be buying from them again.

I really love this. The 'decoration' is very, very nice; the hardware (pulls and rings) are pretty and well made. The purse is well constructed: very nice lining, quality stitching, etc. The outside is just the right color and is sooooo soft. Love it. There are lots of pockets; a small (cell phone size) one on each end, two slanted zippered pockets on the front, a zippered pocket on the back. The top has two separate zippered sections with pockets sewn into the lining. The lining material is nice, not the cheap nylon stuff in most purses. My only drawback is the size. It is twice as large as I would like. Wish they'd make a smaller version with same features and style. Overall, I highly recommend.

I love this purse so much, I asked for a purple one for my birthday. So now I have two great purses! The red compliments most of my wardrobe. It is so soft and the straps are just the right length. I can fit diapers & wipes and so much more in here. There are 2 main compartments so I keep baby stuff in one side and mama stuff in the other side. The zippered pockets on the front are great for holding odds and ends like extra cash, socks, or snacks. I got a purse organizer to help me with easy transfer from purse to purse and it fits easily. Can even fit a small laptop in here (but not a good idea unless you have a protective sleeve for it). This bag doesn't look huge but it feels like a Mary Poppins bag! There are a few minor differences in the look between the purple and the red bags. I feel like the straps and design on the red bag is somewhat prettier, but I love both of them.

Lovely to see, soft to the touch. This handbag also has a multitude of compartments and pockets. 1 zippered pocket on back,1 snap fastened pocket on each side,1zippered pocket on each side of the front with beautiful silver flower zipper pulls. Inside the front interior zippered compartment is ample space for your stuff plus 2 pockets for mobile phone and other quick reach items. The back interior zippered compartment has ample room for your stuff and a zippered pocket. This bag is both lovely and functional.

review_title: Beautiful all leather, quality handbag at a Great Price!
review_text: I spent hours looking for a good quality leather handbag until I found this one on Amazon. Angelkiss has a nice line of all leather handbags at affordable prices. I received my handbag today and am thrilled! The leather is super soft, it looks very durable, and the quality of the bag is better than I expected. There are multiple zippered compartments, as well as a zipper at the top to secure everything. The size of the bag is roomy and wide at the bottom so things don't get squashed up. You can easily put your makeup bag, phone, tablet, wallet, and more in this bag. It works well as a shoulder bag with the straps or you can add the clip on strap. I bought the purple. It's dark purple, very rich looking and stunning! I would highly recommend this bag as compared to much higher priced handbags. Buy multiple colors!

I really like this bag - it's not a style I usually pick. It has room for everything and various compartments for all my stuff. It does look like leather but is not and really doesn't feel like leather. I can't say how long it will last compared to leather but the price was also so much less than it's leather counterpart so even if I only get a year out of it, the price was worth it. If it does last a decent amount of time I wouldn't hesitate to buy another like it.

I love these bags! I just purchased the purple one and I love it as much as the blue one I purchased awhile back! So roomy! I can carry my eyeglass case, my Kindle and my huge wallet --and that's just in one zippered section! In the other section I carry my smart phone and notepad, lipsticks, mirror, etc, etc.. AND still more pockets to fill! Whew! Also, the bag is so soft and comfortable to carry. I use the strap crossbody for lengthy walks, but for quick runs, I just use the handle. I would be very comfortable to gift these to friends or family!

review_title: Color is more of a dusty mauve
review_text: The color has more of a dusty mauve tone to it in person, rather than pale bubblegum pink. I found it rather offputting. I felt that the double zippers on top really seemed to limit the space inside the bag, I kept trying to find out where all the space went because from the outside it looks very large but the inside seems very snug. I ended up having to return it.

review_title: If you're looking for a sturdy bag-- keep on searching cuz this aint it
review_text: If you're looking for a sturdy bag-- keep on searching cuz this aint it! It is nice quality though, and very pretty.. just didnt realize it wouldnt sit up. Theres nothing wrong with the bag itself..

I love the size, shape and feel of this bag. It has great pockets and looks nice on my shoulder. Biggest complaint is the inside material isn't sewn in, so when you try to get something out, the insides come out. It is also hard to find things inside because of the excess material. Hope they fix this going further, otherwise it would be a fantastic bag.

review_title: Nice size and roomy, nice material
review_text: Lots of room and just a really nice purse. Also comes with a longer strap which I like. Cant beat the price. I ordered a red for mother-law and another blue for sis in law. Will make a great gift.

This arrived on time. It is what I expected it to be, even better actually. I ordered red, though a neutral color would have been more practical. I am so glad I got the red! It's beautiful. Pockets, pockets! I usually buy cheap purses, this is the most expensive one I've ever purchased. Love, love, love it. I use one purse until it's used up and then buy another. This one is going to be hard to part with when the time comes. ❤❤❤

review_title: It was super soft when I got it and I loved it
review_text: It was super soft when I got it and I loved it, however the color started to fade and wear off: the black is fading (I'm assuming from rubbing) during the brief time I've had this leaving these shiny silver spots: not at all happy with the quality.

Nice size, lots of room, very soft. The slanted two pockets in the front aren't really good for anything. Too small for a phone and small things fall out, but other than that it is great. In fact I would give it 5 stars except the hook on the strap broke the first day. I didn't order it for the shoulder strap, but it would have been nice to keep that option.

I've bought many purses in my lifetime but this has to be an all-time good investment. Love the soft leather, color, many compartments & the safety of having all the compartments close. No open parts. It will hold everything. It was lightweight until I filled it w/everything but the kitchen sink. Another good feature is the choice of 2 straps for a purse or one over-the-shoulder bag. Handy for traveling. I found the lining roomy but not too baggy, and I really like the name. An Angel kiss!! Just what we need.

I thought from the comments and the picture it was going to be a little big. But its actually perfect. I got a gray interior with the same pattern. Ots really nice ,feels like it will hold up well. And it holds my water bottle and my bible Very happy.All in one place for church. And I love all the pockets it has. I have my mints from traderjoes in the zip pockets in the front. Gingermints on one side and peppermints on the other.And It feels rugged.

I LOVE THIS HANDBAG!!!!! I rarely leave reviews but this bag deserves one.....I bought the pewter color & it is the perfect color to buy if you're looking for a color that will go with pretty much anything you wear the pewter color is it....it will go with blacks, browns, jeans...ANYTHING. The texture is so soft & touchable. It is comfortable to wear even fully loaded. There are so so many popkets to keep things organized & easy to find.....I want one of EVERY color now!!!

I love the overall look and feel of this bag however, I cannot give it a higher rating due to the two large zippered compartments. If this bag had only one zippered compartment I would absolutely love it and buy it in another color. Two drives me crazy always looking for things only to figure out what I'm looking for is in the other compartment. Also, the outside zippered compartment stitching broke rather quickly so I cannot use that for my phone anymore. The faux leather is so amazingly soft that there is no structure to the bag which isn't an overall deal breaker for me as I tend to put a ton of things in my bag. But if you don't really fill it it tends to be floppy. I've searched this brand for a one large compartment bag and they don't seem to make one which is a shame as I won't purchase from them again.

I bought this handbag/purse in the silver grey color. It is shiney and metallic. It is very gorgeous. It came very timely. I checked it over for any imperfections and could find none. The pu leather is very soft on the outside. It has several pockets inside and out. You can wear it over the shoulder or it comes with a strap so you can wear it crossbody which I prefer. I'm not really a handbag/purse kind of person. But when I saw this I fell in Love. If you are looking for an affordable handbag/purse that is very fashionable, great quality, and like most would probably pay a fortune for in a department store. Then I highly recommend this handbag/purse for you. I Love it and I know you will to. Thank You Angelkiss 100% satisfied customer here!!!

I just received this purse and LOVE it. It is large, but not too large, with m,any pockets. I really like the little pockets on each side. Perfect for a cell phone. I wish there had been more hardware. Now I just need to shop for charms....

Mine came without zipper pulls. I could use an old pair of earrings or something that would work but I'd like the option of using what it was supposed to come with. Also, I understand the possible color differences when shopping on line but this was many shades darker and redder than the picture or what could possibly be considered caramel. The purse was nice enough for the price but I'll pay a little more for the real leather next time.

I found this for my mom, who LOVES purple. I love purple, too, but wanted to wait and see as there are certain purples that are too loud and I didn't want to look like I was a Prince music video "extra." Well, when mom visited last time, she showed me her new handbag and it's definitely a very nice purple--not too bright/loud and this bag has lots of compartments to keep her organized! A+++

I love this purse. It’s soft and has oodles of pockets. The lining is thick and seems like it will hold up to repeated uses. The color is terrific for spring. I think it’s more of an aqua than green, so I’m happy about that. All in all, a terrific purchase!

review_title: Product Lacks Manufacturer ID As Well As Information About The Leather and Care Instructions
review_text: I love this item because it's so soft. But I do have an issue with it because I received it and there was no manufacturer tag on it. I have no clue who made it, what it's made out of or even about the dyes that were used to produce it. The only tags on it had "Angelkiss" marked on them(2) and that was it! I also didn't receive the purchase paperwork. Don't know if I'll do business with them again.

I purchased this as a gift for my mother because she wanted a black purse. She usually carries very large bags, which I feel is dangerous. She loves the purse and uses it often. This is my 2nd purchase of Angelkiss bags. They are very good quality and affordable. They don't look cheap.

review_title: Looks like a nice purse for the money.
review_text: I liked the color and the feel of the purse. I haven't really started using it, so I don't know how well it will hold up. review_title: This is a fantastic handbag. It is soft and supple

OMG... beautiful purse, perfect color, more of a rose pink & perfect size. It's so soft!! I LOVE IT!! 😀🖒

review_title: ... more natural to me Very soft leather and smells good. Plenty of room inside

Side pockets good for small cellphones. I bought a two pack organizer for about 10 to use for two pocketbooks For $30 for leather is good. Would purchase again

I love the look and feel of this purse. The washed leather is super soft. The should handles are very comfortable. the outside end pockets are a bit small in height and width. Overall a great buy and very cute.

review_title: I just love it. A particular place for everything means I ...
review_text: This handbag has so many pockets on the outside, I just love it. A particular place for everything means I don't lose my keys or sunglasses anymore! I like this style and the dark pewter color is a great neutral shade.

I absolutely LOVE this bag. It's perfect, so soft so many pockets, zippers are smooth easily slide's back and forth no catching. The color is exactly what I thought it would be a soft dusty rose. I will be buying another one.

I love this Handbag. The color is perfect and it has ample space inside for all your needs. Shipping was great and I would recommend this Seller and I will be ordering another color of this handbag soon.

I bought this in the grey and it is beautiful. No bad smell, like I have heard others say. Plenty of room, and so lightweight. The zippers work well. The inside lining is pretty ugly, but it seems of similar quality to other bags at an even higher price point. Very pleased with my purchase.
Love love this purse. The pockets and the softness along with being pretty.

review_title: A must have gorgeous leather hobo purse!

review_text: Wow...! This product is so bad that it takes the definition of bad to a new level. It's so bad that I question my sanity because there are many good reviews for this product. I keep asking myself, "Did they write a review for the same product I got?" The main issue I have with this product is the playback quality of any music YOU install (key point, read again) and not what the manufacturer pre-installs on the device (manufacturer installs two sample classical music files) (Read that last sentence again because it's a key point). I installed several different audio quality versions of MP3 files and FLAC files to see if any of them would play correctly. Nope. All of them play back with a very odd digital tinny or some kind of alien-like digital misfiring sound. All files I installed on this device play perfectly fine on any other digital music players of mine (basic MP3 player, iPod, FiiOs and more) so the problem is not with the files I installed. The ONLY two good things I say about this product are: 1. It is very lightweight and 2. It is very easy to drag and drop files to the device. That's it. I thoroughly read the directions several times, checked all settings (again several times) and I STILL can't get any music file I install on it to play correctly. I am quite tech savvy and I can't figure out what's exactly wrong. I concluded either the product is defective or this product is just a steaming P.O.C. (use your imagination what P.O.C. means). The bottom line is it shouldn't be this hard to get your music file to play correctly. I have already put too much time into getting this to work. However, I must say it was so bad that it made me chuckle many times! The sad part of this story is I bought it for my 10 year son so he could rock out to his favorite Billy Joel music. I now have to tell him the bad news he will have to wait longer until Dad finds a good mp3 player for him. I might just have to pony up for an expensive Sony. Ugh.

This light strip really accents my room and is a great addition to my bedroom! It had a very sleek appearance, and blended in very well with the rest of my room's aesthetic (see those Philips Hue lights? I LOVE them). The remote has many different colors that definitely shine (side note: this light strip has relatively color accurate LED's, which is a first for me, as most LED strips tend to shine on the green side). The small form factor of the remote is very convenient as well.The adhesive on the back was surprisingly alright, which was better than I have had with other similar products. It was very easy to place where I needed it and kept its hold well. The strip was white, which makes it extremely good at reflecting the light of the other LEDs, especially when using them for backlighting. I always get compliments on my slightly obnoxious room setup (I have 15 light strips), but they can be used for more robust applications, I would assume. It has a very solid construction, I have bent them at complete right angle and it still functions perfectly. I am glad I made this purchase, and it really bring makes my bedroom look 10 times sicker.

review_title: Bright, highly customizable LED strip, but terrible IR sensor control
review_text: Just got it set up today. Looks beautiful, and unlike many of the reviews I think the adhesive was perfectly sufficient for attaching it to the back of my plywood computer desk. The angles were tricky but that's not really the adhesive's fault. Unfortunately I have to dock my review 2 stars for usability. The whole IR receiver and power supply setup is of really poor quality, which I wasn't expecting for a $20 (normally $30) LED strip, given the many cheaper options out there. Two things: 1. The AC adapter connection: If I twist the metal connector from the AC adapter to the white box (LED power and IR sensor unit), I hear a faint buzzing sound and the LED strip powers off completely. Not a big issue but this doesn't really give me peace of mind over how long this thing will last. 2. The IR receiver: I have to point the remote directly at the receiver like a damned Wii first person shooter game in order for it to pick up any input whatsoever. I read somewhere this could be caused by IR interference from the LED strip itself. This seems to be the case for me - when the strip is powered off, it has a "reasonable" range of tolerance for being powered on with the remote, where I can point at an angle of maybe 5 degrees or so, from a few feet away. It doesn't help that they give pretty much no room to separate the tiny IR receiver dongle from the LED strip. (Given I've hardly seen this complaint in the product reviews, any tips would be appreciated here!)

"Excellent product,good quality! all the LED's work and seem pretty robust. The self adhesive backing everyone complains about worked perfectly fine when sticking them to walls and ceilings (matt paint). Just some more detailed information: The remote works well, the colors suggested on the buttons aren't very similar to the lighting equivalent but their OK. There are jump and fade settings that cycle through either RGB or Red, Green, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Cyan, White. You can't set your own colours on these. The flash (strobe) setting is white only. You can change the speed of these settings however. You can save up to six custom colors however you can't change the brightness of these using the brightness controls, you have to manually decrease the RGB values to do this. You can't change the brightness of the fade, jump or flash settings. The control box seems a little cheap but it't working OK. It's hard to set the LEDs up where you want due to the length of the cable and how short the Infra-red receiver is. This is remedied with a soldering iron however. The remote works a decent distance away given that the receiver is positioned correctly and is facing you. The LED's are very bright but you would probably need two of these to sufficiently light up a 6m sq room. The seller supplies you with 4 soft brackets that can be screwed into a wall to hold the LEDs up, but I haven't had to use them. I haven't tried linking more than one set together but it comes with a connector on the end for this. The connector from the LEDs to the control box is pretty loose and may need securing properly. The cover came off a couple of times for me too but it hasn't affected functionality. Overall, for the price an excellent product. I'm considering grabbing another one."

review_title: Very Bright LED Bike Light - Like really, really bright!
review_text: First off, I received this product at a discount to be able to try it out and give my honest feedback on it. Here are my thoughts: PROS: -Brightness: The LED Light is incredibly bright. It surprised me when I turned it on first the first time in the middle of the day. It reminds me of my SureFire M600 Ultra Scout Ultra-High Output LED Weapon Light, Black light I used in the military. SureFires are the best light money can buy in my opinion, but they are expensive. This light can compete. -Illumination: The radius of the light is pretty wide. This is ideal for biking or using it as a headlight at night. A flashlight usually points a beam of light straight out. This light illuminates a wide area around where you point it so you can see the entirety of the area around you. Very practical. -Light Modes: The 3 basic modes of lighting is all you really need normally. It has high intensity, low intensity and flashing/strobe. Highs works great if there really isn't any other light source around. If you are biking at night in the city with street lights and people around I find the low setting works just fine. You don't want to blind people. Again, on high it is really bright. Flashing is great for when you're biking when there our cars around. The eye is naturally drawn to the flashing on and off so cars notice you far better than just leaving it on high or low. -Rechargeable Battery: The battery is rechargeable! I really like that the battery is rechargeable. Most light use disposables and you have to replace them ever so often. The light gets dimmer and dimmer and unless you are using you light all the time you'll likely forget to replace the batteries when you need them. Being able to recharge this battery before a trip is a nice luxury. Also when this light has battery it has a green button that lights up. If it's not lit then you know you're 100% out of juice and need to recharge. -Versatility: I like that it can be used on and off of a bike. Handheld or head mounted with the head strap that comes. -Quality: I'm always skeptical of items made in China. The quality of this light and the various parts are of good quality. Is it as good as a $300 SureFire? No. Of course not. However, considering this light is a fraction of the cost I'm happily surprised. Nothing feels like it is going to break on you from regular use or even after some accidental drops. Again, I'm pleased with the quality and that it will hold up. PHOTOS: -1st Pic is of the headlamp itself -2nd Pic is of the headlamp on (hard to get a good photo of a light when it is on), the cord and external battery to power it and the charger of the battery. CONS: -Cords: The blessing and curse of having a rechargeable battery is there is a cord. Not just a cord for charging the unit when not in use. No there is a cord that goes from the light to the separate external rechargeable battery. I don't like cords. I don't think most people do. If you strap this to your bike and use zip ties or secure it another way then I think it's a non-issue. However, if you intend to mount and dismount it from a bike, unless you secure it temporarily, you'll have a lose cord flapping around when you are ridding. If you're mountain biking, there is a higher change that the cord catches on something. If you use it as a headlamp you have a cord hanging off your head, attached to the battery and you're either carrying the battery around in your hand, put it in your pocket or attach it to something so you can be hands free. Not ideal. CONCLUSION: I like this product a lot for what it is. Personally, I will be using it as a bike lamp/headlight and will be attaching it to the bike and not removing it. I think this is its best use and works great for the job. I can't speak to its long term durability as I haven't owned it very long, but in this scenario I give it 5 stars. If you want to use it as bike light and a headlight I'd give it 3-4 stars. It just isn't the best setup to switch them back and forth. As a headlamp with the cord attached, it sure is bright, but the cord is annoying. You sure can use this as a headlamp, but if you want a wire free solution I would recommend something like the Energizer Pro 3 LED Headlamp . It is light, very portable, no cords, cheap and works well. If you're looking for a good quality, very bright headlamp that gets the job done, pick this one up.
