These lights are absolutely beautiful. I string them around Christmas decorations, door frames, bookshelves, and window frames for holiday decorating. I don't think any have burned out, or if they do, the rest stay lit. The copper wire lets them easily bend to shape around anything and hang on nicely without anything else needed to attach them. They come with a remote which allows you to dim them, set to different flash and twinkle patterns, etc. I like to dim them when I sit by the Christmas tree at night so they aren't so bright. I absolutely love the soft warm light these cast, there is something much more warm and romantic about these versus regular Christmas lights with the larger mini bulbs. They've lasted two Christmas seasons constantly on from November 15th- January 2nd with no issues. I also keep them on a seasonal tree I decorate year round for every holiday and season, which has been constantly on for over 2 years. I highly recommend them.
Love these little things.

review_title: Pretty overall design, too bright, limited expandability, power cord too short.
review_text: Looks better in the pictures, this thing is incredibly bright, not nearly as long as you think 33' isn't much, and the power cord is about 24" so if you want to use it on a porch umbrella like I did, you are out of luck unless you want extension cords and wiring everywhere. which involves removing your umbrella, and hoping the hole will allow you enough room so you can run an extention cord up through the hole and you'll have to precariously dangle the power brick cable and the controller box up in the rafters of the umbrella. Mine worked fine out of the box, most of the buttons on the controller work, the arrow up and down buttons don't seems to do anything. The overall look of the string of lights is very minimalistic, very classy look. not heavy green or white wires like xmas leds, the copper wire is very thin very easy to hide....it is also very weak and feels like you could break it, mine arrived slightly untwisted and partially tangled with a kink in it. this will be a weak spot over time. Ridiculously bright when set on 100, hurts to look at it, it can be dimmed down in intervals of 10 to a dimmer light but even on the lowest setting it is still very bright for a backyard umbrella. The remote is comprehensive, lots of controls, none seem super useful. except the dimming. the "throbbing" feature or smooth flashing is neat, but way to fast, and abruptly stops and blinks at the end of each cycle. One the slowest setting, the total time take for the light to go from on to off to on again is about 30 seconds...this should be somewhere along the lines of 3 minutes to give a gradual sunrise, sunset feel. You cannot buy several of these and string them together and use one power brick and one remote which is just aggravating and reduces the places you can effectively use this. Great for small displays, not what I expected, I paid $15 from an amazon daily deal, I feel like it was worth about $10. I would not buy another if given the opportunity.

Great lights - ordered 3 sets. 2 set of white lights and 1 multicolor one. One of the lights was to replace one given as a gift (from a different company) that didn't have remote control and they were the same price. Remote is great for my kids who use it to decorate and light up their room. They like the ability to turn off the lights from bed. Only thing they wish it had was a timer because they fall asleep in bed and forget to turn it off. I've included a photo of the heart my daughter put above her bed. It's kind of sideways because I don't know how to rotate this photo for Amazon.

review_title: Product was defective but the vendor is working with me on replacing the set. Will update review soon.
review_text: Update: 01/10/17 - based on my review below, the vendor contacted me and is working with me to ensure that the defective product I received is replaced. I find the customer service thus far to be stellar; therefore, I am updating my review. I originally ordered 2 sets so I will try the second set out now and see how things go. I will update my review on the operation of the second set as well as the customer service response once the issue has concluded. Therefore, I am changing my 1 star review to a 3 star review for now. ------------------------------------ Don't waste your money. These lights were turned on 1 to 1-1/2 hours each evening in a bedroom and stopped working after 8 days. I am sooo glad I decided to order this small set before I sprang for the larger set for outdoors. What a ripoff.

review_title: You might get lucky. And you might not.
review_text: The first of the 2 string lights performed perfectly, and are very nice. The 2nd set has at least 2 intermittent shorts that became apparent when I was setting them up (as they kept flickering on and off). I found one of the shorts and will go after it with some electrical tape. Don't know where the other one is. By jiggling the set, they are now on, but I am nervous. So I will keep any eye on it throughout the holidays, then I think I will just have to pitch the 2nd string. It's just not worth the risk. It is also not worth the time and trouble of sending both back, when only one is faulty, which is what Amazon would make me do, and of course, having to replace them. Too bad, because before this experience I would have wholeheartedly recommended the taotronics light strings. I already have 2 of them in lanterns that I use every evening. Both have worked perfectly. But this time, no such luck. So I guess this is actually a 2.5 star review.

I love these string lights. They are the softest light and yet give enough light that I do not need to turn on the regular lights most of the time.They are so light weight they hang anywhere. They are so easy to arrange so they are pleasing to the eye anywhere you put them. You can hang them or drape them or curl them up in a jar or vase or whatever you want to do. I love the fact that you can place them where you want them and plug them in behind large pieces of furniture and then just use the remote control to turn them on or off. I am adding these string lights to each room in my house. I find that these string lights help me in the winter so that the house seems cozy rather than dreary from the rainy or foggy days of winter. These are so worth the money.

review_title: Had to throw away because the lines were cut
review_text: I plugged this in and the lights came on. Within 30 seconds they began flashing and then went out. I then found that two of the 3 wires were cut at a point towards the end of the string. If you hold the tips of the wires together the lights would come on. I tried all sorts of things to try to salvage this. I tried tape, but the tips wouldn't stay together. I then tried twisting the wires together but couldn't get the lights to stay on. Then I tried sticking the wires into the phillips side of a screw. This worked the best but still I couldn't get it to stay. Finally I tried to just cut this section off and splice it with the very end, but no bueno. I ended up having to throw this away. $15 down the drain. Sadly, this is the 2nd highly rated product I've received broken from Amazon in the past week. Really pathetic. Fortunately, I was able to fix the other product myself (hopefully the fix lasts the longterm). You will probably not be able to fix this item unless you are an electrician. It definitely pisses me off that so many people would rate such a flimsy product so highly.

review_title: Just what I was looking for
review_text: These are perfect. They light up my shelves, but when they are turned off they are hardly noticeable. I originally put up bulkier lights and it just looked cluttered. These are clean, easy to work with, and the fact the wire holds a shape makes them easy to place. I love the dimmer feature with the remote. I have my house hooked up to Amazon Alexa, and I needed a set of lights that would remember the last setting for them to work with Alexa. I just used a smart plug between the lights and the power and it works perfectly. Super pleased and highly reccomend these. I went through so many other brands searching for these features, and they weren’t that easy to find. These are a step above the rest!

review_title: Not warm white, but still a nice product
review_text: Update: The company emailed me and offered a replacement or a refund without need for return and they were very friendly. To me that is very respectable of a company to take responsibility and that alone makes my rating increase. I have been using them consistenty for about a week now and I have found that they seem durable and can stay on very long without getting hot. I have left them on all night and they still felt room temp when i woke up. They might not be 100% "warm white" but whne you dim the lights with the remote it does the job well. for whatever reason "warm white" is not the color i revieced. Only maybe 50% of the lights are warm white and the other are bright white. The rest of the aspects of the lights are okay but they came super tangled up and they are hard to untangle and just arrange in general. im gonna update this review in 2-3 weeks to see if they are actually quality and last.

Yeah! I like them! At first I didn't like them because they aren't as warm as my other lights I used to have. These aren't overly bright or anything, but it is a clean white light that you can dim and brighten. I imagine these lights are a midway point between very warm lights you can buy and the ones that are extremely white and bright. These have ambiance for sure. They are super functional in my kitchen because we live in an old house where the light switch is on the other side of the kitchen so you have to walk through the dark kitchen to get to the switch. I keep the little remote next to the doorway and just turn on the lights that way. I keep these lights on in my kitchen for nice calm lighting for the evening

These lights are amazing. They came very well packaged and easy to unroll. The remote is a very nice feature and I love that they are dimmable. Some of the newer LED lights are too bright for my taste, so I love that I can dim them a little. I would definitely recommend these lights.

review_title: Unreliable - Should be Fun but Frustrating
review_text: 33ft 100 LED String Lights Dimmable with Remote Control, TaoTronics Waterproof Decorative Lights for Bedroom, Patio, Garden, Gate, Yard, Parties, Wedding ( Copper Wire Lights, Warm White ) The remote is touchy in that you must aim the remote "laser" at the connector box that you need to attach between the lights and the plug. So - unless you can see the end of the lights where they plug into your electiricity there will be no effect from the remote. There was no instruction booklet to tell me what this extra connector was for. It took me an hour to figure out how to open the battery tray to check to see if there was one -- since the remote wasn't working I had no clue until I opened the tray even though there was a plastic tab in the tray that was meant to keep the battery from activating in shipment, etc. Once I got it figured out. ehh it's okay. Very fragile light set.

We threaded these around the headboard of my daughter's brass bed and turn them on at night during prayers and then off again for sleeping. A couple nights we left them on all night for a sleepover kid who wanted light. We have been over the moon for these...until last month when they quit working. 13 months after we bought them. They had not gotten heavy use. (I tried all the trouble shooting I can think of. It's not the remote, for it works on another set we bought.) For the price I paid I feel like I got my money's worth, but I despise disposable products. There's really no reason this shouldn't have continued to work for years. For what it's worth, the second set, placed on a shelf, has been on 24/7 for 13 months and still going strong.

review_title: LED Lights to brighten up your sad, dark, lonely existence.
review_text: These lights look really great in my room, and they work perfectly. I like the different levels of brightness; I can turn them up when I'm writing poetry about the crushing weight of my own mortality, or I can turn them down low when I just want to weep in the dark but still need enough light to see the photographs of the family and friends who have left me behind. I can't see me using the flashing effects much, but it's nice to know if there's ever a sexy dance party in my bedroom, I can bring something to the table. The lights are on a semi-rigid wire, which makes hanging them very easy. I used push-pins and it took 10 minutes. The remote works just fine; it's responsive and easy to use. All in all, this product was a winner, even if I'm not.

These lights are awesome!!! I have a glass top bar and I used the lights to put underneath the glass. It looks fantastic. I used those clear Command small hooks & zip ties to keep the lights in place. Check out the photo! We call it the V.I.P. Section!

review_title: Controller Doesn't Work - Updated w/ Positive Feedback
review_text: My original comment was about the controller: "Checked on the web to see if this is a common problem and it seems that other buyers of similar lights had problems. There's a hack on YouTube which shows that the contacts between the base of the controller and the upper "buttons" become corroded or otherwise lose contact. Need some work to correct one button (and aluminum duct tape), so to fix the entire controller would be a major effort. Lights work fine, but the features advertised (dimming, pulsing, etc.) are not possible w/ a defective controller." Subsequently, I was contacted by the seller who offered to send out a new set of lights and remote which they did. The new set works fine. Kudos to the seller for reaching out and following up with excellent customer service. Way to go!

review_title: Great for the Classroom BUT wait...
review_text: I used these lights to make a bulletin board frame sparkle! My students love the lights, and the name of the board is "news flash" so the lights remind them to pay attention to the school info posted there! Im very angry to report that since my last review I attempted to hang 2 sets of these lights in my bedroom and they stopped working all together. When I was telling my mom about this, she said she had the exact same problem. Work fine for a while, attepmt to move and they stop working. Only 2 lights at the very end of the strand light up. Very disappointed.

We bought these to use in a very dark hall. We wanted a light that we could leave on 24/7 that wasn't too bright. The string was much too long for our 10 foot area so we just folded it back on itself 3 times, carefully making a small loop at the end so the wire wouldn't crimp. We've got them set at 10% which is more than enough to see clearly without making the hall obviously bright (it's right off our TV room and I am very picky about light when watching). I will edit my review if there are any changes, along with how long the string lasts. Note: we bought ours from seller Sunvalleytek . I had a question/comment and they provided EXCELLENT customer service. Don't hesitate to purchase from them. :)

review_title: I have a Tao Tronics Bluetooth adapter which is great quality - this unfortunately might be if it was ...
review_text: I have a Tao Tronics Bluetooth adapter which is great quality - this unfortunately might be if it was sold as indoor, but it is definitly not fit for outdoor use. I hung these outside for deck, along an alcove under a covered concrete roof, but live on the coast so see a lot of rust and salt/damp effects on kit. They suffered no direct rain, but lasted les than a month before one section, then another, then finally all sections burnt out. This is due purely to dampness in the marine environment, and the shorts on the wires where they burnt out where clearly visible. I would not put this on the thatched roof! I will be buying genuine, thik, LED rope light next time. For indoors - fine; for outdoors - simply a waste of money.

I'm in love with these lights! They're definitely worth the price. The diverse settings are so cool. I love having 10 different brightness settings, and the smooth setting is great too! The wire is extremely moldable, and almost looks rose gold--very pretty! The lights are very long. My bed shown is king sized, and the lights go down to the floor on each end. The lights do not get hot--even when I leave them on all day! I've recommended these lights to all of my friends, and I get compliments on them whenever someone comes in my room! They look great when paired with a tapestry. I would 100% buy these again! One negative: the remote isn't very sturdy and I have to point it very close to the outlet in order for it to work. Not that big of a deal though :)

review_title: So far so good. I'm a fan, they look really nice. They have a sweet delicate look to them!
review_text: I bought 3 sets of these light. I was a little nervous wondering if I'd like these. I am pleased so far! The quality is pretty decent. I keep them on during the day and haven't had any problems! Pros: - Very pretty - Delicate-looking in a very good way! - The quality of the item is good and the aesthetics are FANTASTIC! - Incredibly VERSATILE! (Just look at all the display options! I LOVE THAT THE REMOTE FROM ONE SET CAN CONTROL ALL THE SETS!!! Cons: - Easily tangled! - The cord at the end looks tacky and large. - I'd like to be able to discreetly string them together. It'd be nice to be able to plug them in running continuously from one strand to the next! - "Stringing them together" to make a longer chain of them would be a nice feature!

I'm writing this review over 1 year later, because the product and company, amaze me. To talk first about the product, the lights are great and having the remote is so beneficial as it's nice to be able to easily turn off the lights. I specifically use these lights in my bedroom where I can turn them on and off from my bed. I like the various settings and being able to control the brightness. I recently moved and because of that move, I lost the remote to these lights. I reached out to the company to see how to purchase a remote and they sent me a remote for free, more than one year after my original purchase. To me, this is incredible and has spurred me to write this review. Kudos to a great product and a great customer service team who responded quickly (within a few days) and were helpful and generous.
Look great in mason jars! Held up in the rain. I would suggest sealing the mason jar hole on top if they're outside to avoid filling up with water if it rains.

These are my FAVOURITE lights !! There is nothing about them I don't like. They arrived quickly with professional packaging & directions. The remote has so many different choices & the lights were very easy and quick to set up. Just what I needed !!

review_title: Lasted two and a half months before dying.
review_text: The lights were very pretty when we first bought them for our patio and they were easy to put up. After several weeks, we noticed they were dimmer than when first put up. Upon inspection, we figured out that if we wiggled some of the wires near the end of the light rope, the lights would brighten again. We went through this process many times, until finally, after two and a half months, they no longer work.

review_title: Great for the holidays or every day
review_text: Nice bright lights. Bought this to go under a kitchen cabinet, but had thought about using it for Christmas lights before that. Nice lightweight lines made it an easy choice to adapt under the cabinet. Remote works well, and offers dim and flashing options and a bright option. Plenty of length and package was nice and compact if I wanted to roll it up and store it, say after the holidays. Great lightning buy, and I'd go back for an everyday buy to put a pair in a few other places throughout the house as well.

review_title: Perfect for all my projects and many more.. Will buy again!
review_text: I wished I would have know about these before spending money on other random lights. I love that they can plug in. Other light set's I have purchased in the past require batteries, while those are terrific for certain needs the batteries never last long and not worth the hassle. I purchased these to put under my cabinets (kick plate area). When designing my kitchen I did over and under cabinet lighting cause that is how I roll, but soon realized that near the floor would be so nice at night when going down to get a glass of water. I purchased these knowing that I had adequate distance to the plug and with enough length of wire I am set. I have read other reviews where people were saying that you had to be right close to the receiver to get the remote to work. True, but for what I am using it for it won't be an issue. The remote is handy but again you do have to have direct view to get the lights to dim, dance, or turn on and off.

I purchased these in July 2015 to serve as a light at night. I love that they do not heat up even when they stay on all night. The remote can be a little tricky, but it's not too much of a hassle. Unfortunately, either the remote or the receiver went out this week, so we can no longer change the settings. Originally, we thought it was the battery on the remote, but the problem was not fixed after the battery was replace. The lights are stuck in the flicker mode, but can still be turned on and off by using the plug. Edit 1/22/17: Customer service contacted me almost immediately after I posted my review and offered to send me a replacement. The box on the new set is black instead of white (see picture), but I'm not sure if there's any other difference. I plugged the new box into the old string lights, and they work perfectly with it. We currently have these set up in our fireplace in lieu of an actual fire, and they look nice with the 20s fade setting.

review_title: Sets the mood for any occasion or room! Buy with confidence!
review_text: A wonderful addition to any room for added decoration or to set the mood for that special occasion! Even as a guy, I find it adds a certain romance factor in the bedroom. The remote is great, as I find my lamps are often to bright on my eyes to turn on first thing in the morning or if I get up in the night for a drink. I love that it never gets hot, always cool to the touch. It's bendable to almost any position! It's just an all around great string lighting! Love the functionality of it as well! Bright or dim, it's the perfect string lighting for any occasion! A great purchase for the price! P.S. please excuse my bedroom, I have kittens w./claws.. Need I say more? (it's why everything is covered.)

I've had these lights in my bedroom for nearly a year. Great mood lighting, lowest setting is a perfect nightlight, and it adds so much to my decor. Have switched bedrooms 3 times now and didn't have to deal with a tangled mess like you typically do with standard string lights, even with them packed away for a month before moving out of state. I don't know if it's from all the use I get out of them but they randomly stopped working recently and the company agreed to send me a replacement free of charge so I'm happy not only with the product but with the fast and friendly costumer service. My roommate purchased a set for the kitchen that's been going strong for some time even with 24/7 use. Will buy again.

review_title: Inexpensive and they work great. They have a pleasing soft white light
review_text: Inexpensive and they work great. They have a pleasing soft white light. I use them as concealed lighting for a workspace. This is the second string I have purchased. 33ft 100 LED String Lights Dimmable with Remote Control, TaoTronics Waterproof Decorative Lights for Bedroom, Patio, Garden, Gate, Yard, Parties, Wedding ( Copper Wire Lights, Warm White ) I might get more. I use Command mini hooks to secure them in place. Command Decorating Clips, Clear, 40-Clips (17026CLR-40ES) The wire is strong and flexible. There is a remote control for on/off and dimming. This string is intended for indoor use only. They also make an outdoor version which is weatherproof.

review_title: Bright, light weight, easy to shape, with a remote with tons of features! Best of it's kind!
review_text: I did a lot of research on all the string lights and these are by far the highest quality at the most affordable rate. The remote is so important. This specific remote has a ton of options that I have yet to use but plan on another set. The lights are really light in weight and the copper wire allows to bend and shape the way the lights hang without needing to use many tacks or tools. Another great feature about these lights is they don't get really hot which can be a problem with other brands. You can hang these lights on the wall or bunch them up in a vase making a really cool light source as these put off a lot of light for how tiny the bulbs are. I am ordering 2 additional sets for this purpose now! There are a lot of options out there, I highly recommend these!

I received the product two months ago and love the idea the simplistic yet functional design behind the lights. I have used them for decoration in the home, mood lighting, strobe effect for Halloween, draped over Christmas scenes on the mantle... The copper wiring and lighting looks beautiful. The remote control has several settings, the lighting is great for many indoor decor and projects, it is pretty long for what I need it for. The remote needs to be within ten feet and have a direct line of sight with the reader. It takes some getting used to switching the mode then settings for each mode. I am very careful with the wiring. It is thin gauge solid copper and looks very easy to break especially after a lot of use. I expect it to break easily if I crimp or pull it while it is kinked. Over all it was a great purchase for the price. It is not for use outside.

These lights are beautiful! Bought two strands to wrap around my 10x10 room. Love the ability to dim them. The light fixture in my room doesn't work any more so these lights do the trick. The fact that it has a remote is awesome. It's always nice being able to turn off the lights without having to budge. One remote works for both strands.

review_title: Beautiful, much more than I expected!
review_text: I really love these lights. They are very bright. I can't even imagine all the things that you could do with these. They are led lights on a copper wire. At night you can't even see the wire. The roll of lights came with a remote where you can change the way the light flash, strobe, stay on, etc. There's many options on the remote. This roll of lights are long, really long. I would definitely buy these again and since I only bought 3 sets, I most definitely will be buying more because they would be amazing for Christmas. If I had anything I could have differently I would wish they came on a spool. Since the lights are on a fairly thin copper wire with an LED light somewhat flat against the line, they seem to tangle fairly easily. I will be finding something to wind my on when not in use. I believe they're pretty durable. I could see me harming them trying to untangle them long before they would burn out or fray on their own.

review_title: Eye catching and decorative year round!
review_text: I bought this one and the 66 ft. strand. They are both attractive and eye appealing. I put this strand above the cabinets in my kitchen for mood lighting. I wrapped the 66 ft. strand around my staircase. I use them both every night. The remote has many functions which I tried out but rarely use. The most used by me is the dim function. I'll probably be getting a few more strands in the future to put above my other cabinets and the rest of my stairs.

OMGSH greatest thing ever. I LOVE THESE. I have a small 1 rm apt. and in the kitchen I have a pole lamp in which I had been using the 100 bulb white xmas tree lights year round for a constant light. But it was annoying to have to buy a stockpile evry holidays season and even more annoying to remove them when out and reattach the new set. I ordered these and was SHOCKED when I saw that THESE TINY BULBS make A LOT of light. It is such a moveable formable item and took 2 little pieces of tape instead of the bunch from my last lights that I was happy in that alone. PLUS THE REMOTE control is awesome. I never unplugged the xmas lights as it was too hard to reach behind stuff to get it. so now I can just use the on and off. I don't even know what all the other remote options do as Im completely thrilled with this product. If I had a larger place Id have them all over . hahaha

review_title: Great product, broke early, but replaced quickly
review_text: While a very nice accent, I did have an issue within one month of purchase. That is the only reason it isn't getting 5 stars. The reason is STILL gets 4 stars is because I had a replacement unit at my house in 3 days after I contacted the company. The customer service was awesome. The light itself serves as a nightlight for some young girls. They love that the light can be made bright enough to see the entire room, but then dimmed to be dark enough to sleep with. I highly suggest putting some self-stick velcro on the remote and having the remote in the same location all the time because it can't work without it. It isn't the greatest remote, but everything isn't as easy as the bluetooth-enabled remote on the Fire TV. Keeping it in the room keeps it from getting lost and it can only be used in the room, so it only makes sense. Again, bright and neat, but the early problem dropped it a star. If the replacement lasts longer, I might bump it back to 5.

review_title: I highly recommend these LED lights with adjustable brightness
review_text: I highly recommend these LED lights with adjustable brightness. You can have exactly the amount of brightness you want across a selectable range, from dim to very bright. These LEDs have no flickering at all that I can see. The color of the lights appears warm to me, not stark white. I have them strung in a 7-foot silk bamboo tree, and it's plenty of length and LEDs. I really like how small these lights are and how the thin wire becomes almost invisible in the tree. The uploaded photo shows the lights set at 40% in a room with fairly low lighting. The only improvement I can think of for the design is to increase the range of the remote control. I have to walk up within a few feet of the IR receiver for it to pick up the signal.

review_title: They were really friendly and easy to communicate with and I will definitely use them ...
review_text: This review is for the customer service, also the product but mainly the customer service. I bought these lights earlier this summer maybe in august and then they stopped working at the end of November. I tested it out on different outlets and no success. I reached out to the seller and sent a picture of the malfunctioning lights and they sent me a replacement asap. They were really friendly and easy to communicate with and I will definitely use them again when purchasing string lights. Now for the lights, they're a great length and they have a good brightness and I love that you can adjust the brightness. I also like the copper wiring so they can easily be molded to where you want them to be which is sweet because it's outlining the bottom of my floor, around my door, and up near my bed. It's rad and I love it. One thing is, I did see a review about broken remotes and that if it breaks you have to buy a new set but all the remotes are universal, i did not experience that universal remote because my old remote doesn't work on my new lights, bummer. Other than that, all is good.

I actually really loved these lights at first. They made my room so peaceful and calming. I would be giving this 5 stars if they didn't stop working within 6 weeks of owning them! I only used them for a little bit at night before bed. They weren't on for extended amounts of time and they were not touched or manipulated at all after installing them. I'm not sure if it's the remote or the actual lights themselves but I tried changing out the battery, unplugging everything and trying again and they still won't turn back on. Very very sad! Will be contacting seller to see if they can be replaced. If they do and they work longer than a few weeks, I will change my rating to 5 stars.

review_title: So Far, great value for the money
review_text: So far so good. We did a screened porch project and I wanted some indirect accent lighting to put behind crown moulding. Most light strands were super expensive, so I figured what the heck for the price. So far very impressive. While they don't look like much, they give off the correct accent glow when the sun goes down. You won't read a novel by them, but if you want some nice accent up lighting, these will do the trick. Located in a 10 x 15 space, about 8 feet off the floor, the 33 feet were not quite long enough to encompass the entire perimeter but they do the job for what I wanted. Too bad you can't string them together. The remote works fine, just point it at the receiver and it does the trick. Only issue? The plug goes into the socket sideways, so for the power outlet I configured I didn't adjust for the width of the plug. It's not a standard type little two-prong job, the housing is a bit larger.

Copper wire came tied into a circle with multiple wrap-arounds and the copper wire separated from the wiring immediately. Took me over 20 minutes to untangle the wire only for it to not be connected. Trying to push the copper into the plastic slot (where wire was separated) caused it to spark numerous times. Waste of money. Product did not even last 20 minutes!!!!

review_title: I like the lights and the remote is ok - BUT ...
review_text: I like the lights and the remote is ok - BUT as far as the design.........I do have 2 suggestions for changes. 1. They are sold with a promotion of 5 foot adapter cord, seeming that the cord and power adapter can be placed (hidden) a distance from the string. The problem is that the remote control receiver (a small box that is 'in line' with the cord) is right next to the lights. It is true that the part that you plug in is 5 feet away - but the piece that allows the remote to work is at the other end of the 5 feet (close to the lights). NOTE the remote portion is removable, so if you want to just leave the lights on or off, the plug part is fine being a 5' distance from the lights. 2. The second design item that creates a problem is that the remote control receiver (a small box that is 'in line' with the cord) is white and the cord is black. I guess depending on your application, these details may not be of a concern - but, again, I would suggest a design that has them the same color, or, for me, NOT white! If your gong to have to hide these pieces - trying to camouflage a white box is a bit of a challenge - especially if the rest of the cord that you have to hide is black! Because of these 2 things, I will likely not use these lights in the way I had originally intended. I will keep them for Christmas time in hopes they will work with some of my decorations. For this reason (because it is February), I cannot comment on how they hold up, etc.

review_title: Beautiful lights that can really be used year-round!
review_text: This is a really cool set of lights! I love the delicate bulbs and copper wire. I used them to decorate our staircase, and they reached from top to bottom with a few feet to spare (see my photos). The remote has a lot of buttons, but many of the 'modes' looked exactly the same to me. But you still have quite a few looks that work. Fade-down and up, constant, flash at different speeds, etc. Overall, these are beautiful lights that can really be used year-round!

I bought another brand initially and it had a bunch of different options but the lights flashed a lot quicker than I wanted. I was looking for a more subtle effect. These had that option. There is a fade in and out mode and I believe you can set it from 5 to 25 seconds in 5 seconds increments. I will say that both units were programmed the same way which kind of annoys me. On the fade in and out option the lights get up to full brightness and then go step by step to dim again. So there's a dimming option and if you choose to dim it to 50% the light cycle through 50% quicker rather than spending more time at each level of brightness.

review_title: No more Christmastime ER visits from stringing cumbersome window lights.
review_text: This is my first year using these ever, and as Christmas lights for my windows. What a breathe of fresh air! They weigh nothing and are so easy to manage. I put them up and secured them with a few pieces of regular 'Scotch' tape, saving myself time, money and hassle on those suction cup things that always get lost in between Christmases. You can easily be more creative with these too if you want to get away from just pegging straight lines. Light intensity-wise there's more bang for the buck per window as LED's are crisper and more powerful. If there's anything to add after the holidays I will. The proof will be in whether I'm reusing them next year because they still work. I'll certainly let everybody know. Update: I did get another year out of them, but in all fairness I must add that I never got around to taking them down ;)

Love them! So pretty and the remote is awesome! Update: These lights are still so vibrant and working amazingly well! The best feature is the remote. I keep it on my nightstand, so I can just turn off the lights before I go to sleep. The best lights I've ever owned. Highly recommended for indoor or outdoors.

Perfect amount of light and I love how I could bend the copper into shapes (even though I was too lazy to do it)! We bought these to frame underneath the display case that hangs above our 10 yr old's bed. The high setting gives her the perfect amount of light so she can read at night, and the low setting gives that delicate, ethereal lighting that makes her feel like she's "sleeping under the stars". The remote works easily and intuitively. Way more settings than I expected! The only challenge was unwrapping it from the coiled roll it came in. It's not the way they wrapped it, though, it's because I started to unwrap it in the wrong place, and that got the wire all tangled up into itself. So, be careful as you unwrap/uncoil it. That being said, love the product and I only wish I would've bought MORE!

review_title: The BEST by far! Love these!
review_text: I love everything LED! These are fantastic! The dimming feature really allows you to customize the lighting setting you desire. The copper strand is absolutely stunning. The length is just about perfect for any small projects. I used them to wrap around some large decorative glass stands beside my fireplace. They look amazing. I would highly recommend these to anyone that is looking for a way to showcase something or someplace in their home. They are beautiful!

I got these to string on steps between floors in the house to stay on permanently as a safety measure. I was tired of replacing batteries on motion sensor stair lights. I really like these LED lights for this purpose, they are just what I hoped for ...while the thin wire can be a little annoying to string out and place, the wire does make it easy to anchor (just turn the wire to create a tiny space and insert a pin to anchor to carpet at beginning and end of the stairway, with a few anchors in the middle) and the result is excellent -- attractive, just the right amount of light for the purpose, and the long life of LED bulbs and low energy costs make them the most practical way to light a staircase. (And the long length makes it possible to place lights horizontally as well as vertically at critical spots with a fairly standard sized staircase between floors.) I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars because of a problem with the remote. It worked for one of the features the first time and then stopped working. The pictured remote in the accompanying brochure does not match the button arrangement (or insignias) on the remote, so the problem could be a mismatch between the remote that was sent and the light strand. But since I just want the lights to stay on at 100% brightness the faulty remote is not a problem unless there are times when I might want to turn these off without bending over to reach an out of the way outlet.

review_title: Tiny lights that pack a punch!
review_text: We looked for a long time to find some appropriate lighting for our floor to ceiling black shelving. I purchased these to illuminate the Christmas display on these black shelves. They worked great!! I like that I could use 2 strands that worked off the same remote. These are extremely light and only required a small strip of scotch tape to stay in place. The bendable wire allows you to strategically place the wires so that are not easily visible yet provide enough light to accent the display. The different lighting modes works great also and allows you to have different light sequences or dim them as you desire via the remote. NOW....June of 2016 we have strung these lights under the roof of our patio to provide lighting for summer nights and they work great!! Again, only needed tape to mount them and the remotes are a wonderful to dim or turn them up as you desire. We will be buying more of these in the future for other projects.

Love these lights, they create such a nice atmosphere in my room. The lights themselves are very bright. However I waited so long to actually test them out and now I cant return them and the remote doesn't work at all I can sometimes get them to turn on but can't get them to turn off, can't dim them or change the settings. I haven't seen anything like this in the reviews so maybe I just got a bad one. Either way I'm very disappointed. Edit* The company contacted me right away after writing the review and sent me a replacement, the new ones work perfectly and I am very happy with them. Great customer service

review_title: Did not survive long enough to use.
review_text: The Starry String lights are entirely too fragile. The copper wire bent and split while the lights were being installed. They might be useful if handled with extreme care for a single installation but are totally unsuitable for reuse.

These look great on our balcony! Planning to buy more, because I got cute ideas from the customer photos. Update 1/18/17 - I changed my review from 5 stars to 1 because half of the strand stopped working tonight. They were delivered on 11/3/16. To not even last for the 1st 2.5 months is pretty lame. Man, I really loved having these on my apt balcony and was planning to get more. Wish they had lasted longer.

Wow, I wouldn't think this could generate enough light to illuminate a walkway....but it does ! Considering the simplicity and light weight....this is a marvel. I hope it lasts the winter. I am using it under a carport walkway that does not have access to sunlight. This very little string of lights does a more than adequate job. If the space is smaller (living room, patio walkway or covered area, these lights are quite adequate to the task. I am glad I bought a two pack since I will use the other string in our covered deck area come late spring (Oregon)

These lights are so beautiful, but SO fragile. They were wonderful for 5 minutes until the copper wire tore and took out the rest of the strand rendering them useless. I considered buying another set, but they are just too flimsy.

These lights arrived broken. I didn’t even attempted to unfurl the wire. I just plugged them in to see what they looked like. Only about 1/3 of them lit. Upon closer examination I found that one of the three copper wires was broken. They are beautiful, but way too fragile. Update: I contacted the seller about this issue and requested a replacement. They promptly sent a new string (did not ask me to return the broken one). I was surprised to see the replacement string was neatly wrapped around a spool and in perfect working order. The string I had initially received from Amazon was not on a spool and may have been a returned item reshipped to me. Having them on a spool not only protected them but made them tangle free and much easier to handle. I can now recommend this product and the seller.

New item as advertised. I used this string for night lighting of my veranda porch. I chose yellow for a more subdued, less intense light. I am very happy with the result. The porch is better lit than using a single 60 watt bulb set at a single location. I live off-grid and use solar voltaics with battery power at night, so the 5 watts rating of the string is a huge plus. The remote could be handy should I chose to use it. I hung the string with the nail and plastic clip hangers for telephone lines, so the string was never pinched by conductive metal. For my use, a built in timer circuit would have been nice to shut off the lights on their own should I fall asleep while the lights are on.

Been wanting to get a string of these to mount under kitchen cabinets as an alternative to the harsh overhead light in the kitchen. I got a close up look at these before buying since a local business in town had some hanging in their store. Mine arrived on time and in good condition. I've had them a few days now and are using them every day. They are fairly bright on the highest setting and on the lowest setting are still a nice low illumination. MIne are kind of "cool white" and not yellowish. These come with a little remote about the size of a credit card. All the features on the remote seem to work just fine. There doesn't seem to be any other way to control them though WITHOUT the remote which is the only thing I don't like since it could be easy to lose that thing. The remote allows a few things like dimming the lights from 100 percent down to 10 percent. that is useful. The other remote features are the "pulsing" and "flashing" settings. the "flashing" settings were convulsion inducing and something I'd only use if it were outside on a xmas tree or something. The harsh on/off of the LED lights is almost painful in and indoor setting. On the other hand the "pulse" mode (where they slowly fade up and down in brightness) was kind of nice. only thing is I wish they'd not go completely out...I'd like it if there was a setting that would go from 100 down to 10 percent and then back up. But there's not. I won't be using any of the remote features except on/off and the dimming. THE LOW DOWN: Overall...I really like them and infact...may get some more. The feeling I was getting of "hmmm..these look like they'd be great in the kitchen" while I was THINKING about getting them is about the same feeling as when they were actually installed. That is good. If I were to nit pick on them there are a couple things.... 1. you have to have a "line of sight" to the plug end that has the Infrared remote sensor on it in order for the remote to work consistently and control the lights. So if you plug the things in behind the couch and run them up the wall...you won't be able to control them because the couch would be in the way of the remote sensor. The plug is black and has a few things sticking out of it...it's not something I'm happy to have to have exposed. 2. seems like the only way to control the lights is with the remote. That's handy..however it could get lost since it's very small. But...this is the nit picky section remember. So after 3 days of use....that's my nit picky list. I'll update if there's anything else. So far. I like.

I can no longer remember how many of these I've ordered. I use them at home, inside and out; give them as gifts, and use them as components in art projects. None of this TaoTronics has yet to fail me. This, however, is the first one with a remote control. If, like all the others, it is good quality, I'm sure it will be fine. One word of advice, the longer the string of lights, the harder it is to deal with. I would suggest that two people handle anything over 30 feet to prevent tangling and subsequent frustration.

review_title: Absolutely adorable and because of the copper wire
review_text: Product is exactly as described! Absolutely adorable and because of the copper wire, they are easy to bend and manipulate any way you want. We hung them up in our fifth wheel for ambiance. I will be purchasing another strand in the near future for outside of our camper. Very reasonably priced!

review_title: Party to Spa in a Click of a Button.
review_text: These are the coolest lights I have ever seen! They seem indestructible and wrap around anything you want it too. The many settings it has is awesome because you can go from having a strobe light party to just a soothing relaxing night and watch the lights slowing fade in and out. It has a setting for every aspect of it. It can dim it to the lowest setting, or it can be programmed to be very bright. The fade in and out setting has the option of 5, 10, 20 seconds of length in which fade cycles through. I love the fact that it has a remote too! I have mine wrapped around my heard board and when i am done reading, i set it to the fade in and out setting on the remote and breath in and out with the lights and I am out in a matter of seconds. Its impossible for me to fall asleep at nights. Iv'e tried sleeping teas, and warm baths before bed and nothing really helped and these lights are really help me relax and de-stress.

I LOVE these lights. I got them for myself and also as a gift for somebody. My friend said that these were the best gift she got all Christmas. They have a special way of making a house feel like a home. I have flowers and herbs that I dry from my garden by hanging them, so I have them hanging above my bed, and have these lights running along them. It's quite beautiful. The control is awesome, because anyone who is a string light connoisseur like me knows how annoying it is to have to unplug the lights from the outlet. Also, because they are made of wire, they can easily be shaped to hang or hook onto anything. And the different light settings, there are so many! Dimming, flashing, flashy-dims (not sure that's the best description of this setting lol), fast flashing, slow flashing, etc. Some settings are relaxing and then some make me feel like I'm in the club and should be getting ready to dance to some house music lol. Anyway, I highly recommend these lights for yourself or as a gift as there are many uses for them. If you have no use for them, make one! You won't regret it

review_title: Pretty lights, but broken remote destroys purpose
review_text: The lights are pretty and the wire makes them easy to manage, but unfortunately the remote doesn't work. We even bought a new battery, but it still didn't work so we unplugged the battery...then the lights worked!! We can't dim them, though...which was one of the reasons we picked this product over others. Fortunately, Amazon's customer service is fantastic - just one phone call and they issued us a full refund. I gave it a one-star review because although the lights work now, we can't dim them since the remote is broken, which destroys the purpose of us having bought this product. We picked this one since it had such good reviews, so sadly we must've just landed a rare defect...

I only ordered this because it was a flash deal and i knew i wanted to use something like this in my kitchen, that being said i didnt really measure anything or have a real plan it was more like I'll figure it out when i get it. Thankfully i put it up in about 10 min using a hit glue gun, and holiday light clips (see pics) i really like the fade and that I can dim brightness. Also i didnt have to stand right by the reciever to ise the remote however I didnt test how far I could use it yet. All in all I'm happy with this and feel like its a good value. If your wondering why I only gave it 4 stars, well itd great but i just dont feel like its amazing.

review_title: ... little over a year ago and they still work like new. I've been using them as fun decoration ...
review_text: I purchased these lights a little over a year ago and they still work like new. I've been using them as fun decoration lighting in my room and a substitute to my ceiling light since it is sometimes too bright. I appreciate the fact that I can just turn the string lights on and adjust the brightness with the remote. the remote recently stopped working for me (but it's always been great and never had a problem with it before) so I contacted the seller looking to see if it would be possible to pay for or receive a new one since I've been so content with the product since I bought it. I received a response almost immediately and a new remote for free! my lights are on again and I am beyond happy with this purchase and I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for string lights!

review_title: It doesn't blind you at all if you put it out in max settings which is good. However
review_text: it has stayed on for cotinously 10 months of a low dim! It doesn't blind you at all if you put it out in max settings which is good. However, the connection from the controller to the unit NEEDS to be in clear sights otherwise you wouldn't be able to adjust settings on this. The wire is very malleable! As you can see here in this picture, you can literally bend it however much you'd like. I made 3 different sized hearts and I coiled the wiring around the bed frame to give a better look for my girlfriend.

Bought these to back light christmas decorations on a wall unit. They worked great. The wire is stiff enough to stand on its own so the lights can be lightly placed on and around the decorations to give height to the lighting. We will never use all the features of the lights, but did find the dimmable feature quite helpful. LED lighting can be quite intense - dimming allows you to soften the light source in 10% increments. The light cast is more soft white than the more the harsh blue/white of some LEDs. I would not say you cannot see the copper wires, but when on they are not noticeable. I would buy these again. And just did including the multi color string Dec 2017- last years are still working great.

I bought one of these to line the stairs up to the second floor as a nightlight for my kids. I combined it with Woods 50006 Indoor 24-Hour Mechanical Outlet Timer, Daily Settings to click on at night just before bedtime and then off again when they (should!) be asleep. And then back on just before I wake them up for school. The light is soft and the dimming option is fantastic. Sometimes the remote can be a little wonky and you have to (sometimes) get real close to the receiver but it mostly behaves. Liked it so much I bought a second one for their bedroom to put along the ceiling as another night light with the same timer. No dead lights and it's holding up really well.

review_title: Really versatile lights - use your imagination!
review_text: I balled these up and inserted them into a miniature glass house with the power cord extending out the back. The lights put out almost no heat so "balling them up" in close proximity one to another has not posed a problem. I plugged the light string into a lamp timer and placed the house high on a bookshelf overlooking my kitchen. I Dimmed the lights to the lowest setting using the remote which still provides plenty of light. Now every evening the little house lights up for several hours controlled by the timer. Fortunately the light string retains the previous setting, so each evening I get to appreciate its beauty without having to turn it on and off or make any adjustments except for the twice yearly disruption of daylight savings/standard time. I haven't yet figured out how to automate that adjustment!
These are perfect!!! I bought these to put on my head board for decoration and so i can read at night. I love how you can adjust the brightest with the remote control.

review_title: Absolutely not weatherproof, not for outside use.
review_text: Despite the labeling, there is absolutely no way you can used these outside. First, the light string is concerning. Think bare 16 ga. copper wire. There appears to be no insulation on the wire at all. The wire is about as thick as a spaghetti noodle. The LEDs seem well attached and coated with some sort of plastic. The plug is a transformer combination that reduces 110v house current to 12v. Second, the controller, or controllers counting the light changing box, and the plug in transformer are not weatherproof. If you want to plug this into an outside outlet, and light a tree in your yard this set is not for you. The entire set may be weatherproof starting at the light set, but the powering unit, light changing box and transformer are all cheap, flimsy plastic that is not going to withstand any weather. Overall I do not know the quality of this set, I have returned it.

review_title: FUN, FUN, FUN! ... er, and also practical, too
review_text: I got several of these with an Amazon Lightning sale price and gave them as Christmas gifts, and since the price was right, I got one for me, too. While I don't think the supposed retail price cited is at all realistic, I do think the current Amazon price is a fair one. These babies are a nice, long string of tiny LED lights on a copper wire, so right out of the box, they're more attractive than lights on a green plastic string. My dilemma was where to put them. I finally settled on kind of massing them across the top of my headboard - the wire made it easy to wrap around the bedposts -- and I'm so happy with the result! The color is very warm, even at the lowest level; at the highest level, they're not only warm, but bright enough to read by. My husband is an early-to-bed guy, and I'm a night owl, so these lights have actually solved a practical dilemma for me. He used to hit the sack, read for a while, then turn out the lights to sleep. That left me stumbling around in the dark when I came to bed -- trying to locate my nightgown, put away my clothes, wrangle the dog into the bed, etc. Now he turns these little lights on, reads a little, then turns them down to 10% to sleep, and I actually have enough light to see by when I come in! Turns out Bob the brain-dead beagle also likes them - I thought he just liked driving me crazy by wandering all over the room at bedtime instead of just getting in the bed, but it turns out he apparently couldn't actually find the bed (I mentioned he's brain-dead, right?). Either that, or he couldn't see me scowling and waving my arms at him while I chased him around the room. Now I point to the chest at the foot of the bed and he jumps right up and onto the bed. It's a miracle! The little remote really makes it cool - love being able to dim these!

review_title: I loved how you can control aspects such as dimming and ...
review_text: I have one string of white lights and three or four of colored. I loved how you can control aspects such as dimming and flashing from the remote. I use this clear set to light up my staircase as night, on the dimmest setting. I have it set to a timer so that it automatically comes on at sundown and off at sunrise. It lights up the stairway, serving the function of a nightlight and also creates a more festive atmosphere. I also like how when stored, this string takes up minimum space and holds its form easily.

Although the remote control is not always senses by the plug-in component, that may be solved by a fresh battery. These lights can be amazingly bright and are a boon for dramatic decoration. That brightness is dimmable in increments via the credit-card sized remote control. I really like the fact that when powered switched outlet, the base unit "remembers" the previous setting. Advice: After looping one end around a cabinet knob, spend three minutes carefully unwinding the wire and stretching to full length. Then use a nearly depleted toilet paper roll, clip the end of the wire to one end of the roll. Then plug the unit in and carefully unwind and drape the wire where you want, being careful to minimize twisting.

review_title: THEse run along a very thin and BARE copper wire ...
review_text: THEse run along a very thin and BARE copper wire that is not insulated. the whole thing weighs almost nothing and could be probably be scrunched up in your fist so small that you could not even see it. Not what I envisioned at all. returned it for a refund but Amazon subtracted the return shipping cost.

They work perfectly and give a nice warm glow. Have been using these for about a year as soft lighting. I turn them on almost every night, while watching TV or just hanging out. The only thing I'd suggest is to make the fitting between the remote control sensing box and the cord a bit tighter - occasionally I'll be adjusting things plugged into the outlet and the cord will come loose. Since it's tucked behind furniture that can be a bit of a pain in the ass. Otherwise fantastic.

Beautiful tiny lights that can be dimmed in 10% increments. The wire is so delicate to make the wire almost invisible. The first go around with these I received a defective remote controller. Upon reading my negative review (which I have delete) the company immediately contacted me with suggestions for correct operation. The suggestions did not work in my case and when notified of this the company offered to send another set at no charge - didn't even ask for the return of the defective ones. These work perfectly. But, more importantly, the customer service is beyond reproach. Would buy these again. I used these lights on a large 6 ft artificial tree in my living room and the tree is very romantic at night and leaves enough subtle lighting for viewing TV, etc. Thanks again for the great customer service!! Stellar!!

review_title: This is my second order of this fantastic product. The lights are beautiful and have a ...
review_text: This is my second order of this fantastic product. The lights are beautiful and have a remove control that can dim to eight different settings, I love that they PLUG IN! If you are frustrated from changing batteries and waiting for solar lights to work then buy these. I bought my first set last year and they are in my front window.

So far I'm amazed. These are impossibly small lights strung on two thin copper wires. Just put them up today so maybe 5 stars if they last the summer. Light out put is comparable to mini bulbs. The included remote can dim or fade or even flash if you were so inclined. I put them around a canopy on the deck for mood lighting. Very pleased.

It delivers what it promises: beautiful, warm lights along a string, and a remote control that lets you make it dimmer or brighter (or, if you want, flash). My only gripe is that you can't connect multiple strings together: each one has to be plugged in separately. That definitely constrains how you set them up. Other than that, though, these are perfect. We've strung a couple of these up over some windows in an organic, haphazard way (not outlining the windows in a rectangle of light). The lights are delicate, they make the space look charming and cozy, and the wires do not look unsightly at all.

review_title: This little light of mine, really really shines!!
review_text: At first I was thinking there's no way these tiny things are going to be very effective. But when I saw them in the dark, wow! I only wish I had bought them to be a little longer since you cannot connect another string to it like with traditional string lights.However, I found just the perfect spot for them in my sunroom and we no longer need a light out there with these on. I love the remote, it doesn't work from too far away, but it is so cool to be able to change the settings of the lights whenever your mood wishes! I have received several compliments on them and I would buy again!

I've been using this product for about a week and hung the lights around my room's edges. It provides great, clear light. Although the light isn't as much a "warm white" as other string lights I've tried, these feel much more comfortable to hang in the edges of my room because they're LED and I don't have to worry about them overheating. At first, I was a little worried about touching the wire when they were plugged in because it looks like the wire is completely exposed between lights. However, there must be a thin coating on the wires because it doesn't shock. Also, the remote works great. I enjoy playing around with the settings and with different levels of light. I keep the unit plugged in the corner of my room, so sometimes if there's an object in the way, the lights won't pick up the remote's signal. I would dock a star for that, because every time I use the remote I have to try a few different angles to get it to work, but the lights look so great in my room and are otherwise very easy to use that this deserves 5 stars.

Update: these crapped out after about six months. I had two separate strands, set up in two locations on my house, and both died at almost the same time. They were pretty while the lasted... Original review: Beautiful lights that are easy to set up. The remote control was a little difficult to figure out at first until I read in other reviews that it needs to be pointed directly at the receiver. A lot of different "twinkly" options, but after playing with it for a bit I decided I like the solid lights the best so I probably won't be using the remote. They are very pretty though and I highly recommend them!

We have 3 sets of Taetronics lights in our home & another set outside on the back patio. All are wonderful, & these are my favorites for two reasons. I love the ambience of dimmable lights & the ease of the remote. I had no idea how much I'd enjoy them. I usually leave the ones in the bedroom set at 30% brightness. They're strung around a tapestry on the wall behind the bed (with a second set of non-dimmable lights strung around a tapestry on the ceiling). 30% brightness is perfect for night-time reading (since they're right near the head of the bed). Plus, for those times when you need to flip on a light at night (for doggies or humans to navigate) the brightness is super soft--and the remote is right there--a real bonus. When our doggies need to venture outside in middle of the night, these make it easier to get up (& to fall back asleep afterwards :-). Beautiful lights!

I love how bright they are. They're not a big, bulky mess to work with like traditional lights. They pack a powerful punch (as far as how much light they put off). My favorite thing about them is the ability to control them. There are different settings controlling brightness, pulse, fade, etc. The end of the wire is not able to be plugged in to or attached to any other set to lengthen them. We did twist the wire around another matching end of a different strand to get the exact length we needed to hang them under our deck. Worked well enough. We also have used two of these strings to supplement Christmas lights that have gone out on our fake Christmas tree. They are perfect for this because they're a very light strand that puts out a lot of light and they don't get hot. They saved me from the painstaking task of going through each bulb on the tree to find out where it's lost power. The copper wire and bulbs don't get hot at all so I use a shorter strand on my wooden shelves and tv stand for Christmas decor. Will buy more as needed :) love the product.

review_title: but it's fine. I do like that it is dimmable -- ...
review_text: Not quite as bright as I had hoped, but it's fine. I do like that it is dimmable -- that's been handy to have (put it on 10% brightness when getting a baby milk in the night so I don't have to blind either of us with a bright light.) My biggest grievance with it is that I can turn it on, or change a setting on it, and it will do it -- and then for some reason, I have to put the remote just inches from the receiver to get it to do anything else (And yes, there is a clear shot between the remote and receiver). I haven't pinned down a rhyme or reason for doing that. The thing is practically brand-new, so the remote battery shouldn't be dead, and it's done that from when it was brand-new a month ago. I have the thing high up, so I have to get a stool or a chair to stand on to get it close enough to the sensor to make it change. Frustrating sometimes...

I paid a little extra for these light because they come with a remote and some dimming and flashing functions. The only function I would probably ever use is the one that fades in and out, because it would create a calming atmosphere. However, it needs a bit of work on the tech side because as it fades out, the lights go out abruptly, and you end up getting more of a slow strobe-light effect. Also, 33 ft doesn't give you much flexibility on what you can use them for. I wanted to attached them to the ceiling above my bed to create a cozy atmosphere, but there wasn't quite enough length to make it look good. Other than those two issues, the lights and remote work fine.

review_title: Just What We Needed and Lovely Too
review_text: Arrived quickly and in perfect condition. This is exactly what we were looking for! We strung one string around the top of the grill gazebo - lovely light when grilling at night! Why only four stars? They should be packaged better! The lights were a tangled mess - it took 45 minutes to untangle ONE box! (Ordered two - haven't even attempted to untangle the second box, yet.) A REAL pain for someone with carpal tunnel and arthritis - like me. OUCH! ;P

review_title: Using a Belkin smart plug to turn them on an off on a ...
review_text: I have them put inside a glass vase of sorts with some fake plants sticking out on top. Using a Belkin smart plug to turn them on an off on a schedule through Smart Things hub. Seems to remember last setting every time. Only using them as a constant dim light in the entry way. Pretty nice. Have not tested them outside. The other functions were not important to me besides solid and dimmable lights so I can't comment on that. Overall happy and may purchase more when other opportunities arrive.

review_title: Neat decorative lighting solution for specialty purposes. So far no quality/durability issues.
review_text: I picked this up on sale without knowing exactly what I would use it for. We ended up using it with some cotton "snow" to go with a Christmas decorative scene. It worked very well for this purpose. The remote is a little finicky as the membrane buttons don't always consistently activate (or maybe the IR is just really weak), but for our usage, it served its purpose well enough, especially for the sale price for which I was able to buy it.

We have been struggling to find an easy, inexpensive and out of sight solution for our under cabinet lighting in our kitchen. These are the answer! So happy with the solution! Just tapped a few small nails under the cabinet fronts and wrapped the wires around the nails - totally out of view and unlike other "LED" lights - these are not the "white, bright" color - but a nice soft yellow. I really has made our kitchen lighting so nice!

I love these little lights. They’re quite bright even though the string weighs nothing. That makes it so easy to drape them over mantles and other odd-shaped items without having their weight pull them down. I also really like the remote’s ability to change the display, although the right-hand column on the remote is very hard to decipher with dark print on dark buttons. I think the instructions could explain the functions of the remote in much more detail. I certainly recommend these lights.

The lights are pretty, but they only work when they are plugged in directly to the power. I either have a faulty remote or a faulty receiver, because the lights don't turn on at all if I use the receiver to connect the lights with power. I am quite disappointed, as I bought these specifically for the remote feature. If I wanted remote-less string lights, I could have purchased the cheaper version. Others have had good reviews, but I think the remote/receiver issue is not uncommon.

Very pretty lighting. Nice that you can change brightness. Wire is very thin so you don't see it unless you're close. It seems you have to use the extra plug in tail piece for remote. Also it appears you have to hit clear button on remote between functions. Remote buttons pretty flat and harder to engage with long nails. I got the 2 that come together as it is a better price. Seems to be a good buy for the price. But very pretty at night

Love it, I wanted something that I could hang up in my room that wasn't too bright and at the same time not too dark. This was perfect. Also the fact that I could change the brightness with the remote also greatly helps as I can switch on the fly depending on the activity I'm doing. Had a bit of trouble untangling the wires of course but nothing too major. The dimmable one also comes with two other options such as a smooth fading in and out transitions and a strobe effect. The remote itself can adjust the light brightness by 10 (10,20,30, etc.) to 100, or you could just simply use the up and arrow buttons. When you turn them off they also remember the last setting you last put them on so no need to reset it every time you turn it on and back on. Not sure on the range of the remote though as my rooms somewhat small. Great love and definitely gonna add a couple more pairs to make it look even better.

I bought two boxes of the lights for the Christmas holidays and thought they would look nice draped up and down over the 2 long, narrow window blinds I have on each side of my fireplace. I expected to have the lights up in 15 mins. for each window, but it took me 30 mins. just to unravel one string of lights! It was extremely, extremely difficult and irritating to get them up, it took more than 2 hours and the next day I actually had small cuts on the top of both my hands from the wire! BUT, despite all of this, the lights did look really nice once up, the remote is handy (all the buttons aren't necessary) and it actually illuminated the room nicely.

These lights add such a nice touch to my college dorm room. The copper wire is not noticeable from a distance and looks nice up close. I love the adjustable brightness and the remote is super convenient. It took two strands to go nearly all the way around the perimeter of my dorm. Would highly recommend! Update: a few weeks later I experienced an issue with one of my two strands of lights: one would not turn on with the remote, but the other would. Since I knew it wasn't an issue with the batteries in the remote, I tried unplugging the broken strand and plugging it back in, and restarting the surge protector it was plugged into, but to no avail. I emailed the company's customer service address, and they got back to me within two days saying that they would send a new strand of lights and would not require that I send back the broken ones. A new strand of lights is on its way right now! I really appreciate the company's attentiveness and their consideration of the customer's convenience, as it would be a major hassle for me to ship the broken lights back from school. The situation was a true testament to TaoTronic's great customer service.

This is a fantastic set of lights for the price. The remote allows you a variety of lighting options and is very easy to use. This string is a perfect size to use outside on a small tree for Christmas lighting. I was very impressed by the quality of the lights themselves and of the remote.

Absolutely terrific! I lined a children's room with these. So very light weight. I hung them with sticky hooks attached every yard or so. It has a remote control to change settings from wildly blinking to a 20 second slow ebb and flow. The only caveat is that you have to take care at the start to unroll the whole thing very carefully so it doesn't get tangled. It comes very nearly packed in a roll but I messed up the start and did a bunch of pulling the whole delicate roll through this or that space to untwist it. It makes a fun evening light in the room or even as a night light. I wound some into a closet which I had emptied and turned into a fort. Makes a perfect light for this dark space. Mysterious, yet keeps it magical and not scary. It fits right into the door hinged area as its all on a tiny dual wired thread. I love them!
I bought 2 sets. One worked for less than 10 minutes, the second didn"t work at all

review_title: Good lights with a few logistical drawbacks
review_text: Pros: - These lights look great! - The remote has a lot of settings you will never use, but the dimming options are nice and offer a wide range from very soft to fairly bright. - The remotes are universal, so you can use one remote to operate multiple strands of these lights. Cons: - Each strand of lights must be connected directly to a power source. They cannot be daisy chained like some other LED lights. - The power supply gets decently hot, so this limits how they can be hidden. - The sensor for the remote is an IR sensor, which is attached to the power supply brick with a very small antenna (maybe 3 inches). This means the power supply will have to remain in line of sight with the remote. depending on your setup this may be an eye sore, and if you are using multiple strands you may have to aim the remote at each sensor to turn them on or to make adjustments to the brightness of the lights.

We have tried many string lights similar to these, and these are by far our favorites! Unlike the others we have, these plug directly into the wall. All of our other ones use batteries (we use rechargeables). What I love about these is the fact that they are dimmable AND you can turn them off without unplugging. That way I can turn them off before falling asleep if I don't want to climb off the couch or out of bed. The length of the light strand is also longer than our others, providing more light. I have found that the remote buttons require a little bit of extra pressure in order to work, but that isn't a big deal to us. In short, I definitely recommend these lights over other brands.

review_title: Remotes Did’t Work in Two Sets.
review_text: I ordered two sets, remotes did not work in both. I checked the batteries, and they were good, so it is a problem with the remote itself. Lights come on bright as soon as you plug in to outlet, no on/off or other functions available. The odds of two products, not working indicates poor quality control. I could return for a refund, and will contact the company first. But when you pay full price, you should not need to fight to get a proper working product.

review_title: Very pretty lights, easy to string up, great for decorating
review_text: The lights are actually great, they are nice and bright and when dim, it's very pretty. However, the remote that came with my set didn't work unless you held it at a certain angle to where it was plugged in, which was nearly impossible b/c my son's bed was basically covering the plug. So it made the remote pretty much useless. That's why the 3 stars, otherwise I would have given it 5. But overall, very pretty. It was easy to string up. I use it as a nightlight for my son's room and he loves it. Update (1/30/16): Was contacted by seller after review was written, they shipped me out a new remote asap, free of charge.
