Must've had a defective remote b/c all works wonderfully now. Great customer service and great product!

I bought these lights for my dorm room and they seem to be very beautiful! They have a nice soft, yet bright light to them and are able to create a very nice ambiance. The reason for my poor rating is because I cannot seem to use the remote! Despite changing the battery on the remote, the lights would not respond to any of the remote controls. I believe that this may be a result of a problem in the actual "controller" box. The lights do work when plugged in and out, but it would have been nice to use the remote option, especially because I would have liked to control the brightness of the lights. They seem to be stuck on the brightest setting :( (As you can see, the lights work perfectly fine but the controller box does not respond to the remote)

review_title: Good and long length light brightness is good to be ...
review_text: Decorate the shop windows. This is my daughter ideas. Good and long length light brightness is good to be converted. Above all, it was good because young children touch the broken tree in the window. We do not need any more tree wood. Korea is used for 220V. However, the transformer was not required.

I bought a set of these light a year ago because i work on a cruise ship and the lights in my cabin are with super bright or completely dark so these low voltage lights are perfect. They work on a remote control and they have a dimmable functions and some flashing functions. I do not use those, I just want the light on or off, but its nice to have that option. A friend bought the same type of lights and he got the white color, but I prefer the yellow color I choose. We had some power surges and my lights blew, but I have just reorder new ones. They are connected on a thin copper wire which is a great touch. I recommend these lights for small cabins or dorm rooms.

Awwww. Such a nice light string!! Can’t say it was what I wanted cause it was better than I anticipated. Not harsh or glaring, but nice soft golden light. Perfect! And the remote with it’s combinations is nice too. But I like the soft brightness of the lights. Great quality. Came back and bought a 2nd string. Even forwarded the link to a few people after the compliments the lights received! Pretty pretty!

I love this product! I didn't have a chance to do anything with it so I put them in a an empty vase on my console which ends up becoming a nice lamp with ambiance. A friend came over and loved it so much that I bought him a set and he made a similar one for his shelves. He had been looking for a small lamp and this worked perfectly. He was also excited about the remote control and dimming options. I love the copper wire and tiny lights.

These are AMAZING!!! When I ordered them, I wasn't initially inclined to buy them, but after reading all the positive reviews I decided to just go with it and I'm so glad I did. They are very good quality and an even better price. I like how long they are and I LOVE the remote. The packaging for them was also very nice. I was originally going to buy a similar product from either Urban Outfitters or Anthropologie, but it would have been much more expensive for a shorter string (not to mention the reviews weren't as good). Anyway, these lights are great quality, have a really nice copper wire and it's so convenient to have a remote with so many different settings. Very happy with this purchase and highly recommend these lights.

review_title: These lights add the perfect glow to my room
review_text: These lights add the perfect glow to my room! I bought one for my bedroom at home and a second pair for my dorm room at school. I use them almost every day, but I don't use the remote because it's a little finicky. The lights don't get hot to the touch or make my room warm. They were easy to hang up with small command strips. They are longer than I expected, but the end without the wall plug-in just dangles so I used a piece of tape to hold it down so it doesn't look weird.

review_title: beautiful warm white light with copper wire
review_text: These lights are absolutely beautiful! The copper wire and warm white light makes a perfect combination for putting in a glass vase or wrapping around greenery or just by itself laying along the mantle. I like that the copper wire gives it stability to make it stay in the desired position you want it. The remote is a nice touch but I don't really use it. Overall beautiful quality light set, I will be purchasing more!

review_title: These are great lights and very bright
review_text: These are great lights and very bright. I wrapped it around a fake tree in our living room and it looks great. The copper wire is not very visible, so this is great for anyone who doesn't want thick, obvious chords. The remote is sketchy, but it basically works. Sometimes I have to press a button several times to get it to respond. My only complaint is that if the remote stops working, there is no way to control the settings any longer. Other than that, I love these lights and might just buy more.

review_title: The best brand for warm white lights: long-lasting, great customer service.
review_text: I have purchased 5 warm white strands of lights from this company. They are great and have lasted a long time. In fact, I only look for this brand now. I wasn't a fan of the colored set, though, with just four colorst. To make up for it, TaoTronics sent me another warm white set. The colored version will be good for Christmas, but not everyday use. Their customer service is stellar. If it's warm white lights on a copper string you want, I'd definitely recommend this brand.

review_title: Worked for a very short time only
review_text: These lights looked terrific....for the week they worked. This is the second set of these lights I have bought from the same seller. The first set bought last year, stopped working after about two weeks. I replaced the battery in the remote control and still they would not turn on. I was disappointed but thought maybe I had done something. I reordered a new set this year. The same exact issue occurred. After about a week-ten days, they stopped working AGAIN! Once again, I thought perhaps the remote battery needed replacing as a few times I just turned lights on and off by unplugging and replugging. The remote didn't seem to work with the new battery and then they completely stopped working again (even when plugged and unplugged). I am so disappointed. They looked so pretty but definitely not worth it for the amount of time they worked.

I bought two sets in late November. Both are strung up by my bed (along with a multicolored set), but only one has gotten substantial use. When I plugged the multicolored string in last night, it was noticeably brighter than the one I've been using. I just tried the second warm-white one and it's also noticeably brighter than the one I've been using. Before I tried this I did think the string had gotten dimmer, I just chalked it up to me being wrong. Now having compared it to two strings from the same brand, it is much dimmer than when I bought it. To its credit, when I say 'substantial' I mean it, I've had the one string going almost constantly. But I also thought that led lights lasted longer than a few months. I don't know if it's the brand or what, but I guess I learned a lesson

I like these lights. They are very delicate and come wrapped around a cardboard tube so you have to be careful when setting them up. The remote control has lots and lots of buttons but really you just need to turn these on and off. With the remote you can make the lights flash at different speeds and fade out if you want. I bought a pack of Command Decorating Clips to help hang these up.

I bought two sets and plugged them in to check them out when I received them Friday. They both lit up, great! Then Sunday when I hung one set and went to turn them on they would not turn on! Luckily after reviewing it, Paco from Customer Service contacted me and is sending me a replacement set of lights. I was happy with there quick response. He also assured me that the faulty adapter box was a rare occurrence... so they send me a replacement and it's an obviously used light set that showed up in a mess of wires with knots in the copper, which you can't undo. Thanks for showing me your true colors. Buyer beware.

review_title: Arrived on time and looks like the photo
review_text: Arrived on time and looks like the photo. Was mailed from main land China. Arrived ahead of time, and quickly. Works very well, no weight to it at all. No instruction provided. Wires are very thin and could brake easily. Also would advise to place in clear tubing to last longer. Wire only have a clear coating of lacquer. Wonderful inside lighting idea. Will use outside for Halloween and take back in that same night.

review_title: So cute, lots of features, & good price!
review_text: These lights are awesome! I thought they were too good to be true for only $16 or so. I bought them to hang in my dorm room, I just weaved them around tacks in the wall in a cute zig-zag pattern. They look so great, & my friends all wanted to know where I got them. They give me bright enough light to read or do homework by without being harsh; the glow is so warm and comfortable that I could leave them on while sleeping if I wanted to. The copper wire is pliable enough to wrap around tacks or nails, yet stiff enough that it will stay put and hold its shape. Lights & wire never get warm/hot, even after being left on for hours. The remote works great, didn’t require any extra batteries or anything, works right out of the box. It has tons of features; fade in/out on different time cycles, flashing different speeds, and 10 brightness settings. I like that I can always leave them plugged in and just use the remote to turn them on/off, unlike a lot of other string lights, which you usually have to unplug to turn off. The lights are bright and have a warm, inviting glow. I would buy these again and again if I had more space for them!

Perfect for my use: illuminating the interior of an outdoor gazeebo. The brightness (2 strings) and color of the light are ideal (to me), bright enough to read by and see other people but not so bright as to make it difficult to see out, and unobtrusive enough that they practically disappear once installed. We also usually have a fire going in ours. If you're looking for real working illumination, for a party or something, these would make a nice accent but probably wouldn't suffice for a primary light source. However for accent or a bit of supplemental light give these a shot.

review_title: Fun lights that give a warm glow
review_text: Pros: - Easy to shape and wrap around every surface - Each bulb is tiny and gives just enough light but isn’t super bright - Power cord is long enough for most situations - Wire are thin enough they kind of disappear Cons: - Remote control needs line of sight to make it work - The lights are just coiled up when they come and it is very easy to tangle them I really like these lights – I got them to wrap around my headboard to give the bedroom a light glow and for that they worked perfectly. The lights are tiny bulbs on a pretty thin copper wire that just came as a coil and wasn’t wrapped around a wheel so I did get them tangled a bit when I was putting them on but the thin wires allow you to wrap the light around pretty much anything and the copper wires hold the shape. Thirty Three feet ends up being pretty long for my headboard and I might have preferred using a shorter set of lights. It took me a little bit to figure out that the remote needed line of sight and so you have to have the remove sensor somewhere you can point at it which makes it a little less convenient. However, once you point the remote at the sensor it works quite well and the lights give a lovely warm glow when they are turned on. The remote has a number of modes the light can go through but I just leave them on at 50% power. Overall I am very impressed by this light set and I have been looking for other projects to install these lights in other locations.

We put these lights up in our daughter's room over a year ago and they are still working great. Extremely cute light for her room. You can change for a brighter light to a dimmer light all with the click of a remote. They feel a little flimsy when you first use them as they are not your typical "Christmas lights" but they are extremely durable and easy to put up. I highly recommend.
Love it! I used it to wrap my coat stand for a party and it looks amazing!!

I like how the lights turn on and the remote works but the connection between thelights and where you connect to the power supply does not work properly I have to keep moving it around so that is will turn on and stay on. It seems loose. I have placed it strategically so that it doesn’t turn off on me and placed it on a mirror. Love how it looks just wish the connections didn’t wiggle.

Love these lights. My favorite part is how you can’t really see the wire when the lighting is dim, and how the wire/apparatus doesn’t draw too much attention during daytime when it isn’t lighted. These are classy enough to put in our living room. The remote is a convenient touch and we’re looking forward to trying out the flashing lights when we have a party ;-). Great lights!

review_title: The batteries were easy to insert and the pack doesn't heat up even ...
review_text: They're small but bright. When I first opened it I thought that this was not going to work at all. After turning them on I was impressed with the brightness and the colors. My 10 grandson loves them. He has it on a different color every night. The batteries were easy to insert and the pack doesn't heat up even after being on for some hours. I don't know how long they'll last but we'll enjoy them while they do.

review_title: Lights Look Great, Remote Not the Best
review_text: These lights are nice and exactly what I was looking for to string in my hanging canopy. However, the remote control that came with them is not great. The buttons work sporadically and only if you press them very hard. The sensor also only seems to pick up the signal if you are standing about three feet from it, so not sure how well this would work if you had them hanging somewhere where you couldn’t get that close. Kind of defeats the purpose of having a remote if you have to walk across the room to use it. Haven’t seen any other reviews posted with this issue though, so maybe I just got a faulty one!

review_title: 5 hours wasted stringing the wires up
review_text: I strung these lights along my outdoor balcony and kept the receptacle and connections dry. Within 36 hours they stopped working. 1.5 hours wasted stringing the wires up. Total fail. **Update** TaoTronics contacted me shortly after I posted this review and notified me that they would be sending me a brand new set of lights and a new remote with no need to ship back the old set. Turns out the module must have been faulty, I swapped in the new module for the original and they worked. Lets see what happens when it rains again. **Update: module must become faulty after just a few weeks, it failed again after this winter and now no longer works.

Was worried about durability, but they've now been used daily for over a month and I feel I've more than gotten my money's worth back in joy from these lovely lights. Less than twenty bucks, super long, with a remote, dimmable? Lightweight, bendable, easy to install? Great deal! Everyone comments on how nice they look. Was only going to keep them up in the kitchen for Xmas but we love them so much they're going to stay until they die. My autistic son yanked on them and half pulled them down and they survived without a problem. I like to use them rather than the overhead light in the evening. Who knew my kitchen could feel romantic? (Note: photo is of 1 strand)

So pretty! This Christmas, instead of carefully winding lights through our garland, I draped this very light garland down the staircase in about 15 seconds (the previous winding of lights would have been an hour), and the look was magical. And the best part? I didn't have to climb the stairs every night to unplug the lights. I just pointed the remote and clicked! TaoTronics, Thank you! The lights are lovely and the copper wire delicate; the result was breathtaking. I'm ordering more to use this summer for parties in the back yard and for an upcoming wedding. Maybe I'll just leave this out year round. They are really lovely.

These lights were bright, the issue I had was with the controller, I want to press a button and select the mode I want, not multiple buttons to approximate what I'm looking for. I would suggest 1 button pressed multiple times to select the desired mode, ie: wave, slo glow, sequential, steady-on etc. These lights were used indoors, not sure if they are meant or could stand up to outdoor use.

Very happy with this product for the price. I just got to hanging this up this week and they are very easy to deal with. Can be bent and manipulated any which way you need so they could be used for many different things! Quite bright for how little the lights are but yet so many modes as well, you can dim them to almost any brightness you like, you can strope them, flash them, or have them fading. I took away one star because the remote can is quite touchy. I haven't figured out the distance, but no matter where you are you have to be pointing it just right for it to work. I guess if you are changing the mode often this could be a big turn off but as I will probably just have them on most of the time it won't affect me much. If this was helpful at all please hit helpful below. Thank you!

review_title: I would like a refund but do not want the hassle of ...
review_text: I would give no stars if i could. We tried thes twice. The second time my son smelled smoke and they were burning! I would like a refund but do not want the hassle of shipping something that caught fire in children's bedroom. My husband and I put them up so all was meant to be safe.

review_title: Love em!!! Nice control of pattern and brightness.
review_text: Love these lights, lots of control over pattern and brightness via remote. The first set I received did not work but the seller/Amazon took care of the refund fast. The next set have worked great. I use them at a low setting on top of an entertainment cabinet to keep my living room lighted at nights so my dogs can navigate around the darkness. Have had zero problems and am going to purchase more with thoughts of using these outdoors during Christmas time. I can only guess since they are LED they use very little electricity.

Not worth the money. I purchase them, used them once at Christmas and noticed a connection issue with the lights. tried them again for a Memorial day party and the single light that worked burned when we tried to get the entire strand to connect again. I will say: when it did work it was awesome. I think Quality is an issue with the soldering of the LED's.

review_title: Worth the price to change the look of your space.
review_text: I used these light to accent an otherwise daunting space. While a family member had to be in the hospital for a very long period of time, we wanted to make the space inviting and decided to use the dimming lights. It was so worth it! They are easy to put in place and the dimming feature really is versatile that it can be used for just about anything. Definitely worth the investment.

I love that these come with a remote, I bought these for a canopy for my bed in master bedroom. The lighting is perfect and there are different settings, I would probably only use the solid one, but I do need to two of these to realy finish it. So I will be ordering another one. The conns , when I got it, it is copper wire. Which is good that it's thin, but we I took it out of the package I notice one part was intertwined in the middle of the copper wiring, from there they do tangle extremely easy . So that was a mess. Hopefully these last . I have high ceiling so redoing and paying for them again does not sound appealing . Other than that once untangled they are really nice.

review_title: No more battery hassles; remote control a plus.
review_text: I like these 'fairy' lights very much. They're plug in, which eliminates having to replace batteries, yet with the remote control option which makes turn on/turn off very easy. Reminder; the remote has the little plastic security tag which MUST be removed or they won't work with the remote. I've now ordered several more sets as little gifts for friends. They have a long guarantee so fingers crossed. So far so good,

review_title: Adds a soothing ambiance to any room!
review_text: These lights are so pretty!! They are a lot longer than I thought, which is great - we hung them around our curtains/curtain rod just above our bed. The lighting is so much softer than our lamps. I also love that you can dim and choose optional blinking lights. These would make a great alternative to a night light in a child's room. The remote is great for when we're already in bed - just make sure you have the sensor within reach to make sure it's easy to turn on/off.

review_title: They are dainty on a really tiny wire but put out a pretty bright light
review_text: This was my first of two purchases of these from Tao Tronics. They are dainty on a really tiny wire but put out a pretty bright light. They seem a little fragile while handling but I never broke them. I was very careful and used stright pins with a circle hook twisted on one end to hang them right where the wall meets the ceiling line. If you hang them right and keep them tight as you go you won't even notice them durning the day. Great mood lighting and make even a better night light. Very little power consuption.

I purchased this item about two weeks ago. I started using it a couple days ago for my apartment. Everything was working fine until the remote all of a sudden stopped working. I cant even turn the lights on because I operate it via the remote. I am extremely disappointed because I absolutely loved these lights. I wish they were better quality. Hoping that the seller will contact me and send me a new one.

Bought this and some moss to breathe some life into a "Charlie Brown" tree. Love how you can bend the wiring into place. Was perfect for wrapping around the branches. Took a long time and patience, but in the end, it looks awesome. One of those memorable Amazon purchases. Dimmable, strobe feature, great price and Prime Shipping. Highly Recommended!

These lighting effects are great. I wish I could post my results here. What I love about them is that you can't see them during the day, but they are so wonderfully bright at night. The one thing that I wish that they could do is plug into each other. They can't. So for each set, you have to plug them into a separate plug. But it is still doable. And you'll be the best comment of your neighborhood.

review_title: Simple. Beautiful. Generous length and Water resistant too!
review_text: I just put these up yesterday and they're simply gorgeous - literally: Beautiful simple design that has versatile settings for brightness and effects (strobe, fading in and out...). The remote control allows you to even program the cadence of the light effects, and 33 FEET of LED water resistant lights are awesome!

review_title: Very very cool lights with remote
review_text: These are very cool lights. Easy to install and easy to. You have to be careful installing because it's thin copper wire but once it's installed it's good to go. I had no problems installing it thru several tight openings, through and across several bends.

My sixteen year old daughter hung these lights in her bedroom over a year ago. They're not as bright as they once were, but that's to be expected. She used mini command hooks and they worked beautifully. I like the bright copper wire. Honestly, 33 feet is a whole lot of string lights; there's plenty to work with. The shipping was super fast and the price was certainly right.

review_title: Great company response to a problem, thank you!
review_text: We loved the first set of these lights, purchased last year, however the remote went crazy and we could not control them. We changed the battery and that did nothing. We did like them for most of the time we had them and ordered these to try another set. We'll let you know if these work longer and better. They are under the roof on an outdoor porch, so are protected quite a bit from the weather. Update! After posting this we got an email offering to replace for free because first set the remote must have been defective. Free replacement quickly received.........this vendor is the best!

review_title: 33ft 100 LED String Lights Dimmable with remote control
review_text: I draped these lights around one side of our dining room and china cabinet for a little New Year's Eve dinner sparkle. They look so pretty, and I'll likely leave them up way past the New Year! The remote control works well to switch them off and on easily. They are simple to unroll and use, and I definitely recommend them to sparkle up a room, area or event!

review_title: I love these lights! Great buy!
review_text: These lights work great and look great. I bought one for each of the kids to decorate as night lights in their rooms and they can control the intensity of the light or the function (my daughter likes them to twinkle). I also have them in my entry way behind my giant mirror and they look great. People compliment us all the time. I love that they have a multiple control settings so I can make them blink during our annual Christmas party or 4th of July.

review_title: ... they gave my Christmas tree life and Vibrance looks good and the remote gives you the options of different ...
review_text: Well I must say I was out of Christmas lights and around my way Christmas is celebrated very truthfully so I didn't have any lights or they didn't have any lights that I could buy so I look these up and they work very well they gave my Christmas tree life and Vibrance looks good and the remote gives you the options of different flickerings settings but you must be careful because it is still copper wire but still a good product I'll

I ordered these to decorate the front desk at work and so many staff members/attorneys asked me to send them the link so they could order their own because they looked so nice. I ended up ordering two additional strands for my own Christmas tree at home - unfortunately one came with some lights malfunctioning and in the wrong color. I wasn't going to make a big deal out of it (that's just not my style) but the seller contacted me asking how the order was and if service could be improved. I told them about the lights and they didn't hesitate to apologize, send me replacement lights, and didn't make me return the malfunctioning ones. Talk about excellent customer service! Now my tree is bight and merry, the lights are so light-weight that we can put more ornaments/decorations than ever before, and my family is happy. Thank you TaoTronics - I would definitely recommend!!

What you can't tell from the product description or photos is that the cable and plug are black - unfortunate since my trim is white and this will stand out and look ugly. The wire really is copper colored, just like it looks in the product photo. You can see in my photo that it plugs into a standard outlet. There's another connection but I can't tell what it is - not a mini usb.

review_title: Perfect mood lighting for my bar
review_text: The secretary I'm using as a bar needed mood lighting. Obviously. I ran these behind the shelves and they add a perfect warm glow. A couple of quirks. Each shelf has 2 loops of lights because they don't get very bright, but it worked well for my needs. The remote needs to be able to see the receiver. I hid the receiver below a shelf, so I have to aim the remote into the opening at waist level.

These are kinda awesome. The dimmer is fun. There are other functions I haven't played with, but I like the atmosphere with the dim lights. I have these outside and I like that during the day the copper wire looks pretty in the sun. The only reason I knock off one star is that the remote needs to be within a foot of the cord to work. Its more like an external switch. But having the remote is handy because the outlet I have it in, isn't very accessible, so it does save me the hassle of unplugging it. I got these when they were on some crazy sale on the deal of the day page. definitely an impulse buy, but totally worth it. Not sure if at the time I would have paid 20, but I am definitely $20.00 worth of happy.

These little lights are a great alternative to the larger traditional Christmas tree lights. I only bought one string to try it out and am now ordering a second string. My Christmas tree is 7' tall and not real wide. One string is not enough. I am ordering Amazon 1-day so I have them before Christmas! There are multiple settings, dimming and flashing. You can control them all with the remote. One slight drawback, you have to be close to the transmitter to use the remote. Not a real problem. And maybe when the next string comes I will place the transmitters in a different place. Merry Christmas everyone!!

review_title: Just what I needed, Just in time.
review_text: Did exactly what I expected it to. Bought it just in time for the holidays and hooked it up to the patio. Definitely made the house 'blend in' with all the holiday decor around. My favorite parts of it was how easy it was to basically take down and store away. I was not in a wiry mess that I otherwise was in before. Rolled it up quickly and stashed it in that box that comes out during the holidays. The remote is a huge plus and all the lights I had before had the controls attached to the wiring itself. Pretty awesome, will definitely buy more length to extend decoration this year :)

review_title: Delightful product and first class customer service!
review_text: These lights are great for special events or just fun decor. I gave two sets as Christmas gifts and they were a huge hit. On a side note, one of the gift recipients mentioned a wire broke when she was uncoiling the strand and only half the lights were working. I contacted the seller and they immediately responded and replaced the set.

These are great! I bought them to replace the year round Christmas lights in my living room around the windows so it would look a little less like a dorm and a little more like a house- but still have the charm of lights! The color is really nice- a true 'warm white' and not that yellow color you can get sometimes with warm white LEDs. The remote control is convenient and the thin wire is nice. I scoffed at the reviews and discriptions that said the wire was invisible before I bought this. It's not invisible- but it sure blends in well!

The string has a different look than a lot of others that I have seen. The lights work well and are fairly bright. Surprisingly, I found the string to be very durable. We reinstalled ours in a few different locations (indoors and outdoors), and they held up just fine. I don't use the remote controller. Tried it. Works okay. Line of sight is a bit fussy. But, even without the remote, I still think the string light is worth the money.

review_title: Lights are much more white than shown in product photos
review_text: I'd just like to encourage anyone who orders these to turn them on before you spend a lot of time mounting them. I made the mistake of mounting them first and afterwards I was sad to see they were not the warm golden hue as depicted in the product photos. The lights I received are much more white. Another disappointment was learning the remote only works when it's within a few feet of the receiver. Even though these don't cost much I had higher expectations. Edit: Added an extra star for good customer service. Still just wish the product photos displayed the true color.

The string of lights is fine, but what annoys me is their belief that they last outdoors, because they don't. I've bought at least half dozen different brands of these same lights and each one will fail after a few weeks outside, rain or shine, hot or cold. I'm not buying them anymore. I gave them two stars because they work indoors.

review_title: Not as warm as I had hoped.
review_text: THey are nice and easy to use, but beware the color temperature is way colder than in the pictures. If you are going for a warm orange light (like in the pictures) you will be a bit disappointed.

I bought these for my room a few years ago and I still use them today. I really like how it comes with a remote control so if I am working I can make really bright to make my dorm room more bright so I can focus while working. If I am lounging in bed, I can make it dimmer. Personally, I don't use the other options like the different flashing, only the dimming function which is practical. I really like these because they don't look tacky and the remote makes it easy to use. Other string lights are inconvenient because they are a pain to unplug or find the switch when there might not be an outlet in a convenient area.

review_title: Great product - used on a model sailboat.
review_text: We doubled up the string on a 3ft long model sailboat with a 40 inch mast. All electronics and remote features work perfectly. The thin copper wires are strong and LED lights sturdy. We plugged the unit in a receptacle controlled by a wall switch. The light settings (i.e. brightness level etc) are retained when turned off and on. A definite five stars if strings were also available with lights spaced closer together, for example 1 or 2 inches apart.

I'm a light person. Rabid. Used to climb on my 2 story..1000 white stars...5 foot ..you name it. That's not including the minimum. Got divorced..gave it all awayHere I am. Saw these. What's a woman to do??? They're lovely!!! Classy, and a song in my heart. Reviews point to suppliers who will replace them if they break MY heart...or yours..So..I'm putting 3 of these on a bush up front in the Condo.in a place noone will trip over the cord....or I'd put them EVERYWHERE!!!!!!

review_title: Great for dorm rooms and small apartments!
review_text: I love these little lights. They're long enough to wrap around my dorm room and add just the right touch to it. They range in brightness which is nice and I love all the settings that they come with. Once they're lit up the copper wire is hardly visible from the other side of my room and it is really easy to bend and shape making the process of putting them up easy. I put these lights up with the command hook light clips and only used 4. The package was small and the lights were very easy to set up. They look great in my room and are probably one of the best decorations I have ever had.

review_title: Very bright. I bought these as I made a ...
review_text: Very bright. I bought these as I made a wine bottle chandelier for my daughter. After purchasing I found some that were battery operated. I thought, "Great, now I don't need to run a cord to the outlet!" We used the battery operated lights for not even 2 weeks. My daughter only used the lights occasionally for those 2 weeks and not once, but twice, the batteries became corroded and began to leak. I'm glad I had purchased these first as I immediately swapped them out and have not had a problem since. Fantastic!!!!!!!

First some backstory. Originally I ordered these for my girlfriend, she does not like bright LEDs or halogen lights. The adjustable nature of these is what turned us on to them. So we decided to make the purchase. Few days later we received the item (horrid packaging) the wire was all twisted and worse yet they did not work. I emailed the TaoTronics straight away, had an emailed repsonse in under 12 hours with an apologie and news that they would ship me another ( after providing my addy and order information) within 24 hours and wait 3-5 days for delivery. Move ahead until yesterday, I received the lights, packaging this time was wonderful took 30 seconds to open and unwind the lights, they worked straight away and look wonderful mounted at 70℅ intensity. Great customer service, prompt customer service. I would ( and plan to) buy additional strings of these.

review_title: Remote not living up to expectations.
review_text: GOOD: Lights are what they are advertised to be, nice warm color and easy to work with. We will see how they fare through a WI winter. BAD: I too had issues with the remote. Luckily it works, but only when less than 1" from the IR receiver. In the process of getting a new battery - hoping that is the only issue, but since these are set up outside under my deck I don't enjoy having to walk out there to turn them on and off. After all, I paid the extra to get a remote! -2 Stars.

review_title: Good looking lights, but remote has inadequate OFF button.
review_text: Lights look good but the remote OFF button doesn't turn the lights off unless it is in direct line with the white adapter and is less than 2 feet away. Very inconvenient. The ON button works fine up to 15 feet away. Typically, with cheap products, something does not work or work right and that held true again this time. Usually, I do not buy cheap products but wanted to experiment at a low cost just to see how it the lights looked. I got what I paid for. PS: After reading my review, the light maker emailed me with an offer to replace the remote.

review_title: I don't feel like you can dim them as well as you'd like
review_text: I bought these a month ago. They put off a lot of light. I don't feel like you can dim them as well as you'd like. My wife and I were still playing with them and trying to find the best thing to do with them. They just stopped working. We think maybe our cat chewed the wire. Because something was disconnected. We did a lot of troubleshooting to try and get them working again. No dice. I don't know if it's a faulty product or silly cats. I guess we won't know unless we buy more. For $16 though. I can probably find something similar and cheaper.

These lights are very, very cool. I got one set and wrapped it around my banister above my stairwell in the foyer. They are beautiful. I have ordered 2 more sets. They do not get hot at all. They have many features. You can dim them, program them to come on bright and then dim in a cycle. You can do several different types of flashing patterns and you can even control the speed of the flashes. The feature are really amazing. This is a bare copper wire, it is not to be used outdoors but it is flexible and you can bend it or wrap it loosely. Just so may possibilities.

review_title: Very nice lights. I like having a remote control to ...
review_text: Very nice lights. I like having a remote control to adjust them. Hopefully they will last longer than the cheap lights I had been using. Only thing that would make them more appealing to me is if they had a button to increase and decrease brightness.

review_title: I got said product and everything was fine, until I went to put up the lights
review_text: I got said product and everything was fine, until I went to put up the lights. When I did so I found out that only about 15 bulbs lit up due to a break in one of the wires.

review_title: The best option - a fabulous price for a lot of lights
review_text: I love these lights! They're the best price I've found for the product; I've looked at stores and only 15 feet of lights is often the same price, if not more than these 33 foot ones. I really appreciate the remote to turn them on and off and that you can adjust the brightness, have them fade, or if you're crazy you can make them strobe. I like the copper color of the metal strand and they flex and bend so easily it makes it quite easy to put them up. I first only bought one of them but after I got them and really liked them, I went back and bought three more of them to give to friends/family and everyone loves them. These are wonderful, a great price for the amount you're getting, and I highly recommend them!

Update: as of 6/14, just a few days after requesting a replacement, a new set of lights was on my doorstep in perfect working condition. The seller was eager to make good on the warranty! Hopefully these will hold up longer than nine months for me. -- The lights were just fine for the first nine months I had them. I just hung them around the ceiling of a room and they were perfectly functional. Now, they suddenly won't turn on most of the time, and if they do turn on they flash quickly and won't return to the solid, continuous light I'd had them on since I got them. I will be requesting a refund or replacement and will update here with the outcome.

These lights are amazing. I was completely skeptical from the size of the packaging to the size of lights etc... However, these are fantastic. They are bright and dimmable. They are easy to mount since they are so light. They are quite beautiful. Three months later the lights stopped working. The power plug is very hot and the lights no longer work. They were great while they lasted.

review_title: Really like the lights, but the cast is not warm . . .
review_text: I really like these lights, tiny and bendable, easy to install. Like that I can dim them. The reason I am not giving them four stars is that the color is a bluish cool cast, not a warm cast as the picture would lead one to believe. Even so, I still like them, but I will continue to try and find the same type of dimmable light, but with a warm cast.

I love lighting and this is a fun/cool/something different product, and far less tacky than the indoor Christmas lights I leave up too long. As noted by some reviewers, the lights are very bright. DO get the dimmable with remote control. For a few dollars more you can adjust the intensity and perform lighting tricks as well. The small lights come on a string of copper wire. It adds visual interest to a room.

Nice lights, time consuming but reasonably easy to place around a tree. But we ordered 2 sets, and the power supply on one blew after just a week or two. Since I didn't want to take down the lights, I had little choice but to buy a third set for the power supply, which has worked fine. The remote controls work very inconsistently, and so I have recently just bypassed them and operate the lights from a switch (can't get the special effects, of course).

I absolutely love these lights! I wish I could rate this with more stars. I love how there are so many different settings. I can control the brightness, flashing speed if I want them to flash, or even a steady glow. I forget to turn them off over night or during the day when I am not home so I like the fact that they don't get hot, so I can leave them on for hours. I will definitely be buying many many more of these to create some ambiance throughout my house and brighten up dark areas. These are a must buy!

review_title: I LOVE these lights I was shopping around for something to ...
review_text: I LOVE these lights I was shopping around for something to light up my room without it being too bright and these lights are so perfect. They have a dimmer with 10 different shades from supper nice and almost romantic to pleasant and bright enough to do my homework in bed. So peaceful and I love the vibe. I wasn't sure how the copper would look my my black room but when they are off they are literally invisible but one they are on they twinkle like stars. They are a perfect mix of cool and warm light and they have so many settings on the remote. I would def recommend.

review_title: These work great! Very beautiful and the remotes settings for different ...
review_text: These work great! Very beautiful and the remotes settings for different brightness levels is a cool touch. I just wish that I would have bought two instead of one, and I also wish that the string wouldn’t become so easily tangled— you must be very careful when in raveling it when it comes out of the box. Still, would recommend!

11/2017- I bought these 1 1/2 yrs ago but put them in the closet and forgot about them. I just used them this Thanksgiving. I loved the lights and the dim able remote but when I took them down and tried to reuse them they wouldn’t work. I emailed the company just to tet them know but did not expect any response. They contacted me immediately and offered to replace them and I received them in 2 days! I wish there were more companies like this.

Update: the company replaced the lights and i am pleased with the results. Updated my review to reflect this. Great light set, still more white then yellow. I guess i had a bad string of lights as these copper strings stayed together. Highly recommend especially since you are in control of the brightness! Beware! These are bright white lights , not golden yellow as it looks. Light are good otherwise, but I am still returning them I forgot to add that the copper string was coming apart.

review_title: They love them and I can dial in just the right ...
review_text: Used these in the kids room as a night light. I put them under the bed so not only do they light up like a night light, there also aren't anymore monsters under the bed because now we can see under there. They love them and I can dial in just the right brightness. I run them at about 40% power for night light operation and 100% when the kid just wants a light. All the buttons on the remote make it easy to switch between different brightness levels. Perfect for me, and they don't get hot.

Price was reasonable to an extent that even though I had replaced the battery in the remote after finding out that is not working my lights still have not turned on at all after replacing the battery in the remote control my box is totally fine and everything but my lights just won't turn on so the downside to this is that I spent 14 almost $15 on a string of lights that did not even work even after replacing the battery
These were awesome decors at home

review_title: These string lights were nice for the time that they lasted
review_text: These string lights were nice for the time that they lasted. They had an overall great look and I loved all the features. However, sadly the remote only worked from a specific angle. Then, around 4-5 months in, they just stopped working, I thought they unplugged but then quickly realized that they just completely died. Very sad since I was very happy with the product at first, but I expected them to work for longer.

I bought 2 sets, One we have turned on about 10 times works ok, the other was only turned on twice, the power supply dies, no green light, no power out, very unhappy about that, Update: 1/27/17. Company took care of this right away, very professional, great Customer Service, thanks for the help

Bought this as a gift for my sister. It's unique. She hooked up the lights in the patio and its eye-catching. It has a bright yet subtle appearance. She said she had a little trouble unwinding it. I initially told her to be careful after reading some of the reviews here. She hasnt setup the remote yet.

it is surprisingly long and the thin wire is great for wrapping around pushpins. You have a lot of settings to choose from (blinking, smooth transitions and different levels of brightness). Only thing is that you have to point the remote exactly at the box at the end and it needs to be relatively close to recognize it but that isn't that big of an issue for the way I have it placed.

review_title: the length of the copper strands with the tiny lights is very long and easily manipulated. However
review_text: These are lovely decorative lights which can be used almost anywhere...within reach of an electrical outlet. The multi-functional remote can vary the effects of the lights in a multitude of ways to set the mood; the length of the copper strands with the tiny lights is very long and easily manipulated. However, the electric cord for the lights is long (helpful) and it's black, therefore difficult to camouflage (not helpful). I may look for a solar/battery powered string similar to this one (I do really like it) for use outside, if there is such an item.

Very neat item. Everything works well and provide light from dim to bright. Used them on top (hidden of course) of kitchen cabinets to provide accent lighting on decorator items. With very high ceilings, there is a space of about 2 1/2 feet that until now was dark. These lights provide just the right amount of light to add some drama and ambiance. Just be careful when unwinding as you can get them tangled up pretty easily.

Nice lights for the steps to the basement audio-video room. Lights are adjustable so I can dim them when the show comes on, and turn them up at the end credits. The only negative is the remote doesn't seem to want to work every time, needing just the right angle/ distance to change the lights. mounting on pliable cooper wire makes installation a snap. Update... 6/2016. I have been so happy with the first set of lights, that I ordered another, and they work just as great. May get more for the holidays!

review_title: Small, elegant but very functional and bright LED light string.
review_text: This LED light string was a perfect fit for our accent tree in our cabin. The soft white light was not the bluish, white lights that is found with many LED lights. And unlike many of the LED light strips, the connecting wire acted as an accent with the lights. Great product.

These are freaking awesome especially for the price! Easy to set up, the wiring is very flexible so you can mold it to whatever shape you like, and the wiring is invisible! I set it up with my daughter's canopy to create a reading corner. I love the different options you get with the controller too. I love them!!

review_title: I love how it looks and the dimming effect
review_text: Very cute! I hung them around my bed! I love how it looks and the dimming effect. Perfect for settling down before bed without the overhead light shining too brightly Edit: ordered a second set for my friend and she loves them !

OK, I just installed this light string on my deck. Seems to work OK for me, once I untangles the mess it was in. Unfortunately the remote barely works. It will turn on (most of the time) but will not turn off. Not a problem for me because I leave it turned on and the times it is attached to turns it back on. However, none of the other buttons work: no dimming, etc.Fortunately, I do not need them to.Only been installed 2 days. Rained last night so I will see if it really is weather proof. Update: Upon my review the seller contacted me immediately and fast shipped me a new set of lights and remote. They work perfectly. After 5 inches of rain they seem to be very weather proof as well. Great seller who stands behind their product. Would buy from again. Thanks! 5 Month Update! Ok they died on me. I wanted all to know these lights lasted about 5 months and then quit working. When I removed them I noticed why. The portion that plugs into the wall was full of water. They are not sealed at all and should not be advertised as outdoor lights. The plugs have a gap in the plug that lets water in.

review_title: Not as pictured or yellow/warm - read review for notes
review_text: This is definetly not yellow or amber/warm hued yellow as pictured, but rather traditional white/cooler light. Just a heads up - also as others have mentioned but is worth noting again, they don't connect or link up. Wish the photo were more accurate...

review_title: Exactly what I was looking for
review_text: These lights are exactly what I was looking for. I wanted lights for the headboard of my bed to add something to the decor of the room and provide some reading light at night. These are perfect! The look very pretty, with the copper wire, and are plenty bright. The brightness is also adjustable with the remote, which is a feature I like. I would definitely purchase these again.

review_title: This could be a new addiction for me...
review_text: Panic at first, when I opened the box and plugged them in without unrolling the coil, and already the light was cutting in and out, like there was a short. However, the connection just weren't tight out of the box -- and honestly, I think the connection could be a little firmer, but the lights are working great now! Four stars instead of five because of this reason, plus I feel the little white box part of the wiring should be black, to match the cords. What you have is a black cord plugging into the wall, connected to a white box and cord, connected to another black cord. These cords/connectors should all be black, for consistency. The white connection really stands out. I used these lights to light up my fireplace garland, and there's no way to hide the cord the way I'm using the lights. That said, I'm in love with these lights! I can think of a hundred other ways to use them; they're so cute and easy to use! The box and packaging are also very high quality, which makes me want to wrap a bunch of them up to keep on hand for last-minute gifts. They just have that luxurious special feeling when you open the box, almost like opening a box of jewelry -- good things come in small packages!

If you could only daisy-chain them! Yes, the literature states this limitation clearly. Yes, I bought them anyway. One can dream right? Other than that, the cool patterns work nicely - and the lights are super bright, and also easy to bend and shape around things. I tested the waterproofness too and I'm happy to say indeed they are. Good product.

Great customer service, my first set broke literally moments after plugging in. I returned to Amazon. The company checked in via email on me and I told them what had happened and they sent me a free set on their own. This set works and I have them up for Xmas decor and I love them.

review_title: Love these - great for an addition to a gift bag or stock up now for stocking stuffers!
review_text: I had bought this item before and loved it. I accidentally purchased a different brand and it was not nearly as nice and had no remote, no dimming, and no different light functions. So, I purchased these again and they were as good as before. I use them in various decorations. I tried to show it in some photos.

review_title: The remote is awful. It only works (occasionally) from an inch away and the customer support does not reply to any messages.
review_text: The lights themselves are decent enough, but the remote barely works. It has to literally be touching the receiver to do anything and even then it works on around 1 out of every 10 or so button presses. I've tried buying a new cel battery, but it didn't help. UPDATE: SunyvalleyTek were very friendly and helpful as far as refunding me for the defective remote.

Update: After reviewing the product and explaining that the lights stopped working after only 5 months, I'm happy to say that TaoTronics contacted me and sent me another set. So far these lights are working and I really hope they continue to work because we like them very much. I appreciate TaoTronics' customer service, they made things right in my book and that is the way companies should take care of their customers. I am changing the review because of this great customer service, and although this required more time on my end to take the old lights down and put the new ones back up, I'm ok since they took care of their product - it just needs to work now for a much muck longer time!

These are awesome. I have a pre lit tree and some of the lights are out and we can't seem to figure it out. It is long enough that I have them spread out over the whole tree so when blinking it looks like it should. There are so many options to set the lights on. Also because they are so light weight it wasn't difficult to put over the ornaments that were already on the tree instead of using big lights and having to remove the ornaments.

review_title: Add some sparkle to your life ...
review_text: These lights are really fabulous! I bought them to place in a mini fairy garden, but were longer than I expected, so I was able to wind the extra around a curio cabinet that was above it. I love the features of dimming and brightness. What lights come with a remote? These do! The are super-bright (but not irritatingly so). Easy to operate. They probably do more than I even know or care about, but I enjoy looking at them each night and on the not so sunny days when I turn them on. I am probably going to get another set.

We can't get enough of these! They are strung throughout our home on plant's, headboard's, wall art, you name it! They look awesome, are simple to use and with the remote that does virtually anything one could ask, you can set any mood and level of ambiance! Highly recommend!!! We turn them on constantly! We also have both plug in and battery operated style's. Either of them provide beautiful lighting :)

review_title: ... and then cover with a sort of hot glue like plastic. The wire kind of disappears at night ...
review_text: These lights are essentially leds soldered onto enamel coated copper wire and then cover with a sort of hot glue like plastic. The wire kind of disappears at night so you just see the lights. I am using these as Christmas lights. They seem a little fragile in that a lot of bending would probably break the wire.

They work wonderfully. I made a mess and got them a bit tangled but they still work great. I even pulled a wrote out by accident but I was able to stick it back in and they still work just fine. The up and down arrows on the remote to adjust brightness seem to have no function for these lights, but it's not by any means an important feature.

Update: OK folks, I'm revising my review upward from 3 to 4 stars, thanks to exceptionally responsive and friendly customer service. These people are a class act. Original Review: Like some others, I ran into issues with untangling. It ships in a roll that is anything but intuitive. Took me 1/2 hour to get it all laid out from the roll before I even got to installing. The string is actually 3 separate copper wires that aren't molded together - so it's all to easy to get it into a tangled mess. I thought about balling the whole thing up and throwing it away - but I persevered and got it installed. Following that, it seems like a decent product so far (after 1 day). The remote provides several flashing options that I'll probably never use - including a couple that are pretty spastic. The dimming feature is nice. So - a mixed bag. Personally, I'd recommend waiting for version 2.0.

This is the 4th time I've purchased these lights. They look great as accent lights in any room, are long lasting and use little power. The 1st set I bought may have been the last if my wife didn't like it. She actually may like them more than I do. You control them with a simple remote which is interchangeable so you only need to have one out ever. I highly recommend this!

These are the best led strand lights! We got them for my toddlers teepee, and wanted a strand that plugs in, so we wouldn’t have to constantly replace batteries. The best part is the remote, which came with batteries already in it, so we don’t have to constantly unplug them, and can change the brightness as well. And it’s a very long strand for the price!

review_title: Soothing to the eye and easy functionality
review_text: This works as described and it's also nice on the eye as well. It's got a warm white brightness to it that's not blinding at all. It really does set the mood and with the remote, you are able to control what lighting you prefer and what action you want the lights to do. Although there is one thing regarding the battery life of the battery in the remote and that is it died within a week of using it. I'm not sure if it's just mine or if it's the others as well but that's something to note. If you do have some spare CR2025 lithium batteries laying around then I suppose this really isn't much of an issue.

review_title: Beautiful and easy to use but NOT enough lights for ...
review_text: Beautiful and easy to use but NOT enough lights for a medium sized tree. We ended up using these lights to decorate the inside of the house - but because you can’t connect more than one of these strings of lights, you’re stuck with only one to wrap around a tree. They are easy to use and manipulate and the remote works great. So cool to have the ability to make the lights brighter/dimmer and flicker if you want. Probably best for home/outdoor decoration or a very small tree.

Maybe i didn't read the description closely enough, but i thought these lights were bigger. They came in a small box. A wound circle of thin copper wire with tiny lights on it. It was a bit of a challenge unwinding, but not too bad. I must say the end result, once strung, was very pretty. They were easy to shape where i wanted to put them and the remote was a no-brainer to use. I am not unhappy with them.

I am very picky when it comes to string lights as I hate how tacky most of them look. However these are literally the best ones out out there! I strung them up in my master bedroom and when the main lights are out, we turn these on and it's like looking up at little stars while still in bed. I especially love how there is a remote so you turn them on or off but the small downside is that the you need to point the remote almost directly at the wireless receiver (attached near the outlet part of the lights) in order for the remote to work. The multiple settings of the lights are pretty fun though! These lights can be great for any age and almost any setting.

review_title: These lights are amazing!! I can’t believe how cute and awesome ...
review_text: These lights are amazing!! I can’t believe how cute and awesome they are, and comes with remote for different settings... I’m surprised they don’t cost more ! Would definitely recommend!!!

I really like these Used as accent / mood lighting up the banister of our straircase Slight moderate complaint is that some individual lights appear to have a different temperature light color than the others ( supposed to be 2700K and most are but some appear closer to 3000K in my observation) Still it is minor and not jarring or otherwise ruin the lighting experience just a little less than perfectly uniform consistency color wise.

These lights are dazzling! They are soft light, there are ample lights on the string, the wire itself looks delicate, yet allows shaping in all sorts of directions. For the remote to work the little box on the plug-in cord has to be accessible visually but once I figured that out I just placed a small decorative garland in front of it so it wasn't visible. I used them in a large cylinder this year, but am coming up with ideas for use for next Christmas' decorations, or once I get my house set up I may just use them as accents since they plug in there are no batteries to worry about. I'd buy them again in a minute.

We purchased these as holiday decorations for a lamp post and railing in our front yard. We couldn't be happier with the look of everything. We're both in the design field, so we were on the lookout for tasteful string lights. When we couldn't find tasteful lights at our local home improvement stores, we turned to Amazon and found these! We loved the different options on the remote. We have it set on a 10 second fade-in and fade-out. The entire product is weatherproof (wiring and the adapter). We are in an area that experiences all weather types (sun, rain, and snow) - so this works very well for our needs!

review_title: These work great and are a sure step up from using just ...
review_text: These work great and are a sure step up from using just Christmas lights for some ambient light in dark corners of my rooms. The dimmable feature is wonderful. They appear a bit more fragile with the copper wire, but taking care in hanging them is all that seems to require. The copper wire and low profile of the bulbs has a nice higher end look and they function beautifully. I will be purchasing more! Thank you.

Ordered 2-pack. One set had controller plug contact issue: the string was flickering when set for clear light and shutting off when somebody touched the wire. I wrote an email to the Support team (the information was provided in the booklet accompanying the product). Customer service representative Daisy replied almost immediately, and the company sent me the replacement unit. Very happy with the purchase, and Customer service experience.

Super pleased with these lights. I bought them to replace a half burnt out set of standard string lights used to light my closet. I left the old pushpins in their spots and gently wrapped the wire around them so installation was quick. I really like the look of the thin gold wire opposed to thick green cord I had before. Also, my previous cord had to be unplugged to turn off and my cat would play with the dangling cord and would manage to pop out the 1st light occasionally so although nobody wants another remote to keep track of, I'm happy this is its operating mode. My only slight complaint is that the lights are bright white rather than warm white/yellow but the dimmable feature makes up for that. After replacing ridiculously tiny fuses and bulbs on standard string lights, LEDs certainly are the future.

review_title: The lights are beautiful and the options on the remote are really nice
review_text: The lights are beautiful and the options on the remote are really nice. The only issue we have, keeping it from being 5 stars is that in order for the remote to work you have to have a direct line of sight from the remote to the receiver (which is near where the lights plug in). This is inconvenient for most applications for these lights unfortunately. We are making it work in order to have the beautiful lights, and the price was great.

Initial test showed working fine. Placed them in my china cupboard and they seemed to work fine. Only turned them on for a few hours in the evening. Now, they go off after a couple of hours, remote not working also, and I must disconnect electricity completely for an hour or more before they work again. What gives? Update: They stopped working altogether!

review_title: My only regret is not getting more than two!
review_text: I have several battery operated strand similar to this but I was looking for a plug in version. I LOVE this product. It has such a great variety of settings and I didn't realize it came with a remote until I opened the box! It is wonderful! I have used this at three different parties, as a night light for my nephew, and as a reading light over my bed. It can do anything and go anywhere! I purchased two strands and now am wishing I had gotten more when they were on the Deal of the Day! :)

I used this to light up my patio and the walk leading to the gate. It is perfect for that. Plenty of light to see where you are going but energy efficient enough to leave on. I had planned to connect them to a dusk til dawn sensor socket but they don't seem to be compatible with that so I just leave them on all the time.

Do note that there is NOT a setting for constant. I had wanted them for my bedroom, but there is no setting for steady light. The effect is beautiful, however, and the copper wire is such a nice touch. The lights themselves look like little dew drops on the wire. There are many different blinking and fading choices, and of course being able to turn them on and off remotely is great too. I would give them 5 stars, but for the fact that they won't just "stay" steadily lit for my purposes.

review_title: Works great, looks great, bulbs are cool and very bright but dimmable
review_text: Works great -- I wrapped this around the spindles of our stairway for the holidays and the wires are stiff but malleable enough to stay at the top of the spindles without needing to wrap them around the hand rail. Fantastic!. I checked them a few times and the bulbs are barely warm to the touch at the brightness level that I have these set at. It's great that the lights are dimmable because they're really bright when turned up full blast. I already ordered another strand so I can go all the way around our atrium.

review_title: Defective remotes! Follow up: DO NOT BUT THESE LIGHTS!!!
review_text: Bought these lights for back patio after seeing them at a restaurant. Received them, set them up, turn them on, and changed to flashing mode on the remote control and could not change the mode back, dim them or turn or shut off with the remote. Had to un plug them to turn them off. Sent email to Tao Tronics and they were very prompt and sent a new remote. Same problem with the second remote. Sent another email asking for a refund as i did not want another remote. They promptly issued me a refund through Amazon. The remote is cheaply made and since they asked no questions and quickly gave me a refund obviously the remotes are defective. They died and the remotes are crap!

review_title: The lights arrived and worked great for a couple of months
review_text: The lights arrived and worked great for a couple of months. They stopped working and now I have to go through the trouble of taking them down.

I have used this light set for a few weeks and love it. I hope that the set will last 18 months. If the set lasts that long and does not go up in price then I will be buying much more. The remote has many functions and the line of lights works well with indoor trees.

review_title: It looks totally awesome and I love the fact that it conveniently remote ...
review_text: I bought these lights to backlight two large mirror with frosted edges in my family room. It looks totally awesome and I love the fact that it conveniently remote controlled just plug it in and turn it on whenever. So tiny these lights amazing bright for a soft white as it’s described.

review_title: I really wanted to love these.
review_text: I was so excited to get these lights. They were just what I was looking for. Unfortunately when I started stringing them up, half of the strand started flashing. I think I was able to fix it, but it was disappointing that it happened right out of the box. Once I had them all strung up, I went to use the remote control that came with it and it doesn't work. I tried changing the battery, unplugging the lights and plugging them back in, NOTHING seems to be working. I should have tested everything before I went through all the work to hang them up. They also came with zero instructions and in a white non descriptive box, so maybe I should have known right away. . Not sure whether it is worth it to take them all down and replace them now....I really wanted to love these.

GET THESE LIGHTS! So cute and the perfect addition to our bedroom. We lined them on the edge of our ceiling. The remote has tons of settings to play around with. We got these lights around three of our bedroom walls (sorry I do not know our bedroom's dimensions). The light gets bright enough to read in bed but also dim enough to relax and fall asleep.

Perfect. Perfect. Perfect. Beautiful tiny lights on a delicate copper colored wire. Perfect for so many decorating uses! The remote is awesome and lets you adjust the intensity as well as other functions. Since LED lights are pretty bright, it's nice to be able to turn down the intensity for a more subtle look.... Love them so much I just ordered a third set last night!

Amazing little lights, they light up my room perfectly; not too bright at all. It makes for a lovely cozy type setting. Would 100% recommend these. it comes with a remote that you can use to adjust brightness as well as numerous different settings. The customer service is also truly amazing, they reply to any questions in a time efficient manner and are very helpful.

review_title: Variations and control make them perfect!
review_text: These lights are fantastic! The ability to adjust them makes them ideal for our living room space. Be careful unwinding them- they can easily tangle- but they are easy to put up as long as you plan ahead. We are truly enjoying them. In fact, we love them so much that we went back and ordered more!!

I got these lights to replace a battery operated set in my bedroom. These work way better. No more buying batteries once a week since it plugs in. Although, I put the lights up for some soft light at night. The remote allows you to adjust the light from 10% to 100%. At the highest setting, the string puts off some decent light if I need extra light in that corner of the room. Also I've used the lights nightly for a couple weeks with no problems. Btw, I actually bought these lights, did not get paid to write this and am a real person. (Despite my pic of my schnauzer. I am sure if Moe was still alive, he would like the lights too)

This is a nice little light set that I used on an indoor floor tree. It has a remote control that turns it on and off and also dims the lights. I would give it a 10 but the first one I ordered did not work and I had to return it and order a 2nd one. The 2nd one worked fine. The price is very reasonable and the lights are very pretty at night on the tree.

review_title: Does what it says on the description but one star ...
review_text: Does what it says on the description but one star withheld as the power plug at 12 volts is a loose fit in the socket on the lead from the wall wart and so any heavy movement in the room where it s used or from the subwoofer causes the lights to flicker i guess i can try wrapping the outside of the plug with foil to increase the contact when it is plugged in but any wiggle of it uses the connection to flicker. value for the money is there though.

I really like these lights. We have a light well with a plant shelf and I have looped them around and among the plants. It makes for a very pretty display after the sun goes down. As our days are getting shorter, I will use them more. I see many decorative applications for these lights and will probably order more. The remote control is a nice feature and I love that the lights can be dimmed or brightened.

Easy to set up. Product works great. The many lighting options make these lights really fun. The only "complaint" is that in order for the remote to work you have to have the little signal receiver that is attached to the power pack exposed so that the remote can be pointed at it (line of sight). This makes completely hiding the plug and power pack impossible.

Exceeded my expectations. I had purchased a similar solar powered one before from a different company and was expecting something similar. This by far eceeded what I had in mind, love the remote with the various lighting modes and adjustable light intensity.

The first strand arrived with a defect but the company contacted me and offered to send a replacement immediately. It is on it's way. 5 stars for customer service and I will update again after the replacement strand has arrived. I'm excited to use these in my son's room (he's recently become afraid of the dark and we needed some lighting in there -- I LOVE that these are dimmable) and he can't wait to have "stars" on his ceiling.

review_title: The perfect lighting where you need it.
review_text: This was a gift to my daughter who loves it. It was the perfect finishing touches to her decorations that were in kind of a dark spot on her fireplace and it lit up the whole area with sparkle like diamonds to add light where it was needed. The product itself is made to be worked with ease of placing it where you want it without knocking down anything around it.

Remote failed less than 5 minutes after taking it out of the box. Am awaiting the MFR rep to provide resolution. Update 17 Jan 2016: The company had previously provided a new controller & remote set, and it did not work either. They quickly sent out a complete new set and it was installed and is now working just fine. I have to commend Cust. Service for working hard to rectify the problem, they kept at it until I was satisfied. I would buy this product again.

High quality product. Beautiful glow. 'Love the remote and the choices for levels of brightness. It provides many modes: Steady glow, Fade-out, fade-in, and Blinking The pace of the fading-out, in, and the blinking are also adjustable. For the blinking mode, you can choose a cheerful, easy pace, all the way to a more rapid, aggressive strobe-like quality. My favorite selection is the level of brightness choices. For indoor mood lighting I can dim it, and for outdoor decorative lighting, I can have it at a brighter setting. I really enjoy how versatile this product is. I comes delivered in it's own sturdy rectangular box, with detailed instructions and a battery already provided for the remote. Will definitely buy this product again.

LOVE IT. I bought these to use as a vanity light. I have a big mirror where I do my hair & makeup & the lighting in my house is fairly dim so when I can't use natural light it makes it difficult to do my hair & makeup. I bought just some normal white Christmas lights but it just looked like lights from a disco ball on my face because those just let off like a small circle of light, but these are perfect. It don't let off too much light to bother my boyfriend but it lights up my face & hair in front of my mirror perfectly. I plan to buy more in the future for other areas in my house.

review_title: I absolutely LOVE the remote that comes with these lights--I have them ...
review_text: I absolutely LOVE the remote that comes with these lights--I have them posted around my bedroom, and depending on the time of day, I can dim the intensity of the light. They are natural, not super warm, but when they are dimmed, they have a beautiful glowing quality. I don't ever use the flashing or strobe feature, but I imagine that could be cool for a party!

Bought one 3 months ago. Excellent. Works perfect still. Well done for the price. Bought a second one this week. Couldn't get light to turn on. Pressed against power connection plug that goes into LED Controller module (piece that has the antennae for receiving the remote signal) and it will work. Considered sending back but what a beating. Wrapped tight with electrical tape and could get it to stay lit. As long as it's not touched, it works. Giving three stars because first set gets 5 and this one gets 1.

review_title: I like having lights on all year long
review_text: I like having lights on all year long. However the xmas style lights I had continued to short out in time, so I replaced with these. This product is more sleek and hides well until on. Little harder to work with the string as it's wire, but I just took my time and placed it so it frames out our dining room bay window. The remote comes in really handy and it's great to have the option of different lighting settings (brightness and flashing).

review_title: but they are great and the lighting is enough (comes with a remote ...
review_text: I wish I had gotten the longer set so I could have more lights! but they are great and the lighting is enough (comes with a remote btw, that lets you adjust the strength, and flash if you want it) I think the remote is infrared, so you have to have a clear path between the remote and receiver in order for it to work properly

Decently bright for being small little lights. Most people don't even notice them until they are on. Took about 20 minutes to hang them up in our living room.
