Love the option to make them brighter or dimmer. Also, the remote works from every distance I've tried so far (about 10ft away) but I do have the sensor about 3 ft off the ground. All around excellent product, definitely ordering a set our bedroom.

I ordered two sets of these and I'm glad I didn't review these too early because after only a few months of use, they both have stopped working completely. Both about a month apart. Update: Kudos to the supplier for reading my review and offering replacements. Great proactive customer service. Thank you!

review_title: Other than that the lights look great on the tree - if u have 7 foot ...
review_text: The only reason for 4 stars is the doggone remote control! Even though it shows where to release for opening - it never did. The remote didn’t work and I gave up on it. Other than that the lights look great on the tree - if u have 7 foot tree recommend getting 2 strands

Not at all bright. Is more of a mood lighting. I was looking for a room brightener. My living room has no installed lighting & I really Don't like lamps. These did not work for the purpose I needed them for. If your looking for a bright light rather then yellow mood lighting then don't buy these. Cool that they come with a remote though! Reasons for 5 stars: Company was kind & generous & would be a great mood lighting if that's what your looking fo.

review_title: Which was too bad because they looked beautiful on our patio
review_text: Sadly these lights quite working shortly after we hung them. Which was too bad because they looked beautiful on our patio. I bought a few of these and both from this company quit working.

review_title: All the girls loved them and they were the only lights the girls ...
review_text: Bought this as gift for my teenage granddaughter and she loves it. Her dad put the lights up before her sleepover that day. All the girls loved them and they were the only lights the girls wanted to use. The lights have a wide range of brightness, are light weight, bendable, and easy to put up. The length of these lights makes it great for adding ambient lighting to a room and the wire is barely visible. Based on my granddaughter and her friends' reaction and how they looked in the room; I would highly recommend these lights.

review_title: Beautiful, great priced lights. Crappy remote.
review_text: Have had this for quite a long time now, about a year, and have not had any problems with it. I haven't had it up for a couple months because I've moved, but prior to that I had it in use almost all day every day. Never any problems with the lights going out or overheating. It works very well and adds such a nice charm to my room. The only con is the remote, which is why I didn't rate it 5/5. It really is finicky, like others said needs direct line of sight to work, and mine went out after about a month, in which I have not replaced the battery yet. It works from just plugging in and out, so if you already have it set to go you don't really need the controller unless you want to edit the light settings (I didn't). Would definitely recommend and would purchase more of these in the future.

I can't get over the warmth and quality of these reasonably priced lights~ They are beautiful and add so much to my small space. I put them on my antique fireplace surround (sans fireplace!). I read about so many different kinds of lights, these are just what I wanted!

These lights are bright and work well with the different modes on the remote, but I think the description of them as being "weatherproof" is misleading. The package materials say "water resistant". And the wires connecting the lights to the power source, and the power source itself, would not be safe to plug in outdoors during bad weather. I originally purchased these for my condo balcony, but I would not feel safe leaving them plugged in outside. Also, these lights are very small, each about the size of a pencil eraser, not sized like you might expect in Christmas lights. Not a problem considering their size, but good to know. == UPDATE 7/18/16 == TaoTronics contacted me after I posted this review with an offer to refund or replace with a larger string of lights to make things right. I declined the very generous offer considering there isn't anything wrong with the product and I can use what I bought for something creative inside. That's great customer service to make the offer they did though, and I'm updating my star rating from 3-4 because of it.

I like it. You get a lot of lights that can wrap far and provide a good amount of light (on highest settings) for a long time with little heat or (relatively) little energy. Or, gentle soft light when you just need to see where you're going or, say, get ready for bed. The lights are a warm yellow, easy on the eyes and make everything in the room including skin look natural -- like a softly-lit restaurant on date night. The copper wire in between is attractive. There are a lot of settings besides the 10 brightness increments. Good price. Attached mine with 3M gel mounting tape placed in teeny squares behind every 3rd or 4th LED. What I do NOT like is the remote. First, as many have noted, it requires direct line of sight. I'm not sure exactly where the detection cone is, but it must be the size of a pin head. Sometimes I have to press the off button, without exaggeration, about 20 times in all kinds of random angles from about 6 inches away. Then I think I've found the sweet spot, but next time it's different and the hunt for the needle in the receiver haystack starts all over. I tested this extensively before mounting it, rotating in a 360 circle around the receiver, then height angles, and finally accepted it's random every time... And this is just to turn it on and off - nevermind switching between the many lighting modes. In perspective, it's a cheap product and I've already wired everything so not going to send it back, but if there's one thing that could improve this product, it's the sad remote detection. One other thing on my gripe/wishlist: Ergonomics... The remote has 24 symmetrical buttons all shaped and textured exactly the same. When trying to turn these on in the dark or dim light, you can't even tell if you're holding the remote upside down (except to feel for the tiny bump of the emitter on the edge of the remote and count buttons from memory). In general - this little bugger has an overload of options though you eventually get used to them. How about up/down (2 buttons) instead of all 10 setting steps? Does anyone really need 4 settings for "seizure-inducing flicker" mode?

review_title: Led color may look a little inconsistent for some people
review_text: While these leds are bright and the controller offers many display options (dimming. blinking, etc.), I am not happy with the consistency of the led color temperature. Some of the Leds are bright white, some are warm white, some are more of the white-blueish shade. When viewed all together on a small tree, it leaves much to be desired. When leds are manufactured, there is no way to ensure exact color temperature between individual leds. Higher end manufacturers will "batch" leds according to color temperature, then build a product using similar batches. That was not done when these lights, that's for sure. I would not buy these again... now I have to try and find a consistent warm white led string set in this tiny size... this could prove to be very difficult. UPDATE: I edited my review from 2 stars to 4 stars after receiving excellent customer service from the manufacturer. They went above and beyond to address my concerns. I received a free second set and noticed something interesting. It is not really a "batch" or color temp issue that gives the inconsistent color to these lights... it is the direction each led faces which determines the final "perceived" color temp of each led. If you look at an led head on, it will look whiter than looking at an led from the side. So you have slight inconsistencies in the final look depending on how you use mount these. This may or not be an issue for some people. I found if I use them near other "consistent" warm leds lights, it's obvious, but if I use them in an area by themselves... it looks better. So for me, these are acceptable when used alone, but not if used with, or near, other warm white lights.

review_title: Great product with even greater customer service!
review_text: When I first got this item, I was very excited and immediately hung it up. The way the lights sit on wire is very nice because it’s easy to manipulate and hang. I’ve had many string lights before (mostly from places like Urban Outfitters), but these are easily my favorite due to the remote. Being able to use the remote to make the lights brighter during the day and dimmer at night are such a game changer for me! And now I just click a button to turn them off at night instead of reaching under the bed for the outlet! It’s just so user friendly. I had trouble with the remote when I first received it and so I contacted customer service. They tried to help me troubleshoot, but when that didn’t work they immediately sent me a replacement remote. The new remote worked perfectly and I couldn’t be happier with the product. I’m impressed with the customer service and I’m glad knowing I can contact them if I run into any issues in the future!

*PROBLEM WITH REMOTE TIP* On the end of the second "unused" wire of the white adapter is the infrared sensor. The black curved section is the actual sensor that the remote must send a signal to. Make sure there is a direct line of site path to the sensor when using the remote. You may still have a problem where the remote needs to be precisely pointed at the sensor in order for it to work. You can fix this by taping a little bit of aluminum foil by the sensor and shaping it so as to "funnel" the light towards the sensor. Aluminum foil actually reflects 95% of infrared light and the funnel provides more paths for the light to bounce around and reach the sensor. The lights look really nice and its cool that there are all these different features and settings, but they really could have made the sensor more robust or the remote more powerful. Even with my setup the range is still just around 13 ft

The issues I have with it is that I would have preferred the wiring to be silver or clear instead of copper since it stands out way to much on th wall during the day. Second, the remote only worked for 2 weeks. I have not been able to remove the backing to determine what type of battery it needs in order to replace it and get it back up and running. At this point, I’m debating on whether I want to buy the replacement battery or return it since the Batteries Plus Store and the UPS Store are directly across the street from one another.

Lights are exactly what we wanted. The remote is to be desired though. You must be practically right on them in order for it to operate them. Lights are very nice though. Update: just bought a second set and will order more in the future. Does what we need them to do. Remote control function is still the only real downfall of these lights. Only works if you are on top of them. No biggie really but would be nice so i don't have to learn yoga to point the remote at the receiver since ours are under the bed towards the headboard lol. Life goes on...

Love these so much I bought two more sets. I have one set draped across two hanging planters and a mirror in the living room. They add a very beautiful "magical" touch. Wires are very bendable and easy to shape. The lights are tiny, but bright. The remote is very convenient for turning off and on. Have to admit that I haven't played with the other buttons to see what other effects are available. The fact that these lights are LEDs makes them super ecenomical. If you are looking for very versatile fairy effect lights, these are perfect!

It has all the dimming and flashing settings you want. Quality design. You can do all sorts of creative things with this string light. 30 ft is actually a lot for what I chose to do. I strung it up on a wall in a star and moon pattern. Wish you could connect more units. Recommend buying the clear command wall tabs/hooks cuz they hide well and don't distract from your design or clear tape would do.

review_title: Great replacement for problematic incandescent xmas lights.
review_text: Love these lights! Combined 200 & 100 to dress up grape vine in covered porch. The remote was an extra pleasure!

I absolutely love these little lights. They are so versatile. I use them in my bedroom and the remote make them so convenient to use. When I'm ready for bed I just use the remote to turn them off and I never have to get out of bed. I ordered some for my daughter and my son for Christmas and the also love them. I need to get more for under the kitchen cabinets. I think they would work well under there...

review_title: Perfect for our deck | GREAT customer service
review_text: I bought three of these a couple years ago and only got around to putting them up on our deck about a month ago. They are super easy to put up and look fantastic, putting out enough light that we don't need additional light sources. They do not link to one another, but we found a way around that. Regarding the company's customer service: one of the power supplies failed after being left out in the rain (DON'T leave the power supplies connected if rain is in the forecast). I emailed TaoTronics and a week later a new power supply arrived in the mail. Very surprised and impressed.

review_title: I had read reviews and was satisfied with go ahead and purchasing this product
review_text: I had read reviews and was satisfied with go ahead and purchasing this product. When I received the item, it was my fault that I did not test it to make sure it was working, but didn't have use for it yet in my new house. I was working on finding a place to put the lights and after 4 months in my cabinet, I pulled it out to use, and the lights wouldn't turn on. I changed the battery out in the remote, tried different sockets and made sure all was plugged in correctly and still nothing. Now 4 months later, I can't return it and stuck with lights that do not work. I'm sure this is a rare thing to happen, but just encourage buyers to try their product day of delivery so they can return the item before the return time is over.

review_title: So rare that a product is perfect!
review_text: They left NOTHING out of these awesome LEDS. Not only do they operate flawlessly on the multitude of brightness settings and operating modes, they hold their memory!!! Mine are plugged in and I operate them by a light switch. When I turn the on after being off all night they are at the setting I left them on. Absolutely awesome. The color is beautiful. Not yellow but not blue. The remote works great too. I am going to buy more just to have on hand. Doubt I will find any this nice ever again.

YES IT WORKS WITH A TIMER. Sorry for the caps but I couldn't find a definitive answer on this but I took a chance and bought it. It will shut off and come back on the same setting you had it at. You DO NOT need to push the on button on the remote to get it to come back on. I wrap them around the railing on my balcony and the look pretty cool under the frozen snow.

Using these as a child's nightlight that can be controlled from the bedside stand via the remote. May order more for use over the holidays. The remote has more functions than I need or want (various flashing speeds) but they're there if you want them. I was looking for a) plug in, not batteries b) dimmable, and c) a remote -- and these fit the bill. I'll attach photos showing lowest setting and highest setting.

I LOVE these lights! I bought these lights in August 2017 for my dorm room after finally succumbing to the numerous Pinterest pictures of decorated dorm rooms, and after living through having stale light in my dorm the previous year. I am so glad that I decided to buy these lights for my dorm. Immediately after hanging them up in my dorm and playing with the settings, myself and all of my friends stood there awestruck by how much light they produced, and how fun it was to use the remote to change the settings. The lights were great whether I wanted to study, have friends over, or for winding down before bed. I recommend that if you wish to do the same, you buy these lights as well. The lights are a great price, come with a remote, and are great in any setting. I bought the 33 ft lights and they were perfect for my dorm. Recently, I returned home after the end of the semester and I realized that my remote control must have been left behind in my dorm room. I was devastated and thought that I would have to buy new lights; however, after contacting the company, they have sent me a brand new remote for free! Thank you so much TaoTronics for having a great product and for having amazing customer service. To anyone reading this: buy these lights!!

I have bought at least 5 of these string lights. I make vase lamps to give friends as gifts. Every one I bought was great except this one I bought a week ago. The power cord does not connect to the adapter perfectly. You have to turn it around many times to finally get it light up. Once you move it a bit, it loses the power. I have to give it as a gift tomorrow. Don't even have time to wait for a replacement. This worries me once I give it to my friend.

review_title: Perfect fit for my queen sized bed
review_text: Perfect fit for my queen sized bed. Makes the room feel so much more comfortable and relaxing. Very pleased with this purchase.

review_title: Only 1 of 2 Ordered Works - EDIT - Now 2 of 3!
review_text: Ordered two. One works, one does not. The one that works is very nice. Too bad that, in my experience, only 50% of them work. EDIT - 6/12/2016 GREAT customer service. The seller contacted me shortly after I posted my review. They offered a full refund or a replacement product. I chose a replacement product which arrived within 2 days. It works great and now is installed on an arbor in my backyard. Looks so nice at night. I love all the functionality that the remote control provides. I use the dimmest setting to get a subtle accent around the arbor but it gets plenty bright if needed. Install so the IR sensor is clearly visible and the remote works great. A recommended product.

I love these lights. I wanted something to put on the ceiling around my bed in case I didn't want the full room light on and I was not disappointed. I got the amber lights and the remote, set it up, turned off my light and was more than happy with the result. The remote works perfectly and I love the dimming option. If I want to read a book I can just set it to a low percentage and not bother my boyfriend when he goes to sleep. I'm not a fan of the other two options but each to their own. I'm very happy with this product and would happy buy again!

This product was a nightmare from the start the wiring does not allow this product to have any decent draping and because its so stiff you constantly have to readjust. Once a section gets tangled I worried about breaking the wires trying to undo them. Lastly the controls didnt offer any nice random twinkling and I couldnt get it to stop blinking once they started... Huge disappointment.

Love love LOVE! Bought a cheaper version of this product with no remote as a trial -I was so impressed I bought the TaoTronics dimmable with a remote. Amazing! In the box not so impressive but unwind and plug in and it is beautiful in so many applications. Best features: super bright yet no heat think of all the ways you could use that in home decor! The remote and dim-ability make it even better. Drape it behind curtains, a headboard, on top of kitchen cabinets and it provides fabulous light and looks gorgeous. I'll be buying extras for a Christmas tree this year!

review_title: Long lasting reliable attractive and a safety feature for me at night
review_text: This is my third purchased set. I love the way these small lights shed just the amount of light needed to keep me safe at night and to provide a warm glow to my room. They last a surprisingly long time compared with other lights I have purchased in the past and I find the on/off buttons very convenient. At first I was concerned that the metal in between would look odd but not so. I am grateful for this product.

I friggin' love these things!! They are in my carport. I keep em dim most of the time but if the kids need to play out there at night I turn them up and the will light up the whole area! When we order a pizza or Chinese delivery I put em on flash and bring attention to the house. They don't have the Christmas light vibe at all even on full bright because they follow the lines of the carport so perfectly they look more like runway lights than a decoration. And they are a soft white not a harsh white you usually think about when you hear L.E.D. And unlike Christmas lights the copper wire can be run through and around stuff way more easily.

review_title: Great lights; remote is not so great
review_text: They’re beautiful and very nice looking, the star taken off is for the remote control not working as well as it should; I have to hit it several times while getting closer for it to work. Another reason for the star taken off is that the arrows on the remote don’t work. Other than this, the lights are perfect for my daughters room- they’re strung up underneath her top bunk for a reading area at night. She loves them.

review_title: The lights are beautiful! I just put them over a chair in ...
review_text: The lights are beautiful! I just put them over a chair in front of a window so that they would reflect. Gorgeous. Very bright even though they are tiny point lights, lovely color of light. The programming is fun to play with. I feel comfortable leaving them on when I'm not in the room or at home, since they don't seem to heat up. They arrived a day after I ordered them, in a well-constructed and attractively designed box. A friend saw them and ordered them immediately as well. The shorter strand is still a lot of lights, and I don't really need more, but I like them so much that I'm going to buy another strand, and buy more to give as gifts next year. Love, love these.

review_title: The remote makes these lights worth it
review_text: Loved these lights - they are exactly the kind of warm, ethereal "fairy" lights you've seen in all those dreamy Pinterest bedrooms pictures - but the best part about these lights by far is the REMOTE!!!! There are 10 different brightness settings, which is great if you want to brighten up a cheerful living room, or have a bit of mood lighting for a bedroom. (There are also several different settings for fading and flashing the lights, though I rarely use those for the ones in my bedroom!) t's also great that I can turn the lights off from my comfy bed without having to climb out and fiddle with an outlet.

review_title: Good but harder to keep on
review_text: I have used copper wired fairy lights and I liked the idea that these are not battery operated and had a remote. I put these under my dd Kura bed and pinched it between the wooden support slats. But depending on where it is pinched or how hard, the entire string goes out! Yes, I understand that the flow of electrical is impeded but couldn’t a coating or something have prevented this? I fixed it with tape so not as cute but at least it works!

review_title: I did great with the unwrapping of my other sets
review_text: This is the most difficult request... I wrapped the lights last year and took the best storage care of the lights I have a mess on my hands This string is in such a horrible “birds nest “ mess I sat for over an hour working to get them apart Can you help me I’m short on cash but thank you for your time

review_title: a good tip would be to plug in and turn on ...
review_text: I don't often write reviews for products but these lights totally exceeded my expectations! although detangling them was a little tricky since I was over eager when installing them, it just took a few minutes and a little patience to unravel. a good tip would be to plug in and turn on the lights first to help with the untangling. i was really surprised that the lights also have so many different options / settings for brightness and pulsing/blinking. i used them along the baseboards of my bedroom to provide soft ambient lighting as a nice evening alternative to the overhead lights built into my apartment's ceiling. they provide a very lovely soft glow!

I used this light for a while and I think it is really beautiful, but I have an big issue with these lights. The intersection where I connect the power adapter wire with the lights wire keeps coming off. Thus these lights won't stay on and keep flickering and turning off. I tried taping it so that they would stay but they won't. Even when the light is on, if I move my desk a little, the cords will disconnect and the light will turn off.

The lights work well enough when plugged in directly, but when I add the extension that should allow for remote-control operation, the lights will not turn on nor register any command from the remote.

review_title: These are fantastic. Used on palm trees
review_text: These are fantastic. Used on palm trees, used another set inside arond the Christmas tree and another around the backyard which we will keep up all year to set a nice mood (can change the lightning anytime w the remote) in the backyard when BBQ, reading, taking out the trash, etc. Compared to the set i purchased at the local superstore... a set of only 30 lights, and only 10 feet long for the same price. You get 30 feet and 100 lights with these. I will purchase more shortly. Cannot comment on lifespan... only had for a few weeks but has been perfectly fine in the light rain we have been having.

review_title: Open the box and test when they arrive!
review_text: UPDATE: The seller contacted me and sent me a new box at no cost, which was fantastic! Really great product now that I have two working sets of lights. The first box I received worked just fine - all according to plan. The second box, when I tried to plug it in, they just flat out don't work. Found out through trial and error that the adapter to plug them into the outlet is what doesn't work, and when I went to replace the item through Amazon, I wasn't given the option. The set that works is beautiful, and I love them! Just wish the second box worked. PLEASE be sure to open the box and test these out when you receive them!

Good lights, it's great to be able to band them the way you need and the size is great. I took the star off because the light is not as warm as advertised, it actually cooler. My wife wanted to use them for the bedroom, but they don't create a cozy warm feeling, so we used them in home office. Other than that they work great.

review_title: Really upset because I loved these lights when they were working
review_text: Really upset because I loved these lights when they were working. I don’t keep these on all day, but I’ll keep them on all night. I’ve had these for literally 2 months and they’re about to die...there were times that the light would flicker even when the light was functioning properly. My lights have been like this for 2 days now so I don’t think they’ll be flickering back to its normal intensity. I attached a video where the light’s intensity is switched back and forth from 100 to 0 (my tv is on so most light is coming from that). The photo is when my tv is off and the lights are at its brightest. You can’t see anything at all! When these were working properly, it would light my entire room up and I would not have to use my ceiling lights

Loved it while it lasted. Loved the remote and the settings. Sadly it's very cheap. The adapter came apart after a few uses, it was an easy fix. But than half the lights died out after about 3 months and now the whole thing won't turn on. Even with a new adapter. Waste of money. But I guess that's what you expect for that price.....

I bought these to line my high celing in the bedroom in my apartment and they work well. I still needed another lamp, but these are good for soft mood lighting, but not for reading or doing makeup or anything because theyre not bright enough. I only use the steady-on option but its nice to be able to dim them sometimes.

Work exactly as described. We only use these once a year for holidays but after 3 seasons are still working fine. I roll it up on the tube it came with each time and so far so good. Remote works great and the lights are bright and beautiful. We use sticky tabs ( 2 sided tape) plus scotch tape to attach to a large window. Prob a better way to mount them! Enjoy!

review_title: The lights are bright and the remote is great to turn them on when placed on a high ...
review_text: The lights are bright and the remote is great to turn them on when placed on a high bookshelf. I would have liked a little more set-up instructions in the booklet provided since I had never used this type of product before but I viewed a YouTube video and was good to go! I also had to attach an extension cord because of the limited length of the electrical cord in order to reach from the top of the bookcase to the outlet.

We love these lights so much when decorating our staircase this winter. The lightweight wire made it so easy to get the exact placement of the lights. We also purchased the one without the remote control and I'm not sure if the extra cost for the remote was worth it as we ended up turning them both off and on at the same time. It would be great it you could link them together, but that wasn't an option. Overall, a great addition to our Christmas lights. i think you can use them outside as well, but we didn't do that. Now my daughter wants them to drape over her bed. They don't get hot, so they are a safe alternative to traditional Christmas lights.

I've gone back and bought multiple of these lights as they're my favorite LED string lights so far. Oldest pair still works great even after 1 year. Love the remote control and ability to dim to multiple levels. They're light in weight so I just used clear scotch tape to tape this around my bedroom walls in a random snaking pattern. I turn on the lights every night instead of using a lamp since it provides a warm, inviting atmosphere. Highly recommend!

I love the warm white glow of the lights. And everything works. But what i dont like is that you get either total blackout or full on lightings. What i would have loved is a twinkling effect where lights are on and off randomly and alternately. So the lights look like twinkling like stars and not flashing on and off together.

review_title: Lights don't last, remote difficult to use
review_text: It's cute, but the remote is not good. It's difficult for the remote to register what it is being pressed on which makes it difficult for me to change settings. I like it, but I don't highly recommend it. Updated: The lights now flicker even when it's not at that mode and before if I pressed 10 then 100 there was a clear difference in the lighting, but now it's the same. I've barely used this product and it's too bad it's already deteriorated.

These lights are so pretty! I didn't really care when I ordered them that they came with a dimmer option. However, now that I have them I understand the reasoning - brighter before it is fully dark and use the dimmer for mood lighting when it is fully dark. On full brightness level, these are VERY bright even though very small. I love the ambiance these lights give my outdoor space. The copper wiring also helps to place the lights where you want them. Well worth the price. Packaged well and arrived on time.
These lights never overheat, are easy to maneuver, and the wire is thin and copper. I used it for curtains over my bed and I love it!

Worth noting that you can't connect these end-to-end like you can with traditional Christmas lights, but that didn't matter in my case. I wish there were some way around the thick ugly black cords on the plug end, but I'll get by. All that aside, these are really pretty and look wonderful around my ceiling.

Great product. Lasts all year around! Initially used for Christmas decoration but then strung them around bunkbeds for my daughters and this is used as their night light. Never turns off and I am completely impressed by the durability and beauty. Actually I am about to order six more boxes for the rest of the house and gifts.

review_title: Good for the price. Remote a bit annoying. Color: blue/white light.
review_text: These are okay. Seem suitable for outdoors, and are nice and sleek looking, unlike bulb alternatives. The color of these is pretty very clean/blue white, which isn't the best for using outdoors in the evening, when you want a softer yellow light. Remote has to be pretty close to power box in order to work.

review_title: Decent lights, but only for the right price.
review_text: The lights themselves are nice but the wiring for these lights kink and tangle easily. The controls are cool but you have to be within inches of the receiver to make the remote work. I understand the design idea behind it, so that if you have multiple sets and you want different settings on them the remote won't have the range to change them all, but it is kind of a pain. I definitely would not pay full asking price for these lights. I believe I paid around $10 US each and bought 2 sets.

My daughter added these to the interior of her Privacy Pop tent on her dorm bed. The string encircled the interior of her tent almost a full 2x's and added a fun, unique and calming ambient light to her dorm room. The lights' ability to dim make it possible to add enough light to study or to sleep without ever turning the light string off. A great product for versitile, fun lighting. Totally recommend 'em!

These are pretty and I like the dimmable feature as well as the slow on/off cycle. The only downfall is that the remote must be pointed directly at the plug which for us is hidden behind a bed but I just have it set at a dim level, its not a deal breaker. Overall it provides a beautiful warm and magical space.

I love these lights! I framed them around a tapestry in my room and together, they make a really relaxing environment. I use them every single night. I love the settings on the lights; the 10% dimmer is really nice at night because it's enough light to see in the room, yet dim enough to be really relaxing and comfortable. I definitely will be buying more of these when I find more places to put them!

I Love these lights and have since purchased two more! I have read the reviews about the sensor not working but I can tell you that I have NOT had any problems with mine because I make sure I have it set up so that it gets a direct hit in the center of it. If you try to use the controller off to the side it will not work. Just set it up so it is pointing where your controller can get a direct, head on connection and you will have no problem. It's kind of a no brainer but worth mentioning.

Never worked. The black cord connection arrived non-functional. Tested with another one so I’m certain it’s the black cord vs. copper light wire. Life got super busy and I missed return window. Very disappointed. I’m reminded of this while I’m decorating again for another family party.

review_title: color not as pictured, but for the price they're okay
review_text: These are a blue-white, not warm yellow white as pictured. They are okay. They don't go as far as you think they will, so look a little pithy in the fireplace. It's also not possible to combine multiple strings onto one plug, so it won't be a good long term solution. The remotes work so-so, but I like the dimming feature.

review_title: Packaging could be better. I would like to know if there is ...
review_text: The lights seem to work well in the application I use them in. The one star deduction is for having to un tangle the wire, took 25 minutes to untanlge without damage to the lights. . Packaging could be better. I would like to know if there is a longer version of this type of light set.

review_title: Too small to light a patio area.
review_text: I bought these for a patio party and thought that they would light up this small area. They are so tiny and if you put them high on the patio celing, no draping them around, you won't get much light. These would be good for lighting tables, small trees, shrubs, but not patio areas as suggested on the description.

review_title: Great buy and lots of uses
review_text: So far we have used these for Birthday signs, bell jar, Christmas decorations on a mantle, and just fun room lites and they have worked well and not had any problems with their multiple repurposing so I certainly feel like we have got our moneys worth from them. Remotes work well and control both.

This is a great product over all. I have a rating of 4/5 stars just due to three things. 1. This is definitely a cooler white than warm white and I was looking for warm toned lights. 2. The remote is a little hard to handle. You have to press hard on the buttons and have to be in clear range of the outlet you connect the lights to. 3. The adapter that connects the lights together fits really loosely and falls apart easily. These things are easy to fix/ work around but we’re notica enough to be an annoyance. Over all the lights are beautiful

To be honest these weren’t what I expected, but they are much better. They are tiny LED lights on wire. You can bend and wrap the wire. The remote has many options and levels of brightness for the lights. I wrapped mine across the fireplace mantel and around the window. Soft lights at night and nearly invisible during the day. These are really great lights. I’d buy again.

These lights are exactly what I was looking for. They're dimmable and they're very easy to mold into whatever shapes you want. The only thing that I wish I had thought of ahead of time, was to go buy some little clips to clip them to my canopy, but that's totally my fault for not thinking of that ahead of time. They make my space look hella magical and the remote options just make it soooooo worth it.

The lights themselves work alright, but only when plugged directly into a power supply. The included control unit/remote was nothing but trouble. If you set the brightness too high (above 50%), they would start to strobe. After less than a year (only rarely changing anything) the controller box died completely, and would no longer power the light strand.

The lights are just what I needed! I’ve used them to create a Polaroid wall and the length is just right to reach to the outlet. This is also great because it can either be directly plugged into the wall or into a battery box. Additionally there are multiple different settings - flashing, clear, etc - and you can change the brightness of the lights. The wire is also a nice copper(almost rose gold). One slight problem however is that in order to use the remote it must be pointed at the power box which can be annoying sometimes. Overall though it is a great product and just what I needed!

review_title: It works great if you are patient.
review_text: Great value! Has a remote with many features. "It is what it is." That is a 33-ft LED string light with remote. No, you can't daisy chain with additional strings. No you can't cut the string. It's perfect for my use. The instructions are a bit "thin." I want the LEDs to remain on, i.e., no flashing. I figured out how to do this. Tip: If the remote doesn't seem to get to the feature you are trying to set up. reboot !! -- unplug the string, remove the remote's battery, then return the batteries to the remote and plug in the string.

These are fantastic. I use them everyday over my bed. Easy to cut off with the remote at night before I go to bed and much nicer to wake up using these as the light in my room than turning on a bright overhead light or lamp. They would be great for Christmas lights on small Christmas tree. I thought they changed colors, but they only have flash, fade, and dim settings. I like to leave them on low.

This is my second order of two strands of these lights. I hate to say how much I love them for fear others will buy them and I won't be able to get more. Currently, two sets surround the windows on the outside of my Victorian home. I set them very dim and they add just the right amount of warmth I wish. These strands will be strung around my kitchen high near the 10 ft ceiling and draped around the pictures, shelves, crocks, and artifacts hung on the wall. I hope these are never discontinued and want them to last forever. Best thing I have gotten in a long time.

Purchased fees on a whim and I do not regret. They are very bright when there are no lights and the string is made of wire so you could been to any shape if needed. I wrapped mine around my curtain rod in my bed room and it gives the perfect DM on Beyonce when I want to relax. Love that it comes with a remote control And does not need batteries.

review_title: Already planning another lighting project for TaoTronics!
review_text: Beautiful and easy to set up. Installed these outdoors along a hedge . Tucked the sensor in a hidden, inconspicuous spot but with no interference so the remote works fine from indoors. I find that 10 grades of dim to bright gradations work. This is sufficient and for the cost and beauty, this was a charm of a buy. The flexibility of the wiring was excellent as it 'holds' a shape [as opposed to standard plastic string lights]. This enabled us to scallop it along our fence for a lovely effect! It took no effort and we are delighted with the results! And, on and off with the click of a button from indoors! Very pleased!

review_title: Don't waste your money- doesn't last
review_text: At first I thought these lights were amazing because they are so beautiful, however, they are not good quality. I bought these towards the end of April and they stopped working today. I'm highly dissatisfied and disappointed in the quality... Such a shame.

Pretty great. I love that there's a remote... though the number of buttons on the remote makes me chuckle a bit. At least half of them are unnecessary (ex. On and Off do no need to be 2 separate buttons, and there could just be a dimmer and brighter button instead of listing out each brightness setting). But they work great! I really wish they had a a real twinkle setting instead of what are really just strobe settings. But however, after a month and a half of use, they work great, no remote problems, and they have really made my living room a more cozy place to hang out.

I now have three sets of these. The first has been used about 7-10 times over the past year for camping lights. I love them. Easy to put up and take down, run just fine off 12V (with a small inverter). I clip them to the inside of our pop-top shade structures, and they make really nice background light in the evenings.

review_title: very thin fragile copper wire, 10x harder to untangle than any ball of christmas lights
review_text: it is a very thin fragile copper wire which would never lay as pictured. Ikea makes something like this and at least they had the sense to use coating on the wire...now imagine trying to untangle thin wire, yeah its far worse than any ball of christmas lights. The dimming feature was cool, but I still found the lights to be a harsh white.

Gorgeous, easy to work with. I put these along the chair rail in my bathroom. The remote with dimming feature is perfect for this. Update 14 months later: These are still working perfectly. I turn them on every single night for about 6 hours since the day I put them up. I couldn't be happier with this purchase.

Perfect for creating ambient lighting I like the warmth of the lights and the fact that its copper wire so you can twist it around stuff and the remote is really easy to use you just have to connect all the pieces together and then you can use the remote for it to work it doesnt really come with directions so it took me a second to figure it out but i really like them regardless

review_title: Awesome indoor lighting, living room and bedroom
review_text: I have two strings of these. After I took down my Xmas lights I missed them but wanted LED lights. These are awesome. Can adjust brightness, make them strobe, all from a remote! I just keep them on as some accent lighting in my living room. I have a projector so it is usually dark. These provide good low ambient light so we can still see stuff but not too bright as to affect the screen. I liked them so much I got a second string for my bedroom. Is low romantic lighting like candles. We both love it!

These lights have certainly reached my expectations! The lights are placed about 4 inches apart, each LED bulb is very bright and the alternating white and gold lights give it the perfect glow. The lights are very easy to hang and store due to the copper wiring, and the 33 feet perfectly cover the ceiling lining of a wall. For less than $15 I am very satisfied with this purchase. I used these at a party and everyone complimented them. The remote is very easy to use and the adjustments give great variety to the room. Overall, I would definitely recommend these over another brand and I will probably be purchasing these again in the future.

review_title: This is a fantastic value for money
review_text: This is a fantastic value for money. No matter what your purpose of using this string light is, it will deliver very well. The fact it is made of LED and is waterproof are two of its most strong features. Low on energy cost and no hassle maintenance (out-door or indoor!). The fact this comes with a remote makes it even user-friendly. I use it as ambient lighting in my bedroom and can dim it a little just before bedtime and then switch it off from my bed with remote, without getting off! Perfectly moldable, it can be put in any shape. I bought it for around $15 and gave me a great return. Would highly recommend.

I love these lights! I haven’t been the most careful with them but not a single one has stopped working, the wire is thin but pretty sturdy, the remote works well too. It also has a nice warm glow. I use it for reading light for when my roommate decides to sleep before me, and it’s perfect. The only downsides are that sometimes one of the buttons get stuck, and there’s a million settings for flashing and “smooth transition” but the flashing is a bit weird for twinkle lights since they all do it synchronized and the “smooth transition” is not smooth at all. I don’t use either of those functions though so it didn’t affect my rating at all.

review_title: We bought these lights for our indoor bar and LOVE them. They are definitely quality lights
review_text: We bought these lights for our indoor bar and LOVE them. They are definitely quality lights. They are dim enough not to brighten the entire bar area, but light enough to make a difference. The copper wiring is perfect for making the wire less noticeable. It's so awesome that these have a remote control dimmer and on/off switch. I bought an extra set for my dad -- he loved them as soon as he saw them and wanted some for his outdoor deck! Highly recommend.

Love these lights! The remote works great and I love the features. Makes my new canopy look very romantic. I only had to buy one strand to get all the way around our king size canopy. Fast shipping too

Love these. Strung two sets along ceiling of my back patio and I never turn on the regular lighting anymore. Crazy simple install as these are very lightweight. The fact that these dim makes them so much more useful (same remote works for controlling both of my sets and I now ha a spare). I can fully light the patio or dim way down to bare minimum mood lighting. Have had them up for several weeks with temperatures ranging from zero to about 80 with no issues.
Have found multiple uses for it. Amazing and love the fact that it has different speeds and brings remote. No complaints! Planning on buying more

It's okay. It installed and works just fine. I knew that the lights were all-or-nothing, but that really makes most of the functions unusable. What I mean is that the twinkling (firefly) and fading / flashing lights all dim or flash at the same time, not randomly. I thought maybe the random placement I used would make it less of an issue, but no. I'll pretty much only be using the left half of the remote to set the brightness level.

TaoTronics TT-SL036 33ft 100 LED String Lights Dimmable with Remote Control, Waterproof Decorative Lights for Bedroom, Patio, Garden, Gate, Yard, Parties, Wedding. UL588 and TUVus Approved(Warm White) I loved these lights while they lasted, which unfortunately was not very long. I had set them up in a doorway in my home and loved the fact that they were dimmable and provided enough light for a bedroom. However after about 2 weeks after setting them up they stopped working suddenly. I thought at first it was the battery in the remote, but even after switching it out and checking all the connections my lights still don't work. I am quite disappointed and loved the look, I wish they did not break.

It stopped working after a 6 months of use. There was no sign of wire being broken. Batteries were replaced in the remote and it would not turn on. UPDATE: They sent me a replacement which works just fine. I’m grateful of their service. I use it in my bedroom to prepare for sleep. It’s tucked away from view.
It’s been two years of (inconsist) use, and these lights are holding up extremely well! I will be ordering another set for my classroom.

I was looking for a durable, indoor solution for an occasional light in my daughter's room. When I opened the box, I almost didn't unwrap them because they were nothing to look at, they almost looked cheap. I decided I'd give them a single go but I was ready to send them back if they didn't perform. BUT THEY DID!! Oh boy, were they nice. Excellent price, bright, a plethora of settings, and very well made for such an unassuming little string of lights. You will NOT be disappointed with these lights!

Gave these lights as a gift for Christmas for use in a bedroom. So far the lights are bright, seem to be durable, and the remote works well in the bedroom environment as long as you have line-of-sight. The LEDs are strung on 3 decent size gauged copper wire that was easy to hang around trip with only push pins. It's only been a week but very impressed so far... Might have to get one for myself. Pictures were taken at 50% brightness setting

We love these lights. We live in Hawaii and when we turn the celing fan lights on, on the patio, it's a bug fest. These are perfect! The remote is cool. I also like being able to change the brightness, whether we're eating dinner (brighter) or just sitting outside (dimmer). I'm totally not in to the flashing or strobe effect. But that's just me. It makes me nautilus. I was unsure about the copper wire at first but it's very pretty! We ended up lacing it thru the railing. So I love the copper wire. Be careful taking the lights out of the box. They can easily tangle. I'm not sure there is any way around this on the packaging end. So be aware! I would definitely purchase more sets.

review_title: Very nice, but remotes are fussy. They can be used without the remotes.
review_text: These look really nice and appear sturdy, but the remote control function is very fussy. We hooked up 4 sets of these and the remotes would only work on one. You can pull out the remote module, so we did and now we just switch by timer, and have no dimming capacity.

I almost thought about getting the version without the remote as it was a couple dollars less, but what a great little addition!! I strung these lights on top of my kitchen cabinets through some flower arrangements, and to make the artwork/vases up there more visible at night, and it was the perfect addition! It's a very warm, yellow light; not too bright, but perfect for a little mood lighting. And the remote is such a helpful addition (though you do have to get the angle just right for the receiver on top of the cabinets to pick up on the signal.) 10/10 would purchase again.

review_title: Superb customer service and a great product
review_text: The lights are fantastic! Sadly, my little dog ate the remote a few nights after I decorated my mantle with them. Better yet, the customer service is wonderful. A sales person followed up with me via email to check in on my purchase. I told her about the incident, and she replied back that they would send me a new remote for free! Needless to say, I was delighted. I'll definitely be buying more lights in the future, as they are bright, warm, easy to use and very festive. Plus, I'm always appreciative of good customer service. In fact, I'm not one to write reviews, but the customer service warranted it.

review_title: What can I say? These lights are fun!
review_text: The kids are super psyched about these lights and I have ordered more to string around windows and doors in the house. I like that the remote works. Always a plus. I haven't tried them outside yet, but may get around to that. Who doesn't need more sparkle in their life?

I loved these! I used them in my dorm room this semester to add some brightness. There are a million uses for them, and so far they're held up so well. My only complaint is that they are a little stuck in the coil shape, so it takes some twisting to get them straight. Love all the ideas people have for them. Being able to control all the settings is a really neat little feature too. Update: Still so impressed with these and this company! Excellent customer service.

review_title: Just wound the wire around them and was good to go
review_text: I framed my ceiling with these using pins and preexisting nails. Just wound the wire around them and was good to go! I love the dimming settings - it provides just enough light but is soft enough to not be bothered by it. You can also set it to dim from low to high and back again at various speeds, which is actually pretty soothing. My only complaint is that the remote only works from less than a foot away, which isn't very practical for a remote...I have the receiver also nailed to my wall in plain view, so it's a bummer I have to get up so close just to change the settings.

I love these lights! My husband built me a palm tree to commemorate our honeymoon in the Keys, and I wanted subtle lights that wouldn't take away from the beauty of the wood. These are perfect with the adjustable brightness. And, I love that we can adjust the other settings to switch things up when we have a gathering at the house to keep things interesting. This is my second set because when we moved, I lost the other remote. I've actually looked around the house to see where else we could use these, I like them so much.

review_title: These are very cool string lights
review_text: These are very cool string lights. The remote is really cool and for someone that likes to changes patterns and blinking options, it would be great fun. I don't have a real idea on the durability because I have only had them a month. They can be hung in many patterns. The string is flexible. The lights do not get hot because they are LED. They are bit expensive but if you are looking for something more than a set of christmas lights, these are pretty good. I think you could use these in a variety of applications for decorating.

review_title: Used these to frame a picture wall with lighting
review_text: I'd give these a 5 star if they weren't so finicky. If you pull too tight or wrap too tight they won't turn on. And by too tight I mean just a little bit. It doesnt take much and they won't turn on. So wrap them and hang them somewhat loose and you'll be set. Other tha that these are so awesome. The settings are really cool.

review_title: Awesome and the perfect light for bunk beds!
review_text: These little lights are incredible - super adorable too! Bought to liven up the bottom bunk and my older daughter who is on the top.l bunk lost her mind with jealousy and so we quickly purchased another set for her. Gives off the perfect glow and has a plug in so I don't have to worry about batteries! So the pic was taken with Snapchat so ignore the butterflies, lol!

These lights are awesome! Super flexible, I was actually really surprised by that. And the lights are crazy bright. I love that you can adjust it with the controller. I lined them up on a tapestry I bought and it looks great. Thank you!

I was looking for a solution for a soft light to read in bed. These lights are amazing! The copper is super light and flexible so you can place these lights literally anywhere. I love the remote - what a really useful feature. I can read comfortably on setting 2 with 10 being the brightest. I love the soft light and the ambiance they add to my bedroom. These could be used for so many different reasons and occasions.

These lights are exactly as described, very easy to use. They don't get hot, which is a relief, and the remote control is simple and remembers the last program. They are practically weightless and could be used to decorate practically anything.

These lights are well made & perfect for my son’s room. I used clear push pins & ran the lights around the ceiling in his room. They serve as his night light. They’re way better than cable lights IMHO. Will buy again without hesitation.

The 33 ft 100 LED Sting Lights with Dimmer are fantastic. I wish they had the 66 ft available when I ordered but we have had these lights for over a year on our patio and they are beautiful. The warm light is pleasant and festive. The remote is great, I love changing the settings depending on the occasion. Happy with my purchase.

I ordered one of these in May but was only able to install it in July. Right out of the box, the connecting cords fit loosely. I had to hold them together for the string to stay lit. I informed the company and was told “ if there is no Amazon order, we couldn’t create a RMA order to arrange a replacement for you, hope you understand.” I looked up the order and the return window closed a month after I bought it. Never happened to me before on Amazon. Can’t recommend. Total disappointment.

I ordered these lights a few months ago (and again this week) to use in place of a bedside lamp and for decoration. They work beautifully! They give a soft glow with or without the gauze over them, but bright enough to read by too! And the remote is perfect. And their customer service is amazing. I accidentally dropped my remote in glass of water by my bed, ugh. I emailed them directly and they are sending me a new one. I can’t wait for Christmas to use my second set on my tree.

I love how cute these lights look! They’re perfect except for one thing. I ordered warm white but these lights appear to be cool white. That’s a huge thing for me because cool white light is not relaxing. The lights look somewhat warm in photos but everyone that has seen them agrees that they are cool. I wish they were warmer. Besides that, everything is great. I have had no issues with the remote and the length was perfect.

Very nice lights, but be careful not to break the fragile wire that links them all together. If the wire gets broken by a staple, thumb tack, or anything else, the entire string of lights stops working. I recommend hooks or tape if you want to hang them up. That is my only complaint with these lights. The dimming feature is real nice. I have mine around the perimeter of a stained glass window, and the ability to dim them is great. Plus, the 5 watts they use won't blow up my electric bill.

Used them under a netting canopy for a comfy reading nook. I loved how easy they were to arrange, and how lightweight they are! I'm very pleased, it's exactly what I was only hoping for. The only improvement that I could think of is if the plug/cord were white they would blend a lot better with the background. The remote has many options for brightness, which is nice. I will buy them again in the future.

review_title: Not 2700k or warm/yellow as advertised or pictured - more white or a 4000k color temperature.
review_text: These are NOT 2700k or a warm/yellow as advertised! More like 4000k or a pure white temperature. Unfortunately, I bought it couple months ago and only quickly checked to see if it worked. I just now went to install them and realized this so I can't return them. Also, the range for the remote is pretty awful. It will turn on at a distance of only 13 feet and will only turn off at just 6 feet. Update - April 21: I was contacted by the seller, SunValleyTek and was told they should be 2700k so maybe I received the wrong lights. But take that for what it is. They did refund me which was really nice.

review_title: They work well and offer good lighting. The adjustability is extremely useful to blend ...
review_text: I have used these as supplemental to larger lights on an year-round artificial tree. They work well and offer good lighting. The adjustability is extremely useful to blend with the others. I would have bought more, but the Amazon site seemed to limit me to just one set. Overall, very pleased with performance and at a good price point.
The remote is perfect just don’t put the sensor behind your bed like I did by accident

It's nice and beautiful but less than 2 days after I got it all intertwined with my plant stand, one of my cats came along and obliterated the hair-thin cord in about a half of a second. Very thin and fragile! Put it somewhere where it won't be disturbed or you'll quickly be very sad.

Oh Oh. Better unwind real carefully. It was a bit of a challenge to unwind. I ended up just stretching it out on the floor. The challenge comes because it is very easy to get it tangled.....which of course happpened to me. But all is well in the end.
If you get up in the middle of the night, this is a must have so you don't trip.. We put it all along the bottom of our king bed and it is awesome especially if you have dogs that sleep by your bed

I LOVE this strange of twinkle lights! The copper wire is lovely and really gives the light strange an elegant look. I hung these around my office at work for a festive fall ambiance and they are just perfect! Several oos and ahhs received as people walked by and saw them. Will be ordering additional strands for home!

review_title: Decorating my entire house with these lights!!
review_text: I am so happy with the purchase of these string lights!!!!! I have been playing around with them in terms of where I want to place/ position them, and I have come to find that these lights look great on every inch of my house! I will be purchasing a few more of these lights soon because I am in love with how beautiful they make each space in the house. I would definitely recommend these lights to anybody searching for string lights. The packaging of these lights was also wonderful and there was no tangling of the string lights at all. Overall, the item is beautiful and looks very gentle when placed onto anything or anywhere. Love this product!

review_title: they wrapped it in a circle which was fine until the end and they wrap it around the ...
review_text: Just the right light setting, I would have given it a 5 until you have to spend 45 minutes untangling the wires after you pull it out of the box. It has 3 strands and for some awful reason, they wrapped it in a circle which was fine until the end and they wrap it around the inside. When you pull the end out, it snags on all the LED light bulbs and the strands come apart and you spend forever trying to get it untangled. But, after all that its great.

review_title: These lights perform better than expected--
review_text: My wife likes lights around the window and when the white xmas lights died I started searching Amazon for a suitable replacement. After sifting through hundreds of offerings I finally decided on trying out this product. I was not disappointed, and more importantly neither was the wife. These are 10X better than xmas lights for decorating and they appear to be extremely well made and easy to use thanks to the malleable copper wire which can be bent, shaped, wrapped, etc. with no adverse affect on the function of the lights. N.B: we did not hook up the remote so I cannot comment on that part of the package.

Claims they can be used outside, but after 3 months they are very dim. I placed these lights under the patio stairs so that the light would bleed through the cracks allowing people to easily see the steps. They are on a timer, and turn on for a few hours a day. As mentioned above, 3 months later and there is little to no light bleeding through the steps. I have tried to adjust the brightness setting on the remote, but it looks like they are at their maximum. The wires allow for creating a great shape and slip between the patio boards perfectly to create a glowing feeling under your feet. It was very neat for the first couple months.

These lights are so cool! I bought them to replace the string of lights I had in my bedroom. (I'm still in college without a living room so string lights in my room isn't tacky yet). They are super easy to put up because they are so light and the coper wire can bend around tacks and other items on walls. The lights come with a remote that does super cool stuff. The lights can flash and stuff but the coolest part is the gradual dimming and lighting. If it's what your into, the lights will definitely make your room more romantic.

review_title: Very happy with the led string lights.
review_text: I have been using these lights to light up my room kinda like night light for the last 5 months. I have it hidden on top of the vertical blinds and it reflects the light on the wall and ceiling. I was so happy with this one that last month I purchased the multi color one from the same vendor. I only tried them in a few places but they are still in their box and not being used. I would recommend these lights to anyone. They are also UL certified.

These lights are really pretty. One minor issue is that the part that connects to the battery sensor does not fit well. It does not stay plugged together tightly and easily slips off with a slight tug. Customer service was excellent in trying to resolve the issue but I think that’s just how they are. Still, they are beautiful, twinkling lights and worth the purchase.

LOVE LOVE LOVE these lights. These are the ONLY string lights I have ever owned that last more than a year. They have made it through three apartments with me. I have three sets and will probably order more. Incredibly durable. Love that they don't require bulbs or batteries. Get ever so slightly dimmed after a year's use but hold up very well to constant use. Very lightweight and easy to put up, hardly visible when not on. The remote works for an quantity purchased which is great. Would definitely recommend.

WOW - how disappointing. I finally got to open this, it was supposed to be for our Christmas tree and it is BEYOND tangled. In various places. I cannot begin to describe how frustrating this is, an hour just passed and I still cannot untangle it. It's just all over the place and different knots everywhere. It came in a circle shape, thinking it was going to be fine and once I started pulling it out, there are knots everywhere.

review_title: Love them. This is my second time ordering them
review_text: Love them. This is my second time ordering them. This time I'm working on a project for a friend. So I'll use the lights for her. My first set that I bought is still working great! I know I'll be ordering more in the near future Thank you so much for your product

review_title: Got 2, 1 stopped working after a day.
review_text: I love the gold and how I can adjust the light. One of them stopped working and I'm not sure why. I tried everything to readjust and plug the adapter into the one that wasn't responding and it's still not working.

These lights are lovely - I purchased as a deal during the Holidays. The lights can be strung in so many ways, and the remote allows setting a wide number of patterns. We initially received with a damaged remote, but the lights were beautiful even without the variations. Contacted TaoTronics about the remote which they replaced immediately at no charge. The lights are even better wham they can be turned on & off by remote! Great product and great company backing up their product!
I leave a string plugged in around my balcony and have some strung across the top perimeter of the shower. These create great mood lighting for a glass of wine on the balcony or a relaxing bath.

I bought a few of these string lights, for my plants, for the wall shelves...whatever, and they just look beautiful. They're so dainty, soft and elegant. They really make an area look that must more beautiful but not overwhelming. I absolutely love these lights!

review_title: Worked great for over my kitchen cabinets!
review_text: I purchased a few sets of these and decided to try one for over my kitchen cabinets. It worked out really nice and gives a nice warm glow when the overhead lights are off. I'm very pleased with the results.

review_title: Very durable with a really nice twinkle!
review_text: These are GREAT!! Very easily bendable and twinkle. Have been looking for something to light up my Nativity scene and this does the trick and was easy to put away also. Can’t wait to put them back up (soon!)

review_title: Very pretty lights with a widely variable level of brightness (10 ...
review_text: Very pretty lights with a widely variable level of brightness (10 levels), controlled by remote and can be set to stay on, or blink or fade off and on. I can't imagine what other options a string of light could possibly have, unless you want them to change color. The highest brightness is bright enough to light a small room well enough to read and the lowest level provides a nice glow.

review_title: So many usages of these sweet lights.
review_text: I got two sets of these before Christmas. They are plugged in every day and still work great. Pictures don't do them justice but you can get the idea. Each photo has only one string of lights.

review_title: The lights are great! My remote that came with them did not ...
review_text: The lights are great! My remote that came with them did not work, the company graciously sent me another one but I couldn’t get that to work either. They suggested putting a new battery in but I felt that it was foolish to have to replace the battery in a new item and since it was two remotes I’m not sure if it’s that or me. The lights are great and the company is very professional. The only thing I would change would be to have instructions about the remote and of course to have new working batteries in them. Overall I’m impressed with the company and I guess grateful for the exercise I get since the remote doesn’t work:))

The color is wrong entirely. Not warm white. Very cold. I've tried to get used to it, but it just isn't cozy at all. apparently the color has changed because the pictures will mislead you into thinking it is a much warmer more yellow tone. my friend bought them a couple of years ago and his are completely different color.

Perfect! These were SO EASY to work with! And the color is absolutely perfect. I spent so long trying to find the right lights and if you're looking THIS IS IT! My roommate walked into my room right when I finished and asked where she could buy them - BOOM! She bought the 99ft and it came the next day and now she has them up in her room too :)

Ordered six. One immediately broke. Returned and had to purchase another one at full price. Two more broke a few weeks later. I was not very happry with the product. TaoTronics contacted me via email and replaced the broken lights. Was not happy but their customer service is exceptional and has changed my review. They proved to put the customer first. Thank you TaoTronics.

Love these lights! The photo shows them on a very dim setting since I just wanted them to accent the room instead of light it up. You get a ton of lights, plus they don't get hot and use almost no power. I don't see a downside to these at all.

Used everyday for over a year and still work and look perfect. Prefect lighting for watching a movie in the living room, lighting up the kitchen when grabbing a glass of water or room to add ambiance.

I love these lights. They look elegant and the settings are pretty wide range so they're really easy to personalize to your lighting preference. Not to mention how beautiful the strand is with all copper instead of cheap green or white plastic. I haven't had them long so I can't speak on durability, but they are really well made and the package is very professional. I feel pretty confident they will hold up.

review_title: Very nice lights. They are small LED lights on a ...
review_text: Very nice lights. They are small LED lights on a thin copper wire so you can bend it to conforn whatever shape you want. Remote control is nice but needs to be with a couple feet from the control box to respond. Lights are a nice warm white color that is dimmable with various settings to make them flash, etc.

Beautiful lights. I ordered three as gifts, people loved them, except one remote died almost immediately. Tried troubleshooting by swapping batteries, using a different remote. Even did the little trick where you can see infrared light via your phone camera (science!). Unfortunately it was definitely the remote that kicked the bucket. So 5 stars for the lights, 1 star for the remote =(.

review_title: Color is significantly whiter than the picture makes it seem.
review_text: Very nice looking lights, though the wires that connect to the controller don't stay plugged in (I used electrical tape to keep them together), and the color temperature is significantly whiter than the picture appears on Amazon.
Really nice for decorating, just really hard to put up, and the power cord is huge, heavy, and unsightly. It makes it hard to hide the huge ugly power cord and takes away from the beauty of it.

Horrible. Ordered a set and one of the wires snapped just trying to gently unravel it, straight out of the package. Sent those back and bought a second pair. They finally showed up (late) and these don't work at all! So frustrating. I need them for a project, but I'm going to have to send them back again and just look elsewhere for my lights.

These lights give a room a beautiful feel! The untangling was a bit annoying, it's wound up like a waterhose, but it's copper so it kept getting tangled . After I got it all set up though it was worth it !

review_title: otherwise you'll be like me and think they're defective
review_text: Make sure to double tap the remote for your selection, otherwise you'll be like me and think they're defective... Lack of real instructions in the box didn't help either... Anyway, let's talk performance, well... The five star speaks for itself, order and enjoy!!
So far, so good. Bought these for the dimming feature to use in my daughters room. The only thing I don't like is that the color is much more 'cool' rather than 'warm' white as stated.

This was my 1st time trying copper lights and I could not be more happy! I did not do a good job of reading on the project and was very happy to discover there are dimmable! The remote is great and my daughter loves uses the many different lighting options for our Christmas tree. Much to my surprise, the company provides an 18month warranty; which I love. I am hopeful these light will have a long lasting life! I am very happy with the purchase and the quality of what I received for such a great price!

I love these things. I now have about 20 sets. Using them for outside and inside Christmas lights, and I use them year round to light up the landscaping in my back patio. My only wish is that they were cheaper. One suggestion for anyone thinking of using these outside, you need to wrap the power supply in a plastic bag to keep them dry, they will fail if they get too much water in them, but that's not specific to these power supplies, any power supply will fail under the same conditions.
The lights are fine but they look like a softer candle light in the picture but they are actually a very bright, very white light.

These lights created the outdoor patio feel I wanted on my balcony. Remote is the perfect accessory to make it easier to turn on and off without unplugging. Very bright. I'll probably leave up during the holidays.

This product is everything I expected it to be plenty length and brightness. Packaging was nice and presentable and all accessories were included. Only complaint is that I was not able to use all the functions of these lights due to the remote not working, I am waiting on a response from the sellers of this product, will upgrade my review when problem is addressed... which I’m sure will.

review_title: My college kid has the coolest dorm!
review_text: Worked great! bought two sets for dorm walls and my daughter used one right away. It was longer than expected so she hasnt had to use the second yet. She loves the extra features for color and more. The girls love to come hang in her dorm and use the wall lights for movie time! remote is a great feature

review_title: Do yourself a favor! Buy these
review_text: I love how they sparkle! These go perfectly with my room decor. I ordered two because I thought I read a review that I can connect the two but that’s not possible from what the directions say. Which is okay because I didn’t need two really for what I was going for. The light is soft and easy to use with the remote.

review_title: I love these, and so happy that it comes with remote.
review_text: I use these in my bedroom, to outline the window. I'm in love with the fact that they dim and I have a remote. There is dimming the lights to read, settle down or set mood lighting:) They look good with decor and sometimes I keep them on 100% during the day as an addition to my lamps so the room is lit perfectly. I recommend you try this brand, it's been about 3 months and no problems. Make sure you put them where the receiver can contact the remote control (the receiver hangs near the end of the cord so it will hang close to the outlet you choose to plug them in to)

review_title: A good price for the quality
review_text: I bought these as a gift and at first the person was apprehensive. Once they were strung up through the room, she become a big fan! The wire just about disappears and the lights are very powerful. A good price for the quality.

These are so beautiful! I was surprised at just how bright they are. They can be a bit finicky to unroll and set up the way you want because the wire wants to twist, but a little bit of patience goes a long way. Or, you can do what I did, and just (carefully) let them tangle and set them on some mosquito netting above your bed for a lovely fairy canopy.

So easy to put together. Packed so nicely in the box. A beautiful Light. It's not as Super Bright as I thought I needed but it is plenty bright enough. I sew in hair extensions and need to see into dark places, overhead lighting causes shadows. It's got a very sturdy base and the light is big enough to cover a nice area. I love it, it is replacing a more expensive one I got from a fancy store at the Mall.

review_title: I Can't Say Enough Good About These Lights
