review_text: Love love love these lights. They became an easy to install and great looking replacement on an old pre-lite Christmas tree we use on our porch. I also picked up a few sets to set on top of the upper cabinets in the kitchen that give a nice glow at night. I am just going to leave those up all year. Well packed, easy to use, I can't say enough good about these.

Great product, I still didn't get how to make the light warmer, as it looks like just the intensity changes but the color is always the same. Great product though! So many options, good both for house deco and for christmas.

review_title: I love these lights but giving three stars because the package ...
review_text: I love these lights but giving three stars because the package arrived and the remote is not working. I'm going to replace the battery and see if that helps. updating review to five stars Taotronics contacted me immediately about the remote and were happy to replace. These lights are great, the copper wire not only looks cool but makes decorating easier. Now that I have a functioning remote I am enjoying these much more. Would purchase again!

These lights are perfect for the mantle in my home. The remote works well even though you need to hold it close to the base of the string. Not a problem for me. I love the soft glow when dimmed. Even have placed some of the string inside goblets which is magical! I have gotten complements from everyone visiting my home about how they add a welcoming, warm ambiance in the living room. Thinking of a second string for even more fun.

I bought two sets of 33ft 100 LED String Lights Dimmable with Remote Controls for my granddaughter this Christmas. Was she ever surprised. She even sent me a video of the lights on the walls and over her bed. I'm now the coolest grandma around. They were beautiful and easy enough that a 12 year old could do. Being programmable and dimmable gives her the freedom to go from strobe to very slow and bright to dim lighting. Thank you Tao Tronics for such a excellent product. I would definitely recommend this product to everyone.

review_title: Don’t work for long don’t buy
review_text: Stopped working after a few months of light use. Not a battery issue or a wall issue. Waste of money.

review_title: Fantastic. Very bright but can also be dimmed
review_text: UPDATE: I forgot to update forever ago but turned out these lights only worked for about a week and then wouldn't come on. Piece of crap. Don't waste your money. Fantastic. Very bright but can also be dimmed, set to flashing, fading in and out, or strobe. Super long! Very easy to hang and manipulate into any shape. Only downside- Be careful when you take them out of the package. It comes looped up and can tangle easily. Not impossible, and tangles are fairly easy to undo but if you're impatient these may make you mad...

review_title: I would recommend the remote have a further range though
review_text: Didn't know what to expect when I ordered two boxes of these lights. I wish I could make these myself! They're a dream creation for a crafter who wants to add some flair to a small project. The remote control is just icing for the cake! I would recommend the remote have a further range though. You have to be about 2.6 feet or closer to operate the remote. Of course I could try changing the battery to see if that helps. Not the "curtain of lights" I was thinking but I made it work. Best for small crafts and comes as battery operated as well!

LOVE THESE SO MUCH! Although I would never use the strobe affect makes you feel like you might have a seizure.. too intense. Other than that they give my room the perfect touch! I personally love the lowest brightness light level still enough light and sets a nice tone to the atmosphere. UPDATE: Remote no longer works and the wiring on the lights is messsd up. Very sad :(

Love these little lights! The copper wire is so subtle - once you get it where you want it, it basically disappears. I put it up in my office and it's great - on the brightest setting, I can turn off my main florescent light and my office looks more warm, cozy and inviting. They're staying up permanently. The little remote control is great too - it really does work well in an office!

I wish I could give this product one star. After just one use these lights broke. The copper was too hot while the lights were on and burned through/melted breaking the line in half and making the product unusable. The remote control is also horrible. It took several minutes for me to even get the lines on because the remote's signal wasn't being picked up. Had to have the remote right against the box connecting to the outlet.

Beautiful lights that add the perfect touch to our living area. I love how they can easily be adjusted with the remote and that there are many different brightness and flash settings. The wire is thin so it does not look gaudy during the day like traditional Christmas lights. I only wish that the adapter cord were white instead of black so it would blend into the surroundings a little more.

review_title: the lights are beautiful and work great
review_text: Thought my first remote was defective, I sent an e-msil to the company with no response. I bought another set for by headboard, the lights are beautiful and work great, the remote is awful, customer service was not impressive.

review_title: These might be the best Christmas tree lights ever
review_text: These might be the best Christmas tree lights ever. The strands don't connect, but they can all be controlled by the same remote and the dimming/twinkling options are great. The minimal heat from the bulbs is a good, because all of our tree's ornaments are fabric. (We have pets...) The wire is very fine and I suspect we'll be swearing a lot when it's time to take the tree down, but it will be well worth it. These lights are terrific.

Favorite thing ever! The remote is amazing. I always crawl into bed and then will turn the lights off by the remote when ready. Dimming features are awesome! I've had mine for a long time and they're like new. Buy this!

review_title: They are amazing! The fact that we can dim the lights ...
review_text: We put these in my daughter's room behind a curtain and she uses them as her nightlight. They are amazing! The fact that we can dim the lights comes in handy, too! We can keep them at their brightest when we read stories, but then dim them halfway for bed. It's perfect! I'm thinking of getting another set or two for our deck, but in a perfect world I'd find an excuse to put them in every room in the house...

I bought these to go with a tapestry I had purchased for my bedroom and they were perfect. Only complaint is that they tangle easily (which is expected) so have someone help you hang them. Otherwise zero complaints. Perfect. Not battery operated but they're long enough to hide the plug and extra cord. Love that they have a remote. Great purchase.

review_title: The remotes are very short-ranged (a maximum of about twelve ...
review_text: The remotes are very short-ranged (a maximum of about twelve feet), even if you align the pickup in the direction from which you will usually be using the remote. Treat them very gently (no stapling/nailing etc., excessive bending, or frequent relocation), and they'll hold up quite well for the price.

This light worked great for my son's 3d printed 'Thor' lamp (posted on Thingiverse by user Framingr).... At least for a couple weeks. The remote/sensor is not changing the dimness or turning the lights on/off unless you press the remote about 100 times! Super frustrating when you are putting your 2 yr old to bed. So I went to Lowes and bought an on/off inline switch and put it on for about $2 and trashed the remote/sensor.

They are very versatile. I love that they can be dimmed. I won't use the other features, the flashing and fading effects although I can see that that would be fun for other purposes as these are just for my indoor decor. I'm only giving them 4 stars because I can't figure out how to be them on a timer. Unless I use a separate timer outlet?

I put these lights inside the top edge of my large dark entertainment unit to highlight the decor items I have on the top. I attached the lights across the inside top front, back, and sides of the unit using heavy duty tape to secure them to the wood. The remote control makes it very convenient to turn on and off. This is a very inexpensive and easy way to turn your entertainment unit and decor into a very classy focal point of your room.

The lites are awesome! I put them on two shelves in my kitchen and it is the perfect light because we like it on the 10% mode. You can go all the way up to 100% by tens. Easy to install and I really like the remote because the shelves are high up. The light also do strobe and flash which we do not like. If you have a sign and need for it to be seen, then the flash mode would be great. The small wire bends very easy, so be gentle with that. I had no breakage of the wire!!

Ordered a second and third set to finish off my living room trim. Love them but every one I opened and plugged in did not immediately work. I left them plugged in for a while then after a few hours they worked and I never had a problem again, even with my set I have had over 2 years. I’m guessing someone could tell me what the problem was- but they all work now so I’m glad I did not throw them out!

review_title: You Have to Find a Use For These!!!!
review_text: Love these lights! Lined a glass china cabinet with them and now all my "pretties" are visible and since the lights don't get hot, I can leave the cabinet lighted all day and all night. The ability to brighten or dim the lights is great! love playing around with the different settings to match my mood.

I bought it one month ago within Christmas. When I reciewed the item, the first emage was not good to me,It didnt just look like a good quality.After two days,It just worked for two days,and it broke by no reason.I couldn’t find out what issues inside the item.

Hoping for some tangle free holiday lights, I ordered these because they were inexpensive. It's basically a turn copper strand with tiny LEDs glued in place. Theyre fairly bright once you get it unraveled and hung up..and they contoller is nice for effects and for furing them on and off. Time will tell if they are dependable, but for the money theyre not a bad value.

I'm completely in love with these. They're so dainty that my husband didn't even notice I'd put them up (wrapped around our headboard). And having a remote? So amazing! I can dim them, I can turn them on and off, I can set them to flash or pulse! I am the queen of the fairy lights and they must obey my every whim!!! Can't wait for an excuse to buy more. Pictures to come.

review_title: I am glad I bought two sets
review_text: I am glad I bought two sets. The remote on one set did not work. I replaced the battery with no luck. I am glad the other remote in the other set works well for both . I love the lights. I put them in a tinted vase and use it for an evening light in my kitchen when I'm not in there. The only reason I gave it 3 stars was because of the faulty remote. Otherwise I would have given it 5 stars.

This is a neat little light set. I used small eye hooks to hang it from our pergola (yes, the wire and LEDs will fit thru them). I also modified a small "sandwich size" waterproof plastic box to allow wires to go in / out from the bottom, then mounted it to the pergola. I inserted the electric connectors/adapters inside the box, connected to an extension cord, and sealed it up. Now all I do is plug it in and use the remote to adjust the brightness or whatever. It works great!

review_title: Easy to use, but not “warm white”
review_text: The lights and remote are great. Very easy to put up. My only complaint is that they are not really a warm white color. The color is more of that led bright white color. I have to figure out where to use these now, since the color does not match my other lights. Other than the color, the item is great.

We've bought many of these over the past few years and love them. Our kids use them to line the ceilings in their rooms as well as path lighting in our theater and even for Christmas decorations. They only use 1 - 8 watts of electricity and the quality of the light is great.
A minimalist design with a great amount of light. We used these to decorate windows. The wires hide well and are easy to install without the weight. Highly recommended.

This wasn't long enough to wrap around the perimeter of the ceiling of my room, but that was my fault for not measuring it before purchasing these lighs. Regardless, the lights are very pretty, and I love the many settings the remote offers! I love being able to change the lights based on what I'm feeling. Very great product for the price. Thank you, TaoTronics!

review_title: Great product. Works well. Everything is included.
review_text: We ordered another so-called dimmable option, but it required a 9v dimmer. This one however worked right out of the box as described. Everything you need is present, all you need is an outlet to plug it in to. It looks well made, the remote is great and functions perfectly. I am very happy and would recommend it to any friend or family. I thinking of buying another one just to have it. I don't need it, but I sure I can find a place for it.

Bought these when the price dropped below $16.00. I have only tested the lights and remote to make sure everything works and it was just as described. These led string lights are very bright at full power but the remote allows dimming in steps. If I had one suggestion for the manufacturer it would be to allow the remote to step down the light level a few more steps or incorporate the ability to dim the light continuously from off to full brightness. This would allow more creativity and flexibility for ambient or mood lighting.

review_title: The defective piece was replaced promptly
review_text: When I purchased this item one month ago, it did not work with the remote. On my complaint, the seller took it back and apologized for the defective peice. He also gave me another piece for free. This new piece is working absolutely fine. However, I would request the seller to include detailed instructions for attaching different parts of the item in the information book. Moreover, all pieces must be examined thourouly before despatch to the buyers.

review_title: Lights are nice! Remote doesn't work :(
review_text: I love the lights, but one of the main reasons I chose this one was for the remote, which does not work at all. I tried changing the battery and checking in the battery compartment to be sure there wasn't anything in it obstructing something - nope. Just broken. Disappointing for sure :( But at least the lights are nice!

I wasn't paying attention and assumed these would be 12v like the other, similar lights I ordered were. Same barrel plug, which seems like it could be a problem if you got them mixed up (the chip is only rated to 5.5v and no on board buck) I swapped the plug out with a USB cable.

Love the lights, but unfortunately the remote doesn't work correctly after only using for Christmas last year. It will change "some" of the speeds, but not all, and will not turn off or on, so I just unplug. Do miss not being able to set speed of twinkle though. All in all still like the little lights, would be awesome for a wedding. Tiny lights on a copper wire, very pretty.

I like these lights a lot! I put them inside a cloche and made a "lamp" and it looks exactly like what I was going for. The only reason I did not give five stars is because I ordered soft white and they are a bright white. Not sure if I got sent the wrong ones or if they are just brighter than described.

review_title: and they are perfect! I love that they have a remote
review_text: I bought these lights to use in my bedroom re-do, and they are perfect! I love that they have a remote, and the lights themselves have a kind of "twinkle" look to them. I can put them behind fabric and never have to worry about them burning hot. The price can't be beat either. I will definitely buy these again.

review_title: Very nice light set with lots of possibilities
review_text: I was pleasantly surprised by these. It is a very thin copper wire and the remote provides 0,10,20... to 100 dim settings. and other flash and fade settings. I am planning on running these under our kitchen cabinets and also outside on our steps up to the house. it provides a nice bright light, copper wire is easy to bend and fit around objects.

review_title: The color is a lot whiter than the pictures. ...
review_text: The color is a lot whiter than the pictures. It's definitely not a warm white, but the dimming effect helps lessen the bright white. A few of the lights on the string just don't work. I'm not sure if I just got a defective product or if they're all mediocre quality.

This was the best purchase EVER! We needed something to light up our covered back porch and I wasn't sure if these would be bright enough. After reading the reviews and clearly people saying they were bright, AND it comes with a remote. It's absolutely perfect. I am glad it comes with a remote because with it on high, they are quite bright. I love them and want to find something else that I need to "light up", just to order more!

review_title: The remote function works fine but that was not exactly the feature I was ...
review_text: They are not "warm" they are a bright white light. That was really the only reason I bought this was because I wanted a warm glow... The remote function works fine but that was not exactly the feature I was looking forward to the most.
Smells like chemicals. Put it in the basement near my hepa air cleaner for months with the box open. Smell would not go away. I cannot say whether it worked or not because I never used it.

this is actually the worst light i’ve ever purchased. i am being 100% serious when i say they worked for a solid 10 minutes. then they just stopped. no more light after plugging in multiple times, and the remote also didn’t work straight out of the box. if I could give this product negative stars, i would.

I wanted a dim lamp and also was thinking of ways to hang up my pictures to decorate my dorm. Oh my these are perfect! The remote is well worth it. There's a bunch of settings, but I just use the three buttons 10, 50, and 100 for the brightness levels. I am definitely going to pack it up and set it up all over again when I get back to the states.

review_title: Exactly what I was looking for!
review_text: These lights far exceeded my expectations. When shopping for lights to use in s floor lamp I'm making I was skeptical that I would find something so perfect for my needs. It's nice to be surprised. Very well made and functional. The IR sensor for the remote is perfect and I even like the screw holes so I can permanently affix it to the interior of my lamp. Highly recommend!

review_title: Liked the idea but remote was broken
review_text: Ill try it again and order another one. Out of the box the remote didn't work. Returned. Will certainly give another try and will then review again to give honest assessment with a working one.

review_title: a good product, but just not for us
review_text: hello, this product has all of the bells and whistles. but, the copper wire stood out for all of our applications and took away from the design of the scenery. it is hard to hide copper wire if that is what you want in a lighting situation. but if you are in the market for a well built lighting product, this is the one. (only if you can hide the copper wire) we returned it for credit... a good product, but just not for us

My first order for these lights came in defective. They would not turn on. When I contacted the company, they offered to send me a replacement set and they worked perfectly. The lights give off a nice glow for a dark spot around my house . And I like that I can adjust the intensity of the lights. They are perfect for what I needed.

review_title: One was Dead on arrival, other one died after six months
review_text: There's no reason to buy the two pack at all. Just get the individual ones times 2. After I put one of them up on my ceiling,I realized the other one didn't even work brand new. At that point I didn't even want to stand up on the chair again. The one that I did use stopped working. I was moving my hamper and brushed by it. Boom, the end. So it was a total waste of 30 something dollars.

review_title: Very nice set of lights for a decent price.
review_text: The lights are tiny and come on a nice long strand. Having the remote is a bonus. You can dim the lights or have them on bright, but the bright setting is not overwhelming. I was so impressed that I bought two more sets. One thing to note, you will need to have the remote and antennae plug in relatively close in clear view to communicate to get the lights to turn on/off. Although some may find this as an issue, I feel that if you know this you can plan accordingly and set the plug in with in reach.

review_title: Failed to work after one time.
review_text: Bought if 12/2017. Used it for one Christmas and packed and set it away. Now second year, does not work anymore. Installed a new battery in the remote, still no light. $15 for one time lighting is way to expensive. Hope you all find a better place / item to spend / buy.

review_title: I'm so happy with my purchase
review_text: I'm so happy with my purchase. These lights are a bright and cheerful addition to any home. Looks good bunched up on a table with taper candles and other holiday decorations. The copper wiring is thin and allows you to easily wrap around lamp posts, pillars, etc. Great for decorating year round - you have numerous brightness settings and strobing effects. We keep them on the lowest setting (10), which makes for a beautiful, subtle night light glow.

Love these copper wire lights! They are strung along my front porch and I love the remote control that lets me turn them on or off or make them brighter. We live on the Georgia coast so it is hot humid and salty and they are performing well. Like them much better than regular light strings. My only improvement would be to have white or clear plug and cord instead of black.

review_title: Great lights for a great price
review_text: These string lights are amazing. The wire makes them easy to shape, and the little lights are amazing. At full brightness, they light up the entirety of my dorm room, and the lowest setting is just enough to be able to see your surroundings without it seeming like a light is on. I hung these around my window and bed frame, and they are perfect for reading, doing homework, watching TV, etc. You can even change the setting and turn them on and off from around the room as long as you're pointing at the outlet plug. If you are looking for string lights, I highly recommend these.

I loved these lights. Unfortunately, the love affair didn't last. I bought them in mid-October and hung them near the ceiling in my bedroom. When insomnia spoiled my rest, I would turn them on and enjoy the lovely glow. Christmas week they just died. They were on and then they weren't. Nothing I do makes them turn on again. Too bad...they really are lovely little lights. 1/22/17 - I've tentatively updated my rating from 1 star to 3 stars. It's been a month since I first posted. Since then, the supplier has kindly replaced the lights at no cost to me and I once again have these beautiful lights decorating my room. Why only 3 stars when I REALLY like the way these lights look? The first set worked for about 3 months before giving up the ghost. So.....we'll see. I'm hoping for the best...they really are very lovely.

Beautiful, and they set the right tone. We love these in our bedroom or even outside! They really add a calm and nice touch to the vibes in your room. I really like the settings so you are able to dim the lights and brighten them, whatever floats your boat. These are good quality lights and amazingly priced! Love them.

These were just the lights we wanted for our deck. They use little power, they look wonderful--with their adjustable brightness, you can choose the mood you want--and I love having a remote so I can turn them on and off from my back door. And so far the squirrels have not tried to eat their way through the wire, unlike other outdoor lights I bought!

review_title: I bought 2 set's... I have only ...
review_text: I bought 2 set's...I have only had them up for a month,They are under my gazebo out of the weather and just tonight one set is not working,,,My husband said maybe there is a fuse in the box,,,Keeping my fingers crossed,,,Really don't want to have to buy another set,,,The company contacted me and made it right,,This is truly an awesome company,,,It was rare that this happened,, So anyone thinking of buying these lights you will not be sorry,,They are beautiful at night and the different settings are cool also..

I'll give this a 5 because it looked so great when we installed it in the shop windows. For myself (the installer) I get a 1< Star because I broke one of the wires making it inoperable. My fault, make sure and treat these with kid gloves and don't grab the 22oz hammer whatever you do. Reordered again and the windows look great after a CAREFUL install. Fast shipping thank you

Pretty. Very lightweight. Copper wire allows you to bend it and hook it over things. I don't know why I though these were going to be multi-colored. I think I got the wrong idea from the remote with its 6 different colored buttons.

review_title: SOOO Pretty In my white Christmas tree =) I get this ...
review_text: SOOO Pretty In my white Christmas tree =) I get this because it was hard for me to find some light to put in my White tree that didn't have green cable(my mistake to shop decorations right before christmas =P ) and would look terrible . But I'm glad I did cause they look awesome and I like the little remote so you can change for different types of "dimmer actions"...don't know how to call them ? what ever they are pretty lights =)
Only reason I purchased these was due to the remote. Should have purchased the lesser expensive ones without remote and put on a timer or smart plug. Oh well, live and learn.

Works as advertised...and the remote adds a nice bit of variety to the lights. One must be fairly careful in handling lights during installation, as they arrive coiled and must be carefully unwound. As it is copper wire, it's not exactly like stringing your average Christmas lights..... However, they work fine and add a nice touch to a tree that previously had the "old-school" lights on them. Hopefully these will last a long time and I won't have to string that same tree again.

This string of lights is the perfect amount if light to light up my room in the middle of the night so I can see, but I don't feel blinded. I like that there's a remote as well so that I can easily turn them on and off. The only problem I've had with that is that sometimes the off button doesn't pickup as easily as the on button does.

The remote came with dead battery, not good news as we had to purchase new one, it's one of those round 3v Lithium type. The remote is quirky and the buttons are hard to read, due to the lettering be tonal to the button color. We had issues using the remote and getting the light to where we wanted, so we just use an outlet on off switch.

review_title: Amazing lights especially for the price!
review_text: I wasn't expecting anything great for a cheap price. I'm a college student trying to brighten up the basement where my bedroom is and these lights have brightened up the area substantially! I will be buying another set of lights to cover the larger basement area. I am very impressed by these and would recommend them to anyone questioning the quality or anyone struggling to decide whether to buy them or not.

Awful. Stayed on for 15 minutes before dying or dimmed immediately without ability to adjust. UPDATE 12/10: I was contacted by reps and they sent out a new unit to replace the defective one. From what I can tell, this works better but the remote still doesn't work. Eh.

Really nice lights. Very easy to put up and they look great. I put one string up on the wall where it joins the ceiling in my living room and one string in my bedroom. Very, very nice soft romantic lighting. I can adjust the intensity higher or lower with the handy remote.
Every house - and every porch should have these! I love, love the remote. I can set the lights at 10% dim or 100% dim, and every 10th in between. A great housewarming, kid birthday, etc presents.

review_title: Lights Not Stamped UL certified as advertised :(
review_text: just received. Although it says on the site that it is UL certified - it is not listed anywhere I can find on the product or packaging. Will not use as planning in my girl's room. Returning unhappy.

Great product. Minimalist. Lightweight. So far has operated about 16 months with no issues. I gave a set to my friend who really likes it as well. People attending my rooftop party were impressed. Remote is kinda silly but also kind fun. I don't ever really use that aspect of it though.

review_title: Could not be happier with these lights!
review_text: These lights fit perfectly up around the inside of our gazebo using some small Command Strip hooks to hold them in place. We needed 2 strands to go all the way around. We can turn them both on and off with one remote. The dimmer allows us to turn the lights up or down with one click. (Or have some fun and make them strobe) They are tiny and barely noticeable but give off a great source of light at night; not blinding and not too dim. We have had them up since the spring and could not be happier with them. I am thinking about getting a few more sets for outdoor holiday lights around the house!

What beautiful, warm-colored lights. They make everything sparkle and were incredible for a recent house concert where multiple people wanted to know where I had got them. They are very easy to decorate with. When they're not on they are barely noticeable because of such a thin copper wire, but when they're on they add a twinkly, festive quality to the mood. So happy to have them that I bought 3 more packs! The only trouble I have is on the small remote itself. There are many buttons, and the ones down the right side have the deepest blue background color. The black writing on dark blue is very hard to read. Other than that, there are slow and quick flashing modes and dimmable settings by percentage, all controllable from the remote. I recommend highly.

review_title: Haven't had a problem with the control but due to other feedback will be keepingwatch.
review_text: Lights work very well on the fade mode from bright to dim using one strand. Using to add a touch of ambiance to a solar porch at night without having to turn on the overhead lights. 1 set was to string the length of the porch. I have the lights on a programmable switch so am not using the remote. Haven't had a problem with the control but due to other feedback will be keeping watch.

It’s really pretty, and I love the lights, but my remote isn’t working and so I don’t get to turn it on or off, or get any of the light effects I was expecting to. It kinda defeats the purpose of spending a little extra for the effects.

review_title: They shine beautifully and the pliable wiring is convenient for making any ...
review_text: I've had these lights for over a year, I use them every night and they still work perfectly. They shine beautifully and the pliable wiring is convenient for making any kind of design you might want to create. There's nothing more you could want from a product like this! Also, they have amazing costumer service; my remote broke and they sent me a new one at no cost right away!
I bought these to put behind a tapestry and they are beautiful. I've had them for over 6 months now and it's still working perfect. Love the different light intensity settings . This was a great buy!

review_title: Beautiful lights from a company with A+++ customer service
review_text: Beautiful and versatile lights. The functionality allows you to adjust dimming, blinking and brightness. Each of the tiny LED lights is surprisingly bright, and together with the fine wiring, they appear to be stars suspended in the sky. the wiring is flexible but "moldable"; you can flex and bend the wiring to fit whatever shape you wish. I had an issue with my remote control, and the company replied within an hour or my complaint with an expedited replacement. They followed-up to make sure I was very happy with the result. You can trust this company with your purchase.

If dimming the lights, remote becomes unresponsive until youre about 2 feet away. Its a bit annoying to say the least, so Ive decided to keep them at the brightest level so my lazy self doesnt have to get out of bed or be embarrassed in front of my guests (read: cats)

review_title: Perfect tiny lights for the inside of a curio cabinet.
review_text: I bought these to light the inside of a curio cabinet to display china. They work perfectly the wire is so thin it was easy to maneuver between the shelves. At 50% it is the perfect amount of light and makes the cabinet look so beautiful even during the day.

Loved these lights. I put them under the snow for my Christmas village. They made everything easier because they lay so much more flat than strings of Christmas lights. They were difficult to work with because you know that they are delicate and it is difficult to keep them from intertwining. But they stayed on from 11/01 until now (12/26 and still going). Will purchase some more of these for my other villages.

These LED lights were exactly what I needed for my living room. These little LED lights are amazing you can dim, flash or make them fade in and out with the convenient remote control. Would recommend to anyone who wants very nice light set 33ft. I'm going to buy more to complete my living room. Fast deliver.

review_title: I bought this for my son’s teepee at the end ...
review_text: I bought this for my son’s teepee at the end of September, and used it maybe a handful of times, now the lights do not work. I’ve tried unplugging and plugging it again, but the lights will not go on. When I do press the on button, I hear a clicking noise on the receiver but still no lights. Anyway we can exchange for a new one?

I really loved them at first. I hung them on a curtain above my bed, and they looked nice. But after a few weeks they stopped working. The copper string broke in two, I am guessing because of my fan that blows towards it at night. So they are very fragile, if wind can break them. I don't see how else they would of broke, because we never touched them.

review_title: Price, flexibility And ease of use, excellent after 1st month use
review_text: Ordered 2 kinds of these light strings, warm white and all blue. I recommend both for the price, flexibility and ease of use. The warm white is still a little cold white because it's an LED but it looks great and have had no issues. I will probably buy a multi colored string next. After 1 month, I say give it 4 stars. Great decorating solution for my kids secret room/club house. Will definitely buy more.

review_title: Love the brightness and the ease of use
review_text: Used to light a snake cage. Love the brightness and the ease of use. One star knocked off due to thee being no way to turn them on and off easily without the remote and there doesn’t seem to be a wait to purchase a remote separately.
We love using these lights for out grandsons vunkbed. I have them woven in a net that is stapled under the top bunk. I can turn them on a dim them from a remote which helps in not waling him up.

I received these lights in a timely manner and it was packaged well from the supplier. I have not found a space for them yet but plan to use for holiday decorating so that is why I have them a 4-star instead of 5. I have plugged them in to ensure they work & love the remote control for ability to dim or brighten. The wires are very thin and bendable providing options for use - I like them and may purchase more.

These are incredible. I live in a small trailer and have them nailed around the ceiling. They work really well and I actually use them instead of a traditional light. I love that I can turn them off at night using the remote control function & also make them flash or dim! Super neat.
Great amount of lights. Happy that it has a remote. Put them on a wreath on my front door with star fish embellishments for the spring and summer.

They work as advertised. I think it is a good price for a set of lights with remote. However, I'm dissapointed by the fact that they cannot be connected to another set (although I understand that this always happens for this kind of lights). Also, the power adapter is big and cannot be easily hidden.

I bought these lights on a whim over the summer, and I'm so glad I did. I hung them in my bedroom and they add a ton of light and I love having a switch to automatically turn them on/off and change the brightness. The lowest brightness level is perfect for when I'm trying to wake up in the morning, and the max brightness is enough to use instead of my bedrooms overhead light. Highly recommend these lights!

review_title: The product itself is an awesome idea! I love the remote and the ability ...
review_text: The product itself is an awesome idea! I love the remote and the ability to dim the lights. But I had so much trouble trying to get everything out of the package without completely tangling the wire. Also, this just wasn't really what I had pictured when I hung them up without turning them on. In the daytime they looked very strange against my white walls. I would recommend these for trees and other outdoor settings!

I got these lights for my (13 y.o.) daughter's room and she LOVES them! It's a tiny little string of lights, but the wire is pretend for easy install cuz you can bend it or even wrap it around a hook. The remote is her favorite feature because it dims/brightens and even has different pulses. Sure has a typical sized room and they made it a little over halfway around the perimeter of her room. It's easily worth the money!!!!

Worked as described, soo many options with remote. Brightness control, solid on or blinking with speed control. Semi-Flexable material feels a bit fragile but was able to bend and curve it around good enough. It's pretty cool.

This light string is sweet. We hung it under a 12' X 14' awning in a U shape and it is awesome. It has multiple settings which are terrific. The manual is outstanding in that it is written in excellent English. I highly recommend these lights, the string appears to be very good quality.

Lights work. Remote is absolutely useless so they work on bright setting only. Update: Sunvalley emailed me and offered to send me new set. Remote so far works as it should. Nice to be able to dim the lights. Appreciate their customer service.

Really like these lights. We use them during the darker months and place around the house in vases. It offers a soft, warm light. Love the dimming feature. We have purchased other lights before just like this but they've diminished in brightness over time. Hoping these retain their pretty hue. Would recommend.

I love these lights so much! I hung them up around my room and that was the best idea ever. It is a nice soothing light on the lower settings and an amazing overall light at full setting. It's also really nice not having to get up to turn my light off when I go to bed.
Item worked perfectly until the wire split in two, causing only about 1/5 of the lights to work. Lasted about a month and a half, so not worth the money.
The adapter it came with was loose and constantly disconnected causing the lights to go off all the time. They no longer work at all now.

review_title: Why didnt i get 2 right away?
review_text: The only reason why I don't give this 5 stars is because the remote doesn't have very long range. I can't turn them on from the front door as I had hoped. Still, there are so many options...steady, pulse, etc. The lights are adorable and add nice touch to my hallway. I expect light bill to go down and my blinding dog can see at night. So...I'm ordering another one...or two...now.

These lights are beautiful and I would give five stars, however the remote that came with the package didn’t work. I would’ve given the lights three stars after that, but after emailing their customer support staff, their fast and friendly service made me add a star back as they shipped me a free remote without even making me email the first one back. Highly recommend!

These little lights are great! We bought 2 sets. We have one set under our cupboards above the sink and counter and, we use the other set wherever we want. Had them outside on the fence for a party, then took them down so we can use them later. They put off a good amount of light and its a nice, soft, warm light, unlike the LED ones that are cold looking.

review_title: Great customer service by Tao Tronics.
review_text: Remote Power Signal didn't work. Tao didn't have a replacement. I was sent a new set at no charge. This was great since I had put up the string. The are great in the pergola, also added small flood to show off artwork..

review_title: I love the copper wire as my Christmas tree will be ...
review_text: I haven't put them on a tree but plugged them in. I was suprised at how bright they were. My purchase of 2 strings for a 4 to 6 foot Christmas tree seems adequate. I love the copper wire as my Christmas tree will be copper.

review_title: Prettier than pictured and work great!
review_text: These lights are fantastic! They work great and are very subtle, but VERY bright! The color on the photo isn't quite accurate - they are actually much prettier than this photo shows; the wire is more rose gold and the lights are much more clear. The wire is bendable and lightweight, so you can do a little twist around a nail or whatever you're hanging them from. Hopefully they continue to work this well!

I purchased these lights after seeing them at my daughter's house! They are beautiful, so tiny and unique. I love the remote as it allows you to adjust the brightness for your room. No batteries!!!!! The copper wire is almost invisible when lights are on a mantle or bookcase! Great for holidays or special occasions or simply year round!! So many places they can be used. My sister just bought a set too! I'm really pleased with the product and the service!!!
Loved the product first. We installed the lights in our kitchen and they were exactly what we wanted. However, after 3 days they stopped working.

These little lights are fantastic...a great buy for the price...I used them in a Halloween skit and for Christmas decoration..and I will find other uses. There are many different setting and the light level can be controlled easily from dim to bright. Do not hesitate to buy these if you have an application they would be useful for. I'm not easy on stuff and they are pretty durable...all lights stay lit.
I really like these lights, they frame my entire room.

review_title: and they are definitely one of the best investments I made in my first year of school
review_text: I have been using these lights for over a year now, and they are definitely one of the best investments I made in my first year of school. I love having lighting like this in the dorm but have always been concerned about safety, especially with the lights heating up or having issues with cable and wiring. These LED string lights are extremely well made and the wire can be arranged in a variety of ways. The wide range of settings on the lights also affords any level of dimness or mood you may desire. I bought some tiny 3M hooks and strategically placed them along where the wall meets ceiling, and have arranged them to surround my bed. Absolutely love them!

review_title: Great little product, just exactly the size I needed.
review_text: These things are great. I just got them yesterday, so haven't owned them long, but I put them up around the canopy of one of our family's beds. They provide great ambient lighting, and went up great. Just so happens it's the perfect length to go up the wall to the top of the canopy, around the three sides of the canopy, and back down the other side. Very much like it, and may be getting more sets.

review_title: Works great as a night light!
review_text: Bought this as a night light for my son and he loves it. The remote has many cool features that he doesn't quite use, but I'm sure he will in the future as he gets older. He has been using these lights for almost half a year now on a nightly basis and they still work great. I am grateful TaoTronics created this simple yet useful product.

review_title: Untangling copper wire is a lesson in futility
review_text: I bought this for my office to decorate for Christmas. I spent nearly an hour untangling the wire until I finally gave up and decided to turn it into a copper light "ball."
These lights are pretty, but they aren't warm white. They're cool white. The copper wires make them a bit better, but definitely not warm. Did I receive a defective item? I don't know. Returning.

The lights work well. 33ft is not as long as I thought-- used two runs for a very small tree. I really like the dimming function, so the lights can be not-so-bright. They are much whiter than as pictured and a very thin filament.

review_title: Love these, remote makes it a must-buy.
review_text: I purchased these without certainty where to use them. Now, after I put them in our bedroom, my daughter loves them and looks like we'll soon order another set. What makes them really nice is the remote that provides lots of lighting options (fade, blink, brightness, etc.). Not intrusive, but gentle light.
Nice lights but be aware if your order two sets they come in the same packaging. I order them as gifts and wish I’d known prior.

review_title: leave the fairy lights on for me!
review_text: these are very pretty, we put them over a spare curtain rod over the main entrance, to use as a "night light" for whichever roommate is coming home last. they give enough light to clearly navigate the entrance, and use way less electricity than the ceiling fixtures. so it makes a very pretty way to save some electricity but leave a light on for housemates.

review_title: The reviews didnt disappoint! I bought these for my daughters new big ...
review_text: The reviews didnt disappoint! I bought these for my daughters new big girl bedroom. She absolutely LOVES them! She calls them her stars. The remote makes it so easy to turn on and off! She now goes to sleep to her stars and mommy and daddy don't have to lay in bed because she's scared anymore!

The lights do not work :-( It's finally Holiday season and time to use them and they do not work. I don't see a way to notify the seller therefor I am writing here. If there is a way for the seller to see this review I would so appreciate receiving another set and I was very excited about the prospect of the product. Thank you for any kind response.
The connection should be better and tighter, I finally got it to work. The length I think is great. Love the different ways you can make the lights go bright or less bright. I would buy them again.

review_title: They worked fine for the first few months
review_text: They worked fine for the first few months, but after a while the lights started to flicker out until one day they just died and I couldn't turn them on anymore. I thought it was just a problem with the remote, but after changing the battery in it the lights still wouldn't turn on. I'm very disappointed and I'd return them but it's too late to do so. Edit: I was contacted by customer service and they refunded my order, had a really lovely conversation. Many thanks to Daisy for contacting me.

review_title: So great! Customer service is fantastic
review_text: So great! Customer service is fantastic! Thought I lost the remote but I really stuffed it in my pocket of a robe I don't normally wear and they were going to replace it until I found it the next day! They're gorgeous. Will order more.

review_title: Lightweight & simple, but a bit misleading
review_text: -1 star for misleading image, the "wire" is white not copper colored. -1 star for IR spectrum, my tv remote changes settings on these as well. Aside from that, they've been a nice addition to our bedroom, a good low-light solution with no glare off our TV.

These are so great, I put them in my bedroom along the ceiling and it has been the perfect lighting. I can turn it up if I want to read and turn it down when I am doing yoga and trying to relax. Highly recommend!

The lights are beautiful when put up! The only problem I faced was the remote sensor's plug did not correctly fit in the plug on the lights. I had to use electrical tape to keep it connected for both sets.

review_title: Very nice, easy on the eye LED lights.
review_text: Very beautiful! I brought these around a silk palm tree and leave them on all day. Versatile! Just be careful when you undo them since they do tangle easy in this is a long strand. Very nice, easy on the eye LED lights. I the dimming feature is a nice addition.

review_title: Oh my goodness it's the best purchase I've made in a while
review_text: Seriously, just buy these! Oh my goodness it's the best purchase I've made in a while. They're minimalistic and add such a beautiful calming effect to my bedroom. It's even helped decrease my stress and panic disorders, that's how great these lights are.

review_title: The remote doesn't reach from very far but it does work and does have some nice alternative settings
review_text: Very elegant and low maintenance alternative to Christmas tree lights. The remote doesn't reach from very far but it does work and does have some nice alternative settings. The copper look of the wire gives a nice gold touch and the lights are very soft on the eyes. Fit our 6' tree with a little bit more room to be able to go
These little lights are great. We stuffed them inside our favorite gin bottle (empty!) and it makes a great eye-catching decorative accent. The entire spool fit nicely in the 1.5L bottle.

review_title: I use this product for residual lighting in my room and love it.
review_text: These lights give you exactly what they say they will. They are very bright at their highest level and give quite a bit of light, enough to light a master bedroom to reading level throughout in the middle of the night. I'm not sure what the functionality of the Firefly timer setting though, as it appears to be more seizure-inducing than anything. I use this product for residual lighting in my room and love it.

Very happy with these. They are very bright, seem to be good quality, and the remote is great since it lets you adjust the brightness in multiple steps. It also has other functions like flash which I don't use. Good product.

I absolutely love these lights. They are so much brighter than you would imagine for such small lights and they are thin and malleable and can really be put anywhere. You can pick the brightness of the lights which is awesome. I put them in my bedroom instead of a lamp and as I'm getting more tired I dim them more and more. You can also make them pulse in many different tempo's. Personally I do not like pulsing lights, but as far as look, effectiveness, and brightness go, these are amazing.

These lights are great-so far. A few reviewers complained that they didn't work after a few hours, but I have not had any problems. They are a nice soft light, and you can dim them or make them brighter, and they have several flashing modes. If you are planning to run them a decent length, go ahead and purchase the longer version because you can't connect the strands. I used them to run under my deck railing for soft lights but had to plug in two sets.

I love these lights, used them in my bedroom to make it romantic. However, one of them is not working properly, I need to call and get it exchanged. It seems that the plug in from the lights to the transformer is loose inside. It makes my lights come in and out if it's moved. Otherwise, they're awesome!

I wrote a negative review after the original string of lights I bought turned out to be faulty. The company has since improved the design of the AC adapter and the controller, and I'm very pleased with the set I've received of the new model, which was the outlandishly long 66-foot string. The response of customer service to the whole situation was great - responding to negative reviews, improving the product, replacing faulty sets, friendly presence over email. If they stop working anytime soon I'll report back, but for now they look beautiful, and the options to dim and brighten them with the remote are appreciated.
Bought these for use in our travel trailer. The trailer's stock LED lights are nice, but too darn bright. I strung these around the ceiling, and what a great improvement. MOOD LIGHTING!

review_title: The dimmer function is great, love the remote control
review_text: They are tiny delicate looking lights but are very strong and durable. The dimmer function is great, love the remote control. Get the recommended mounts that are suggested. I didn't and it would have been much more convenient to have them right there on arrival of the lights. you will want to put them right up. also get more than one set.
The copper is really nice allowing me to position where I needed the light. I love the dimmer function and remote. A+ all the way!

These lights are perfect. They are pretty and classy all year round, and the remote is very handy because the outlet they are plugged into is hard to get to. Also, 33 ft sounds like a lot, but if you're going to wind it around anything it goes fast. These lights are not ideal if you plan on putting them up and taking them down a lot as they tangle really easily, but I intend to leave them up as a permanent fixture so they are perfect!!

These lights are beautiful and definitely worth the price. I should have bought more than one! The copper wire makes it easy to manipulate the shape--I actually used sewing needles to put these up! Love them!
These lights are amazing! You wouldn’t think such small little bulbs would do much but they light up my whole room and it’s just really nice, relaxing mood lighting. The length is perfect as well!
I love these lights, I will be ordering more for the other side of my back porch. We used command light hooks to hang them and they're PERFECT. I love all the features on the remote, too.

These lights were absolutely beautiful on my tree. I had smaller led light sets that I used to decorate my wreaths and garland. I would definitely buy from this company as the light set came with a remote! I kept mine on the steady glow, but knowing I had options was terrific! Great value for the price!!

review_title: Two thumbs down in this item.
review_text: Lights came on but would not respond to remote. I put a new battery in remote and plastic battery holder broke. The plug is in a tough spot to reach so big pain to plug & unplug to use. Two thumbs down on this item.

I first wrote a review after I purchased these back in January (4 months ago) indicating the brightness had faded and they were no longer bright. Well today, after only 4 months, they completely quit working. Very frustrated. They were hanging in my living room with 3M Command Hooks, so we're not damaged and not mishandled. Took them down and threw them out.

review_title: Love to be able to dim them!
review_text: These are super LEDs!! I use these softly flexible lights on top of my dining room hutch in foliage and decorations for different holidays. The ability to dim the lights is important as LEDs can be really bright. I set mine on 40% and they look almost like soft white regular little lights.

review_title: Love having the ability to dim these
review_text: Love having the ability to dim these. on any setting above 50%, they are bright white, not warm. But on the lower setting they are warm and lovely. I don't care for the power cord though. That along with the remote receiver is thick and black. Very hard to hide. Would be better in white and I will consider painting them in the future so they are less conspicuous. Lovely little lights though.

These lights are very bright ! They look great,are nicely packaged and so convenient to have a remote. I bought two sets and used them on the 2 8' columns on my front porch. There were a good length for that purpose . The instructions seemed to say they could be strung together but at the end they say don't do that so not sure about that feature- the reason for only 4 stars. I am very satisfied and will probably purchase more.

review_title: Versatile, Useful, and Worth the Cost
review_text: I ordered these lights to line my fence for a backyard party. They came promptly and worked perfectly. I loved the little remote that came with; seems silly at first but is actually dead useful! I thought that, given the price, these lights would only last a couple of uses. Instead, they survived the elements (including rain) and are now used inside our home to light up a tapestry. They are easy to manipulate and the wiring is quite malleable. Would no doubt buy again if the occasion arose!

review_title: Bought to replace rope lighting and we are very happy with it
review_text: I bought these because they have a remote control. After buying you don't really need the remote because we like the brightest setting. They are not too bright on the highest setting. I bought 3 sets and I am very happy with the way they look. You really can't see the copper wire and if one light does burn out the rest stay lit. We used these to replace led rope lighting and entire sections burnrd out with that.

review_title: Very creative idea of string lights!
review_text: Excellent quality LED string lights, this is my second purchase. Previously I bought the colorful version of this one for Christmas. This time I bought for everyday use on my bay window. Trying to get creative with it

This light set worked beautifully on a long plate rail above our sun room windows. During the day it's virtually invisible, and at night it adds a soft glow to the room while illuminating the objects on the plate rail. It's so convenient to dim or brighten the lights and was amazingly easy to install.

review_title: Beautiful lights! Very bright! Great quality!
review_text: These lights are beautiful! Much brighter than I ever thought they would be for something so small...bought them for my sons teepee and they light up the inside beautifully. My only problem is the remote...has dimming and flashing features however my remote will not work properly..wont shut lights off or clear the modes I press...maybe I got a defective one...will contact the company. Other than the remote will definitely buy more of these!

review_title: Beautiful warm white. And remote w dinner is awesome
review_text: These lights are awesome. I live the dimmable feature. They are a beautiful warm white. One of my sets died about a month after the return window but upon writing to amazon, they are replacing the set.

Got bit by a tornado this past Saturday. 90 MPH winds, trees down all over the place. I wrapped these lights around my deck and they stayed put and still work. They cast a lot of light for their size. And with the thin copper wire they are hardly noticeable and easy to wrap around your deck or a tree. The only down side is the line of sight remote which is more of a nuisance than an actual problem. Highly recommended.

review_title: Not meant for rain and snow.. Not outdoor friendly. But very bright and pretty
review_text: The goods: The lights are very bright. Much brighter than other christmas light). The copper wire is of good quality The bad: I'm taking two stars off because, I don't think it is meant for outdoors. The power adapter and the controls are not very water proof. We had some drizzles lately and the adapter parts are rusting. Also, the remote has a range of less than 5 feet.

Got this for daughter's room a few months ago and it looks nice but they're not as bright as I had hoped at 100%. Additionally there's something wrong with the plug or something because sometimes when she turns it all the way on it'll sometimes be dimmer than usual and randomly brighten later

review_title: i understand that the return policy is only good for 30 days after purchase so it's completely my ...
review_text: Ordered two of these sets earlier this year for a project I had planned for late spring/early summer. Pulled them out this weekend and one of the sets is completely broken. The wire is disconnected from the power source and I can't fix it. i understand that the return policy is only good for 30 days after purchase so it's completely my issue but I feel like there should be some manufacturing warranties for a completely non-functional product that hadn't even had the package opened. EDIT: Taotronics replaced the defective product immediately. Received it and it worked perfectly. Thank you for standing behind your product!!

review_title: We're very happy as they went up easily and worked without a ...
review_text: Wasn't sure about these but thought I would give them a try. We're very happy as they went up easily and worked without a problem. They've been running daily for the last month and we've had no issues. I don't think they will take a lot of bending back and forth but we will see as time goes on.

I purchased this product to place outside in my porch. The lights are a lot easier to put up and take down when comparing with normal lights. They looked good out on the porch and the remote control was awesome as the lights had multiple modes that could be used. The only problem is that the remote control would not work while the sliding glass door to the porch was closed. I had to open the door to operate the lights. Other than that, I was very happy with my purchase.

Absolutely love it! Tangles easy, so be careful. The "bare wire" won't shock you, it appears to be coated. Not quite as "warm" as shown in the photo, but the white balance is still rather neutral (not too cool, not too warm) so it still looks nice.
Great lights! 33 ft was plenty of length to decorate a large corner of my room. The color of light is soothing, and I absolutely love that they're dimmable AND comes with a remote.

review_title: Wire isn’t great. Remote doesn’t always work.
review_text: These work ok. The wire is flimsy and breaks easily. Luckily I have an industrious husband who can put them back together. The remote control is touch and go. Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn’t. Wouldn’t order them again. Will look for a different brand that has stronger wire.

These lights are awesome. Much better than we expected. They look so much better than any Christmas lights we've seen. They really do appear "Starry". They don't heat up, which is another plus. The dimming capability makes them very nice for many applications. We put them on an indoor tree that we like to light all year round. We are going to order several more sets.

review_title: ... I was pleasantly surprised by high quality of product Nice packing Actual led are very small in size than ...
review_text: Used for Christmas decoration of tree last year I was pleasantly surprised by high quality of product Nice packing Actual led are very small in size than expected but still looking amazing when lit up Have couple of modes and setting for led cordinstrd display Satisfied either purchase!!

I received these lights only a couple of weeks ago. We hung them up on the inside of our apartment patio by placing several command hooks around the ceiling and running the lights through the hooks. They are easy to set up and the remote is a great tool. We are able to chose different flashing patterns and brightness. We no longer use our patio light since these are bight enough and easy to use. I just purchase my second set!

Great when the remote works, which is about 30% of the time. Not sure if it's a signal/receiver thing or an electrical issue in the remote itsrlf, but it's unfortunate either way. Apparently this is an issue with some units sent.

review_title: Turns on great. A bugger to turn off.
review_text: I've had these for a year now and they are still working. Turning them on from across the room works just fine. However, changing the intensity or even just turning them off requires getting up and standing within 6' - 8' before the sensor reads the remote. I guess this is okay because when I'm turning them off I'm planning on leaving the room and had to get up anyway.

Great lights working very well. Come with very good remote that has tons of options to set the ligths up. We use them for holiday decoration in front of our house entrance. Very nice. Would highly recommend them.

review_title: pretty but not dimmable for me
review_text: dimmer switch doesn't work. so this is just a string of lights. the lights are pretty but tangle a lot, very light and easy to hang on stuff.

review_title: pretty cool stay in place lights
review_text: these lights are great for setting the mood. kinda ticks me off the price went up right after i bought them so i did'nt buy a second set and will hold off untill it comes back down. what's up w/ that Amazon! i have a lot of different lights and these are kinda cool in that you can leave them in place. hopefully they hold up,,check back

review_title: Perfect string lights, bright, and multiple modes!
review_text: Items arrived as described, light level was great! Using them indoors kinda floating over a door, and I used them at a slightly low level as some background lighting when watching TV in the living room. Love the ease of adjustment and multiple modes offered (Dance party? STROBE SEIZURE MODE, GO!)

review_title: LOVE THESE LIGHTS- ESPECIALLY DIM AND TIMER FEATURES
review_text: I purchased these lights specifically for the timer feature and the dim option- it's nearly impossible to find both features. I strung the lights around the front of my garden arbor and liked them so much I purchased another set to string around the back of the arbor.

review_title: but it's still very nice and the dim feature is great
review_text: Not as warm as the pictures make it to be, but it's still very nice and the dim feature is great, sets a good atmosphere for the room. Taotronics makes pretty quality stuff at great prices.

I bought these for my canopy bed and they look great, the only downside is that they dont have a twinkling setting.... You can change them to blink and stuff but its a little intense because they all just flash at the same time lol

review_title: I wanted to love these. It seems like a cool company and ...
review_text: I wanted to love these. It seems like a cool company and product. Sadly I was quite disappointed. Before hanging them up I tried plugging it in and it turned on. review_title: Cool lights to set the mood
review_text: It's cool to have remote control LEDs around my projection screen, so that I don't have annoying recessed lights dimming out the picture when I need a bit of ambient light. The IR sensor seems to work fine, right now it's just haphazardly lying on the stage below my screen since I haven't figured out exactly where/how I will permanently mount these lights. Your mileage may vary--I'm not using the stock remote, I have them programmed to work with my Harmony 650. Amazingly, the Harmony has the code for these lights, so once I added the model # in the software, they were programmed without a hitch. As a side note, my first set accidentally broke somehow when I took them out of the box after only trying them out for a few minutes to make sure they worked. I was really careful with them when wrapping them back up, but they still broke. However, TaoTronics was kind enough to send me a replacement set, even though I had the original set for 2 months before I discovered they had gotten damaged. They also offer a 1 year warranty on the item--I think you need to register or something. I'll make sure to do that this time. I'm not the most creative person, but I saw these lights and I'd read about other DIYers putting these in their home theaters, so I thought I'd try them out. I might ultimately put them in the kitchen under the cabinets, b/c I just can't come up with a cool way to install them as others have done, and they would look great behind some glass front cabinets, or mounted underneath cabinets above the sink and counters. If you like a bit more low level light in the kitchen than you get from the fridge or stove night light, these may do the trick, and look cool while doing it.

I have an outdoor deck with a canvas awning over it and I wanted some lights to put underneath (inside) the awning that would not only be decorative but also provide some task lighting at night. After looking around I found these lights which seemed to be more what I was looking for and I have been extremely happy with my purchase. I have purchased 4 sets, am using 3 and kept 1 for a backup. These lights are very small so I was able to string them through the grommets on the underside of the awning, lining each support pole, - creating kind of a starry-night kind of vibe. The remote allows me to dim the lights to whatever level I want, so if I need to actually see something at night I can with the lights at full power, or I can dim them way down for a romantic dinner feel. My wife loves them as well and has told me they were a great purchase. They really add a cool ambiance to the space. In addition to dimming the lights, you can also make them flash at various rates, - I guess if your having a dance party or something. review_title: Good quality, look great, endless creative uses.
review_text: I needed a lamp to light one corner of my living room, and I came up with an idea that incorporated a bunch of fairy lights among other things. It's made from an aspen log I found at the back of my property, and a bunch of antique bits and pieces. The log has several big holes in it carved by woodpeckers, and my idea was to light them up with these lights... I also found an old lantern at a thrift store that was missing its globe for $5...I replaced it with a mason jar, and filled it with another string of these lights. On top of that, I strung these lights down the back of the log (poking into the woodpecker holes)...the lights run down the back help light up the corner behind the log. The result looks great. Quality of these lights is pretty good, I couldn't find anything to complain about. The control box and remote work. I thought I would want dim them, but I ultimately decided not to use the controller since I just run them at full brightness anyway. I do like the fact that you can just leave the control box out of the power supply if you want. I was also a little concerned after seeing reports of them overheating...I didn't really want something that gets hot strapped to an extremely dry hundred year old piece of wood lol. They're plenty bright for accent lights...you're not going to use them as a primary light source though. Well, if you had enough of them maybe, but it would take a pretty big ball of them. They just don't throw light very far. The creative possibilities are endless though, and I'm having a lot of fun finding new uses for them. I'm sure I'll be buying another set soon for some other project.

I was interested in a new updated scale and had the opportunity to test this one out. I have read some of the reviews where people were having issues with the error message and personally have only experienced that one. The opinions I share are soley mine and an effort to assist you in your decision making. Packaging: The scale arrived enclosed in two boxes so I believe there will be no damage in shipping. Looks: This is an area where this scale by far excels and it look contemporary and clean. The glass is a unique look since it is smooth cleaning it should be a breeze. I like the modern blue colored display as well. Usage: This is one area the manufacturer could work on especially the directions. They are very short, although I had no problem getting it setup including converting from kilograms to pounds. I have set it up for several people in my house and it is able to detect them differently. I like that you can just step on the scale and it works. My current body fat scale requires you to press a button and then wait several seconds before stepping on. I have kept this beside my old scale and compared my weight and other measurements and they are very close to one another. Pros: Ability to just step on and use it Looks like an expensive scale Recognizes different people without pushing of buttons Suggestions: I would like to see the instructions made a little more detailed. Also, as a couple other mentioned it would be nice to have a bluetooth connection and an app that you could record your information to in order to track your progress. Overall: I have been pleased with the look, function and accuracy (compared to my other scale) and would recommend this purchase.

Lumsing Scale I have tried my best to like using the Lumsing Smart auto recognition body fat scale. It is a wonderfully modern looking scale; sleek and smooth. It was fairly easy to set up the individual profiles although the directions do lack detail. If you have set up similar scales that have more than 1 profile you can set up this one. This scale also lets you choose an athletic mode in your profile. It’s not explained but I suppose that mode allows for a more muscular type person to get readings that take that body type into consideration. After setting up a profile the first time it seems that you have to repeat setting it up and having the person to stand on the scale a few times before it will recognize the person. I didn’t mind that because it did eventually work. The display starts with the weight and then cycles twice through showing first your BMI, body fat and water % on one screen then calories, bone and muscle weight on the next screen, ending up with your weight and profile number. When displaying your BMI it politely displays if you are healthy, under weight or obese. Those are the “Pros” for this scale, but the 2 cons that made me return the scale were the erratic weight and the constant errors that wouldn’t display any screens past the weight. The weight readings could fluctuate from 1 to 4 pounds within minutes of weighing. The Err 2 or impedance error (the instructions DO explain error messages) is the most irritating and consistent. No matter how much I wiped the scale off this error would constantly display. It got to the point that I started hating to step on it because it was a better chance it would error than give the complete information. That’s when I decided to return it. The return process is very easy. I would not recommend this scale unless you aren’t concerned about reliable weight readings and you are willing to settle just for weight reading if the scale errors out. I did receive this scale at a discount to give my honest opinion and I’ve done that. If Lumsing could improve on the reliability of the scale I would rate it higher. I hope my review has been helpful.

review_title: Tenergy Odev 2-in-1 Transformable DIY STEM Education Programmable Robot Kit - Tomo
review_text: This is a great DIY STEM robot kit for kids. It's recommended for 8+ but my daughter aged at 5 had no problem assembling and playing with it with a little help from me. This kit can be either installed as a "tricycle" or a "dicycle" and the fundamental features are similar. It has an ultrasonic sensor acting as its "eyes" which is used for obstruction avoidance. It utilizes a tracking sensor, which has IR sensor on board. This helps the robot to "track" black maker or tapes. There is a map included in the kit and I can also DIY a track for the robot to follow. I like that the user manual is really detailed and easy to follow. All the tools, screws, nuts are included and nothing is missing. The tools (screwdriver & wrench) are easy to operate even for smaller hands (kids friendly!). The overall assembly took about 25 minutes for my daughter with my help and I can tell she felt proud of herself when it's finished. There are two companion APPs which are used to control & program the robote - "ODEV Explorerr" and "ODEV Blockly". We could manual control the movement of the robot as well as let it roam (with obstruction avoidance) or track black tapes. The on-board LED lights are also programmable through the app - both light color and pattern are changeable.

My son is in elementary school and I signed him up for a robotic after-school program last fall and he is really into this now. By the end of the spring semester their club is going to host a science fair. And all parents know the competition at these fairs are fierce! I don't want my boy to get too discouraged and lose interest in the subject. So, I decided to offer a bit help. Ta-da~ enter this awesome robot kit. He was beyond thrilled to see this arrived at home. I know the package says 8+, but my 7 year old was able to figure out the entire assembly process by himself. Also, the programming feature is very kid friendly and took only a little tutorial for him to code away. The built-in cameras on the robot enables it to do many fancy maneuvers beyond the basic movements, such as avoiding objects automatically, or follow pre-outlined routes. If you program it the right way, you can make it dance to your favorite pop song :) And the best part is, with all these customization and possibilities, my boy is fully engaged and happy to explore and solve problems independently. I think that's priceless. And yes, we are ready to rock that science fair!

review_text: I purchased two of these for my 8 and 11 year old daughters. Without a doubt these are their favorite Christmas gifts. We made a few small mistakes during assembly that caused us to undo and redo a number of steps, but it still took less than an hour in total. Our girls love driving the robots around the house and timing how fast they can complete obstacle courses we create. We’ve also laid out a long track using black electrical tape going through several rooms and hallways. The tape goes under chairs and tables with lots of branches that split and come back together. Each robot follows the twists and turns of the course flawlessly, often taking a different route than the prior pass. Excellent quality for the robots themselves. The only issue was the two motors on one robot didn’t turn initially. After spinning the wheels/motors by hand on each robot to compare them, I noticed the wheels/motors that weren't working were much harder to turn. So, I continued spinning them back and forth for another minute or so, after which they started working perfectly and have continued to do so after hours of use. The two wheeled version was slower and more limited in what it could do then the tri-wheeled version, so my girls prefer the tri. But since it takes only 15 minutes or so to switch from one configuration to the other, you should check them both out. I highly recommend this robot.
