If I could give a product negative starts this one would get 5 negative stars!! Do not waste your time or money!!

review_title: ... uses this mister a couple of times but i love the quality and spray pattern/amount each time
review_text: I've only uses this mister a couple of times but i love the quality and spray pattern/amount each time. The quality can be felt and the glass makes a difference. I used to have a Misto and it was good at first but failed after some time. This sprayer feels more solid with a powerful spray after just a few quick pumps of air with the cap. It's a bit pricey but I hope the function and quality last and it will be worth the money!

Ok. I could hardly get it to spray. So I read around online and found out you have to pump it a lot to get it to work. The directions on the box; which I just looked at; say pump it 6 to 8 times. Which I did, and it barely sprays anything. I read somewhere online that you need to pump it like 30 to 40 times. So I tightened the top a bit and pumped it 55 times. Sprays great. For a short time. Runs out of air pressure quickly. This thing is too much work. I don’t want to have to pump it 50-odd times every time I want to use it. It’s not worth $25. I’d return it if I could but I cut the instructions off of the box so now I can’t return it in the original box. Don’t buy it; get a pump sprayer like the Evo. 12JAN2018 Update: The 1st mister worked poorly. They refunded my money in full; which was great. Didn’t have to return the defective mister. They sent me a replacement. Which I just tried. I put warm water in it 1st; per directions. I pumped it 10 times and tried it. It sprayed fine. Ok, that’s for water. What about oil. I put peanut oil in and pumped it 10 times and tried it. It works GREAT! Sprays a very fine mist; which is what I wanted. The spray lasts long enough to spray-coat the bottom of my pan. Which is what I wanted it to do. I took one star off for all the trouble.

review_title: Don't buy unless you need to "mist", much better sprayers available.
review_text: I got this as a Christmas gift, so my review is irrespective of the price. When pumped up enough to evenly coat a pan this sprayer atomizes the olive oil into the air. We don't have a hood fan so the oil goes everywhere into the air. See video. Also, the unit sprays itself and needs to be wiped after use. I'm going to buy the Evo oil sprayer set because I've used these at a friend's house numerous times and they are far superior oil sprayers to this mister. The Evo pump sprayer it is much more even and better controlled than the chefvantage mister. For certain applications this mister would have its place but not as an everyday pan sprayer. It excels at making a cloud of oil, not coating a pan.

review_title: Not very user-friendly in the kitchen
review_text: I’m sorry but this sprayer doesn’t work as well as it is advertised and described. A hassle to be honest. I never really give bad reviews and thoroughly research my purchases. Having to pump to spray a few times for one pan isn’t quite user friendly in the kitchen. I really thought this would be a better item. I would ask for a refund but at this point I would just assume pass and consider it an unnecessary purchase. Not made to be very functional in a my kitchen and cooking setting. Who knows if it ever clogs because I can only get 3 sprays befor I’m pumping again. Maybe it’s defective, I’m not quite sure.

review_title: So yes I was frustrated at first but this does actually work and works great.
review_text: If you get this product, go to you tube and watch the tutorial video on how to use it. I got mine and thought it didnt work. It doesn't come with instructions and it doesn't tell you to go to YouTube to watch the video. So please if the company sees this review put something in your product box letting people know to go to youtube. So yes I was frustrated at first but this does actually work and works great.

Update: the company sent me a new insert piece and it works perfectly now. Followed l directions to a T and it still doesn't work. This is not our first oil mister (last one of a different brand fell to it's demise due to a "helpful" child). The lid constantly detaches from the sleeve that goes over the spray nozel. Reservoir is a little less than half full and no matter how much we pump, it won't spray more than a tiny fizzle. We always release the pressure when done (which is never much. We have given it many chances over the past couple of months, but I am done.

This works really, really well with water, and I give it points for it's pump system and consistent spray. But it simply doesn't perform with thicker liquids. When I load it with olive oil, it trickles out slowly and with low pressure, no matter how many times I pump it. When I switch it back to water, everything works like I want it to.

review_title: Not as good as it seems!
review_text: This did not work for me at all. The plastic piece at the base of the pump mechanism is too flimsy. It stopped working during my first use, the gasket was damaged from me trying to pump it (which I did carefully, knowing that an airtight seal was needed to build the pressure in the bottle). The company had been kind enough to email me when the item shipped, so I contacted them, hoping I had just received a faulty one. They sent me a new pump, which worked for about a week and then stopped when the gasket wore out again. Even when it was working for those few days, it took far more than the amount of pumps they claimed to get proper pressure built and get a good spray. The company asked in their response to me that I please not give them a bad review because they are a small company and it can really hurt their business. However, I feel that the amount of positive reviews here is misconcieving. They need to figure out a better solution for the gasket end of their pump mechanism. This was so disappointing as I really had my hopes up with this sprayer.

For the most part, we like the product. When you follow the directions, it works fine. It appears to keep the mist going longer without cleaning or failing than the other types we have used in the past. If you don’t follow the directions and fill it more than 1/3 -1/2, then the pressure doesn’t last very long; make sense since the volume of air is greatly diminished. After using the Oil Mister for 3 months, the stainless steel cap started to split from the bottom up. So in that sense, the mister did not meet our expectations. We have owned 2 others brands of misters that failed and/or stop misting; although we paid ½ less for those than the Chefvantage mister. For the price of the product compared to cheaper ones, it does don’t seem to hold up as well. So far. Where the product didn't shine, the customer service of the company greatly did. After submitting an email describing the issue to the seller of the oil mister, without question and without me requesting a complete replacement, she immediately sent us a new one, which arrived two days later! This shows a focus on customer satisfaction that seems to be disappearing from many places with each passing year. The owners of the company truly stand behind the products they sell. Where-as the product may not have held up, the company did. I would definitely buy from this company again because of the dedication to the customer.

review_title: We had difficulty in getting the mister pump to work ...
review_text: We had difficulty in getting the mister pump to work. I sent an email on Sunday and got a reply the same day. The reply said to view a U tube video and if this did not work, she would send us a new pump. We watched the video and it worked. The owners sand behind their product and respond quickly to your problem. I was impressed.

review_title: Decent sprayer but won’t buy again
review_text: Update: Out of the blue, I was sent a replacement sprayer to see if my first one was defective. I cleaned both sprayers and compared them head to head and their performance was identical. I’m upping my star rating by a star to reflect the fact that, having to pressurize twice may just be the nature of these. Both sprayers performing identically shows the quality control in place with these sprayers as well. Lastly the extra star is to reflect the great customer service. The replacement sprayer that was sent came with thorough instructions, faqs, and even a small note stating why it was sent with an apology and further guarantees on their product. I’m now getting used to having to pressurize the thing twice which really isn’t a big deal; my initial dissatisfaction was due to having one I only had to pressurize once. To be fair, there were some downsides to that sprayer also. This sprayer is just alright. My last one was significantly better. When using a 12” fry pan you’ve gotta pump it about ten times, spray till the pressure is gone, put the top on again and pump another ten times and spray again to get decent coverage. The last sprayer I had, got by with one set of ten pumps easy. I also don’t love how the nozzle is so close to the top so some of the spray cone tends to land on and drip down the top. The black sprayer looks nice though and all in all it does as it’s supposed to

review_title: Meh! I have to keep pumping the top to get the mist
review_text: As I said in the intro, I have to keep pumping the top to get the mist. The most lasts for about 5 seconds and then you gotta pump it again. If I knew this, I would have bought something else

It wasn't quite clear from the instructions, but the way you prime the mister is by moving the entire top glass lid (the piece on top if it is all put together) up and down about 10 times. You don't have to pull it all the way off when you pump, just a bit up and down will do. You'll feel a bit of resistance after about 10 pumps, this is the air pressure building up inside the lower glass part that holds the oil. After that, remove the top glass lid completely, and try to spray. For me it takes about 10 pumps of the lid to get enough pressure to spray. I usually have to re-pump a couple of times if I am spraying a pan for cooking. For me it creates a pretty good mist and has decent coverage. I bought it to replace PAM-like cooking sprays, and so far it seems to be good replacement for those.

review_title: Worked decently, until it spontaneously shattered
review_text: This mister worked alright for the first few months. The only (minor) criticism I had was that it only works well when it is neither too full, nor too empty. So, you have to refill it just a bit every week or two. Fast forward to last week. I was inexplicably having issues getting any pressure, no matter how much I pumped it. I unscrewed the top to check the gasket. Everything looked fine, so I put it back together and pumped it up. Still hardly any pressure. Left it on the counter while I continued cooking. A minute later, I hear a popping sound, and the top tilted to the side. The glass spontaneously shattered, breaking the neck off. Pretty disappointed, given I didn't do anything abusive to it.

review_title: I was wrong. IT WORKS FINE
review_text: Most people that gave 1 star reviews, as I did before I just changed it to 5 stars, had the same confusing issue I had- the sprayer DID NOT BUDGE! I think the problem is in the expectation of how the sprayer would work. It's not a pump-action sprayer. The top dome/cap with the plastic cylindrical chamber in it is the pressurizer. You pump THAT thing 6-8 times OVER THE SPRAYER. This builds the pressure, then you just press down on the spray for a constant stream to come out. It's more like a spray can than a pump spray like you'd expect on a cheap trigger sprayer/etc. I can't speak to the problems people have been having with oils vs water, because mine mists fine. Gina, co-owner, was very polite and professional with me about this. I see that she's the same with all the other 1 star reviews, and that she's offered all of them a replacement or refund, but it appears none of them bothered to follow up. I'll update this review if the item starts to fail, but I expect I'll be fine for a while. It's a lot to spend on a sprayer, but I spend $10 per olive-oil sprayer, which is the only kind that sprays pure olive oil under natural pressure and with no added chemicals (the cheap-o/$2 bottles are rife with chemical additives). With this mister I can now spray grape oil, which I can't find anywhere in spray, let alone the natural variety. I'm very happy, and will be extremely happy if this proves a good sprayer over time. I consider it worth the money if it lasts me half a year with daily use. I expect it should last at least that long.

First let me say that I love this product; clever, well made and most of all, it works great! I had issues with other “misters” in the past. Second, I can’t say enough about their customer service. And this where I would rate a 6 if I could. When the pump arrived, a small piece turn out to be defective (operator error in hindsight I think). I sent email and had a response in 30 minutes apologing and informing me that the replacement part would ship the next day. Sure enough, a few days later the part arrived (I live 3,000 miles away) along with a handwritten note, wanting to ensure my 100% satisfaction. For good measure, Gina (owner) sent a follow up email to make sure all was good. Great customer service is disappearing quickly- but not here. If these folks sold cars - I would buy one. Gina and family, thank you for the great product and outstanding service! Paul

This has great reviews and I have no idea why. I got one use out of it before it stopped spraying. I could pump this thing for a year and barely be able to oil a cookie sheet. Love the concept but the execution was a huge fail. UPDATE: I had no intentions of returning this product or asking for a refund but due to this review I received a new one in the mail about a week ago. I waited a bit to update this review to make sure it did in fact work but even if it had not I would have complimented this company for their exceptional level of customer service. They sent a new one without me ever asking and it works wonderfully. Its apparent why so many people gave it 5 stars. I barely have to pump it at all and it sprays a perfect mist as I expected it to when I bought it. It speaks volumes when somebody goes out of there way to insure a customer is happy with the product they are selling. Unfortunately customer service has become a thing of the past in this country so I applaud those who still value it as a guiding principle.

I've tried a misto oil sprayer before with terrible results. I simply hated the thing and ended up just going back to throw away bottles of spray oil. I read the good reviews on Amazon and this works perfectly for my needs. It's not the finest mist like an aerosol but I didn't expect it to be. This distributes an even layer of oil where I need it. But it's a higher maintenance item that needs some attention to work it's best. 1) The oil level sprays best when it's filled at the half way point. If it's too high it doesn't build enough pressure when you pump the cap. Too low then you feel like you're pumping the cap forever. 2) I usually wipe down the nozzle and surrounding areas with a paper towel to keep any oil from gunking the nozzle. I think any left over oils will clog over time. With those things in mind, I'd still recommend it.

review_title: Could not get it to work
review_text: Bought this for my wife. Directions say to pump 20-30 times to prime it, which we did. But it wouldn't work. Must have pumped it well over 200 times, still wouldn't work. Took it apart, cleaned it, looked it over, reassembled....still wouldn't work. Immediately returned it. Ordering a different brand. 12 Jan 2019 UPDATE: The company sent us a replacement at no charge, which was a surprise since we didn't order one. So with nothing to lose, we decided to give it another try, and this time it worked perfectly. After filling with oil, it easily pressured after less than 20 pumps. It sprays a nice, fine mist that my wife likes for her salad. I have no idea why the first one we received didn't work, but this one works great and I have no problem recommending it. So I've changed my original 1 star rating to 5 stars. Good job!

review_title: Great product and even better customer service
review_text: We've had our spritzer about a week, and we really like it though it's a bit smaller that we'd realized. It's nice looking, though, and the quality is great. I also appreciate how much the company truly appreciates its customers and reaches out to make sure you're happy. They're a family business, and they sincerely care.

The product works very well. My only complaint is that it actually produces too fine of an oil mist, that The cloud of mist floats away to the rest of the kitchen instead of settles on to the food. So I use this product outside to avoid greasing up my kitchen walls. Update 5/30/2018: I gave 4 stars with the previous review above, which you would think is already a pretty good rating. I got a letter in the mail from the seller enclosing a new nozzle that they have tested, saying that they hope the new nozzle would fix the problem. I guess they really care about 100% customer satisfaction. As a customer, this is the type of merchant that I hope all sellers are. Also, turns out that I didn't need the new nozzle because in fact I had figured out that you can avoid producing very fine mist by not pumping the mister too much. So 5 stars for both the product and the seller!

review_title: LOVE SO MUCH, NOW I HAVE TWO!
review_text: I bought one of these in 2016, and it had a bad sprayer, BUT the company sent me a replacement at light speed. Been using it with olive oil for all cooking, ever since, and still totally LOVE the performance. I had a Misto many years before, and there's no comparison. This never clogs, never fails, when fully pumped it has a nice long fine spray, and once you get used to it, you can use it in your sleep. The new one looks even sturdier, so maybe I'll have these two the rest of my life. I'm going to try melted (not hot) organic clarified butter (ghee) to spray popcorn, then wash it right afterward. Betcha this will work - very functional - but if not, I'll put another oil in in. I would HIGHLY recommend this! Also a great company; I'm hoping they make more products! We all need quality in our lives again!

I've had this mister now for around 4 months and it is still holding up really well. We like to use to when we make popcorn at home and want a little bit of oil in order to get some salt to stick to it. You pump it about 10 times and then when you hold in the sprayer, a fine and even coat of oil comes out for only a few seconds. We have not had issues with clumping of oil, etc. The pump is still working great to this day. I thought it would be important to mention that we only use olive oil in ours. Not sure how other oils would hold up, but I imagine that they would do well. The glass is very durable. I haven't attempted to clean it yet and haven't felt that it was needed, but I imagine that it'll be fairly easy to do. If you're considering this as a purchase, do it!

review_title: Above and beyond customer service. Love my new mister!
review_text: UPDATE : My new mister works great! I was so happy with my original purchase. I even recommended it. But after 6 months it just quit working. I left a review thinking that would the end of it but a few days ago I received a replacement and a lovely letter introducing the family and their business. It was clear that they wanted to make it right. I tried the new mister and it worked so well it was obvious to me that my original one was defective from the beginning. Which is saying a lot because I was happy with the original. However, the replacement has an even better spray and the pump works better. I wish I had contacted them sooner rather than leave that first negative review but I thought after six months it would be too late. So if you're on the fence I highly recommend this mister and if you do have an experience like mine be assured that are willing to make it right.

I couldn't figure out how to get my mister/sprayer to work. I emailed them and they responded quickly. You prime the mister with the clear plastic lid/cover by lifting/pumping it up and down 7-10x (careful not to completely remove the clear lid). Then it works beautifully! DEPRESSURIZE IF NOT GOING TO USE FOR A WHILE. They suggested to depressurize the mister when done if not going to use for a while. Just unscrew the top to let the air out.

I originally said the following when I received the produce-- "Touted by reviewers as the best thing out there. Worked for a few times and sometimes it sprays and most times it squirts a line of oil. Not easy to pump due to the shape and design." But the creators / owners of the product were right on top of that review and were very proud of their product, I could tell. As a result, they not only apologized, they sent me a replacement sprayer part which now works perfectly! I was very impressed with the company's response, and acknowledge that it was something in the sprayer that malfunctioned initially. Now it seems to do the job well, and I'm pleased to give them a 5 star rating,

review_title: Top quality oil sprayer combined with unbeatable service, makes buying this oil sprayer a winner
review_text: We ordered this oil sprayer, because one of our goal this year, was to improve our eating habits. When the sprayer arrived, we noticed that it seems to require a lot of pumping, to release a few drops of oil. We contacted customer support and within hours of our email, we received an e mail with both an apology and a solution to our problem. The vendor promptly replaced the sprayer component and it now works like a charm, we use it everyday and couldn't be happier. The product is great but the customer service is unbelievable. They even followed up to ensure that the replacement worked perfectly. If I could give them 6 stars I would. We are very happy "Customers" in New Jersey

I like the fact that it's generally easy to use and isn't hideous to look at. However, the nozzle design lends itself to olive oil pooling around it. What does this mean? It means that if you're going to use it you'd best have a paper towel handy. You'll need to wipe the nozzle before you spray, a few times during spraying (if you're spraying quite a bit), and again when you're done. If you don't wipe the nozzle down, as mentioned, olive oil gathers around the nozzle hole and clogs it. The result is that fine mist you're spraying onto your pizza dough starts turning into spattering gobs of olive oil and you're like "Oh noes!" because it was probably easier to just use a basting brush.

I don't want to buy commercial cooking oil sprays because of the chemical ingredients and propellant. I've tried several pump aerosol oil sprayers that have clogged up over time, and I ended up throwing them out. I tried this sprayer, and at first the oil sputtered out, which I read was one of the complaints of this sprayer. I emailed the seller, and she got right back to me, and offered to replace the sprayer part. She also sent information to make sure I was using the sprayer correctly, which I was not using correctly. Once I pumped the air until I felt pressure, then the sprayer worked beautifully! It sprayed a fine mist across my pan. If you've never used a pump sprayer, you'll notice that it doesn't spray like the commercial sprayers - it's more of a gentle spray, and it will run out after about 5 seconds of spraying - which is about how much you need to spray your pan. If you need more, you just pump it back up. It's well worth the effort for having a chemical free oil. I haven't had any problems with clogging at all.

review_title: Very happy with how easy to fill and use
review_text: Not one but two! One for EVOO and one for Vegetable Oil(used when I bake). I wanted to do away with the canned spray. Very happy with how easy to fill and use. Would like to see a dark glass option for the Olive Oil so I can leave it on the counter but then again that's just me. Just remember not to fill the entire glass as you need room for the air to be pumped in.

I previously gave this product a 4 star review but now that I have had it for many months I have noticed that it no longer functions as well as it did during the first few months of use. It doesn't hold pressure very well now and I no longer use it. I can't recommend anyone buying this product.

Finally I get to use this item. Took out of box. Seemed all intact. Simple directions for using. Does not pump. Can't spray. Thought turning the sprayer right or left, like medical spray bottles, to unlock. NO! Put in olive oil, thinking it needed to be filled. NO! does not work. A waste of time and money. Am I going to return it, NO. Sometimes it is easier to just chuck it. Go to Home Depot ang get a small plastic spray bottle, holds s lot and costs noting.

review_title: This product works somewhat but it's a pain to use ...
review_text: This product works somewhat but it's a pain to use. I have to pump it about 7 or 8 times then spray, pump another 7 or 8 times then spray and then pump another 7 or 8 times and spray again. All of that just to cover my double griddle. Plus oil always runs down the side of the metal top so I have to wipe it each time I spray. It's almost more effort than it's worth.

Came with a crack on one side of the bottle. Returning it. Update on 8/23/18: I reached out to the Seller when I first received this defective bottle on Saturday, but i did not realize that they responded back to me right away. I thought it was one of the many courtesy emails i receive from Amazon sellers so deleted it without reading it. Gina from ChefAdvantage replaced my defective bottle right away and responded to all my emails. She worked with me until the issues were completely resolved. I believe my defective bottle was an isolated case and knowing that they stand 100% behind their products is good enough for me to not think twice before buying from them in the future. As a matter of fact, I went ahead and bought another one for my other house and the oil mister is working perfectly. I recently purchased an Air Fryer and this Oil Mister will definitely help me eat a bit healthier. I wish all Amazon sellers are like Gina and I hope to see her extend her product line so that I can continue to purchase her products. Thank you!

review_title: Edit - Wonderful Customer service - "Pump" is very weak and is not able to generate much air pressure.
review_text: ------- EDIT ------- June 5, 2018 I was contacted by the seller and a replacement pump was sent. I compared the new pump to the original and there was indeed what appears to be a defect in the one I received. I have been using it for the past few days and it's been working okay. I'm giving it only 4 stars because the width from the nozzle to the edge of the metal top is a bit too thick resulting in the oil dripping down the side. It is holding air pressure and working, so enjoying my popcorn much more now. :-) I will also give the owners a 5 star rating on their customer service. They took the initiative and sent me a replacement w/o any calling or anything like that. So I thank them for the replacement and the excellent customer service. Don't waste your money. Nothing but problems. - "Pump" is very weak and is not able to generate much air pressure. Low pressure means it does not spray, it more sort of just drips. - Top button broke when trying to get it to spray. - Nozzle clogged on first use. Just wanted to spray some olive oil on popcorn, this could not even manage that. I can't imagine your results if you were trying to cook with it.

I bought two different misters to see which one was better. This one was great! I bought the Misto and the spray came out chunky, almost like a stream. This one was way better! It looks nice and I love that it comes in 4 different color options. It is, however, a bit priceier than the Misto, but worth it. I bought it to use with my air fryer; and I don’t want a chunky mist coming out. I much rather a fine mist that sprays evenly. The instructions weren’t that great, but it’s pretty easy to care for. I can apply the same instructions I got for the Misto, to this one. To clean, fill with warm water and one drop of dish soap and spray continuously. Empty and fill with clean warm water and spray again continuously. Empty and rinse. Also, to store, release any built up pressure before putting it away. I wanted 2 misters (for Oliver oil and regular oil). I returned the Misto and bought another one of these.

I had previously owned a Trudeau spritzer which, I just flat wore out. The Trudeau never did mist as fine as this mister, so life is very good with this one. Also, I can see my oil line through the clear glass....another positive thing....so I know when to refill. My son has dropped it a couple of times (don’t ask me how) and it takes a lickin and keeps on ticking....although it has a slight dent in the stainless on the top by the sprayer. Guess we can say it is now experienced. I do like this sprayer and hope she has a long life.

Using this for spraying canola oil instead of paying for "pre-canned" oil sprays. It took time until I learned how this works. The seller (MB Lifestyle) was very helpful and explained it clearly enough for me. It turns out that it does work and because the instructions were so unclear, I uploaded a video for this item (titled "Putting it together and making it work!") One part that seems like it's already falling apart is what they call a plunger. This is used to pump air into the bottle so that it can spray. However, I'm confident that the seller will replace it even if it does break - there's a 1 year warranty. (Edit: the seller explained how it's supposed to have a little slit, so it's all good.) The rest of the product seems like it's solid and all in all, I'm looking forward to using this for my eggs tomorrow morning!

review_title: Unfortunately broke after 6 months of use
review_text: This item broke after 6 months of light use. The plastic piece in the center used to pump to create the pressure cracked in a very odd location. I paid more for what I thought would be a more quality product, but unfortunately this was not the case.

review_title: Oil sprays onto the bottle itself
review_text: The overall design is good. However, the spray head is too short while the bottle is too wide. Consequently, the oil sprays onto the bottle itself, which you need to wipe off after each use (in the photo you can see oil droplets right in front of the spray head). It would be a perfect product if they could have their spray head stick out a little bit more. ========================update================= The seller have given me a full refund for the complaint above, and that was totally out of my expectation. I have changed the review from 3 star to 4 star. If I could separately review their customer service and product, I will give their customer service 5 star.

review_title: Customer service is the best I've ever experienced!
review_text: I had a few hiccups with the mister so I contacted their customer service dept as so many reviews said they were very helpful. The got right back to me and gave me some trouble shooting things to try. This didn't work and we came to the conclusion I had a faulty spray unit. I do have to say, in all fairness to the company, the first thing I did when I received this is take it all apart and wash it - so it's possible I screwed something up while doing this. Nonetheless, they sent out the new part and I tried it. This time it worked fine. I think this product is great for a salad mister or using it to cover a small area with oil. It doesn't operate as well as the spray cans you get from the grocery store (e.g. Pam) but it also doesn't have the propellants in it to make it do that. In addition, I'm not having to toss a can each time it runs out plus, I can use whatever good quality oil I want to put in it. These are the reasons I bought it. The reasons I would recommend it, and buy it again, is because of their customer service.

review_title: Fails on the clock in 6 months.
review_text: Had refilled it 2 to 3 times so far. Now not able to open it for refill. The surfaces are extra smooth and does not offer any grip. Tried counter clockwise does NOT budge. Tried Clockwise does not budge. One expensive use and throw product... More and more these products break. @Manufacturer. Can you please post a video of how to hold and open it ? and what to do when it is staled shut? Otherwise reduce every one's blood pressure and stop selling this product. Thanks Mahesh

This is an excellent product. We bought is solely for the purpose of spraying butter oil on popcorn. We do not like our popcorn dry as like when it's cooked in an air popper. review_title: I decided to give this one a try - it works just like advertised. Just fill with your favorite liquid (doesn't ...
review_text: I wasn't sure what to expect with this 'Mister' - how to pressurize it, etc. After reading reviews for several others, I decided to give this one a try - it works just like advertised. Just fill with your favorite liquid (doesn't have to be Oil), pressurize the bottle using the large cap (number of pumps will depend on how full the bottle is), remove the pump cap and spray. Use is easy and clean. Keep in mind that the sprayer only works if there is pressure in the bottle, and the length of useful pressure is dependent on how full it is. Less full bottle means more pumps to get it charged - but the charge will last longer; a fuller bottle will require less pumps to charge it, but then you won't be able to spray as long - so you may need to recharge it before you've finished spraying. No biggie, as long as you understand that concept and balance how full the bottle is when you start using it.

The company sent me an email days after I purchased it, and I raved about how much I loved it, and I did love it. Then just days afterwards, it stopped working properly and barely sprayed unless I pump it 10-12 times. The company saw my review and sent me a new pump at their own expense and now it's working excellently!

review_title: but it works well enough for now and I really do like usng my own olive oil
review_text: A bit sputtery, and doesn’t seem to hold pressure well, but it works well enough for now and I really do like usng my own olive oil. I was gifted some garlic infused stuff and it’s been just sitting unused. Now I can cook with it essily and waste very little.

review_title: I think this one is your best bet
review_text: I spent a lot of time trying to find the right oil mister. It seems like a lot of these are just garbage. This one is not. You do have to pump it quite a bit, but I think that is expected for this type of mechanism. Sometimes it will come out in a solid stream instead of mist, but not often. I'm not really sure how I should clean the actual sprayer part, but I'm sure I'll figure something out.

This is the nicest mister that I have ever put my hands on. It is made of quality materials and I love that I easily see how much oil is left. I have owned a few misters and have either given them away or thrown them out because they are either cheaply made, difficult to use or because they just fall apart. The other ones that I have seen in the kitchen stores are either outrageously priced or junk like my past models. And I love that it is red and matches my kitchen!

This product is just as expected and definitely worth every penny. Doesn't clog, sprays a consistent mist and not wet droplets. Let me reiterate that this mister definitely sprays a fine mist, allowing you complete control of the amount of oil used. I was able to clean, fill, pump and spray this mister easily from the very first time I used it. After looking on-line at several such items, I'm so glad that I opted for this one, recommending to anyone who cares to listen.

review_title: Simple and effective, just what I was hoping for
review_text: I bought this to use with my new air fryer. I wasn't crazy about using the aerosol sprays, and I had tried to put oil in a regular spray bottle and ended up with a narrow stream of oil instead of a mist going evenly onto the food. This product is very effective, it definitely does spray out a mist so you want to put it close to what you're spraying. My favorite thing is that I know I'm just spraying oil onto my food, and not dimethyl silicone or whatever else is in commercial cooking sprays.

This is an excellent product. I have had mistos for years. They don't give an indication of how much oil is left, clog easily and the seal eventually fails. I have only just received this sprayer but I can tell that significant details are better. It is glass which gives an easy view of remaining oil. It has more capacity. It has an improved gasket on the sprayer insert and easily disassembles for cleaning. Gives a very fine spray. Not sure how long it will last but given the quality construction I have high hopes.

I'm very happy with my oil mister. I've wanted one for quite some time and I'm so glad I decided upon this one. Now I can lay my veggies out on my baking rack and spritz them with olive oil before popping them in the oven and they come or so amazing. So much better than having to drizzle oil and use a bag or bowl to mix things up and hoping everything gets evenly coated in oil.

review_title: This one actually works for cooking oils!! Many others do not!
review_text: My husband has been experimenting with buying different oil misters to find just the perfect one. This one finally met all the requirements for him! ( I think we have tried and rejected 3 others...) It is exactly what we wanted. Sprays a very fine mist of any oil we choose, and we tried several immediately to make sure it was a good fit. Many others spray a mist for a second then turn into a stream, but this one didn't. Excellent product!

review_title: Bought this for my son for Christmas, filled it ...
review_text: Bought this for my son for Christmas, filled it to use the next day and it doesn’t work. Followed the directions exactly, nothing! Disappointed UPDATE: Two days after submitting the above comments, A NEW MISTER arrived in the mail along with additional instructions and apologies for the first product being defective. IMPRESSIVE. I wish all companies had such incredible customer service. New mister works perfectly! Thank you

review_title: Awesome little sprayer! Awesome small business with the best customer service.
review_text: Thank you, we LOVE this! Great quality and makes our meals even healthier. Love it with avocado oil! Update: I dropped the lid and cracked the plastic in half. I contacted the seller and they promptly sent me a replacement free of charge. I can’t even express how unheard of this level of customer is! My friends and family will now be getting these next Christmas. Support this awesome small business!

I bought this to replace aerosolized oil cans and it works very well. The mist isn't quite as fine as an aerosol can, but it's close enough to use in a frying pan. For best results follow the directions and only fill to half to allow for adequate pressurization to achieve a fine mist. I've tried other oil sprayers on Amazon and this is definitely has the finest spray.

The spray works good with few pump But the spray did not come out really even Update company email me and try to help trouble shoot the trouble. It fail so the company send me a new insert and it fix the spraying trouble Great company!

Only useful if you're cooking for one. Sprays very little before having to pump it up again to recharge. Returning it after trying to use it the first time. PS. After exchanges with the company, whose customer service has been quite attentive, I am returning this. When I washed it for return it worked perfectly with soapy water. My conclusion is that the heavy olive oil I needed it for was far too thick. Would be great with thinner oils.

review_title: Quality product backed by great customer service
review_text: Just what I was looking for! For use in cooking when I want a light spray of the olive oil of my choosing and not the questionable contents in the aerosol cans. After I received my mister, I had a little start-up trouble, but an email to the owners of the company brought an immediate response. She gave me some instruction and encouragement, and I am successfully using the mister as I had hoped.

Update: After my first review, I received a replacement part from the company and now the oil minister works perfect! We love it! I read the directions before use and the first few times using it, it worked great! After about the 6th time using it the pump action to get the oil to spray doesn't feel like it pumps very well and I only get a little oil to come out at a time. It still works, just a bit frustrating to have to spray for a second or 2 and then go back and pump. Normally wouldn't use much oil but when I was baking tortilla chips it was extra work to have to keep stopping spritzing to pump.

I've tried many brands of misters, but never get a mist, only a stream. I decided to give the Chefvantage mister a try because there were so many positive reviews. I'm glad I did. This thing works perfectly. I have a pretty chilly kitchen and I was fearful that the olive oil would thicken and cause problems, but it continues to provide a fine mist.

review_title: This oil mister is a big Hit!!
review_text: Got this olive oil mister as a stocking stuffer for my wife for Christmas...she loves it! We used it for the first time tonight and the way my wife was spraying the skillet and telling me how well it was working with distributing and not using too much oil..well I thought I was watching an infomercial! 5 stars!! I would give it more stars if I could!

This mister is nicely presented and constructed. My only gripe is the low volume - the instructions recommend filling to half only to allow air pressure to build up, but I find that I need to prime the pump and resume spraying to cover even a couple of chicken breasts. It produces a super-fine atomized spray when you want a *really* light coating of oil. Works well if you're using an air fryer.

A product of great quality, I love the possibility of using flavored oil without risk, it offers many possibilities of use, very good design and final completion, worthy of a precious gift, my daughter will use it soon and I am sure she will love it. The attention from the manufacturers has been very good, sending comments for better use, I am very satisfied with this product and I would buy it again to use it with other liquids.

When I first got it, had problems with the spray. It wasn’t the fine mist I had expected and the pressure didn’t last long. I contacted the company and they sent a replacement part, as well as instructions on the best way to pump and prime it. It now works perfectly. It is beautiful, works well, and the customer service was top notch. They contacted me several times to be sure that all was well. Would definitely recommend both the mister and the company!

review_title: Nice design but needs too much pumping
review_text: Just heard from the vendor and is sending me a new mister. I have changed my rating because that is awesome customer service. I will use new mister and if it works as promoted will change my rating again to 5 stars. Thank you. Need to pump too much and a little messy too. Like the design and will continue to use because I dont like aerosols.

review_title: I love the appearance and function of the mister
review_text: I love the appearance and function of the mister, although I've yet to get the "30 seconds" duration talked about. My only complaint is that the durations are printed only on the box rather than on a paper that would be easier to tuck into the cabinet for future reference. Having an "exploded" illustration would also be very helpful. I would definitely buy this one again—it's beautiful and does what I need.

review_title: Store your oil in glass before you spray!
review_text: I love having a glass sprayer for my olive oil, instead of the more common aluminum sprayers. The product works great once you pump it enough. It holds its pressure overnight easily. If you don't mind pumping it up, this is a great solution for obtaining a fine layer of oil on your cooking surfaces. Excellent customer service when a part on mine came loose as well! My friend bought one and it is also working beautifully for her.

review_title: High Function and Great Looking Oil Mister
review_text: I am new to the air fryer craze and needed an olive oil mister to achieve the desired result. Now I wonder why I did not get something like this sooner. So long Pam and related products that left my pans with a funky residue. Now I can get a fine mist of oil anytime I need it whether to achieve a non-stick result or for lighter saute of vegetables etc. Easy to use and looks great on the counter.

review_title: Works very well; nice fine mist
review_text: So far, so good! I followed the directions and everything functioned correctly. After pumping to prime it, I easily got a nice fine mist of olive oil and it has continued to work just fine every since - no problems with clogging, etc. You do need to be careful handling it due to the glass container, but I prefer using glass for foodstuffs. Very happy with this product.

EDITED! I love this sprayer but have found that I have to pump the bottle at least 15 times to get a continuous spray. Other than that, it works great! 10/7/18 update: Sprayer doesn’t work at all anymore. Pretty bummed since this was so expensive as far as oil misters go. May contact seller since my return window ended a long time ago.

Had to have time to use for a while, but after I couple of weeks I can say its a really great product. First and foremost it actually works. I've been through so many of these that were total duds which is why I wanted to wait and test it out at least for a bit. I do want to order extra seals to have on hand and I wish I knew how to get that info easily, otherwise very pleased with this mister.

review_title: So far it is working great! Per the seller's emailed suggestions we only filled ...
review_text: We started using this oil mister just a few days ago. So far it is working great! Per the seller's emailed suggestions we only filled it half way with olive oil, and after pumping a few times the mister produces a nice oil mist to coat the inside surfaces of pots and pans. We also use it to mist vegetables for grilling or roasting. This mister workes much better than other misters we have tried.

When I received the product, at first I had trouble with the spray. I reached out by email to ask if I might have done something wrong. Received a response almost immediately which was very professional! Turns out all I needed to do was pump a few more times! The product works perfectly now! I am extremely happy with the purchase. The quality of the product is exceptional! I did think it was a bit pricey at first but seeing the quality of the product I am extremely happy I decided to purchase. Definitely with the money. Would highly recomend!

Love this product, it works exactly as I expected. Customer service was fantastic, I sent an email and they responded within an hour. If you are like me and have never used one of these before, keep in mind that you need to pump it a few times to get the oil to spray out in a mist. There is a you tube video with instructions on how to do this if you need.

review_title: I am glad to not buy the pressurized cans that somehow leak
review_text: I am glad to not buy the pressurized cans that somehow leak. I love the fact that it is a glass jar. I got three different sprayers at once and the other one that starts with the word "fine" is a bit top heavy and keeps falling over when I move things around in the cupboard. This one stays upright. In addition, when it comes to oil, I think that glass is easier to clean compared to plastic.

review_title: Works fine after I figured out how to use it
review_text: It's probably obvious, but when I first tried to use it after disassembling, cleaning and putting oil in it, I didn't know to pump pressure into the well using the clear plastic hood. The seller is very diligent about contacting you after purchase to be sure it's working. They sent me a video showing how it works. This gadget is truly useful if you want to use oil in your salad for example, but don't want to overdo it pouring from a bottle and want to have it spread evenly.

review_title: The Best on the Market (that I know about)
review_text: This is the third mister I have been through this year and THIS ONE WORKS! Why it's five stars: 1. It provides a long, well-dispersed spray (the previous one provided quick bullet-like squirts) 2. It's great looking 3. You can see when it's getting low 4. It comes with good directions -- things I did not know about, after owning misters for 20 years!

I needed a touch of oil in my non-stick frypans and was throwing a lot away by spreading and wiping with a towel. I am also using my air fryer more and didn't like the way my store-bought sprayer squirted oil out. I decided to get an oil mister but found a great deal of choices for which the reviews were variable and prices were all over the lot. I decided on the CHEFVANTAGE and found they have a 100% satisfaction guarantee. It allows me to put a fine mist of olive oil into my frypans or on food going into my air fryer. It appears to be well-made and is just what I needed.

review_title: Company that stands by their product
review_text: Bought this product and absolutely loved it...but, after a short time it stopped spraying. However, when I reached out to customer service about my issue they immediately sent a replacement pump that was likely the culprit and whoala it’s working again! This is a company that not only stands by their product they also provide exceptional customer service and follow up!

I bought this sprayer to replace a much inferior quality one. The old one sprayed more or less like a pump and delivered a spray like a watergun. This baby sprays a fine atomized mist and delivers even coverage over pan surfaces and on food. It is small, easy to pump and fits nicely in the hand. All and all, a nice addition to my kitchen counter.

It works at first. After a month, it just won't pump any air into it. Updated review: This seller is really concerned about the customer’s satisfaction. They reached out to me by sending me a replacement part which they figured out that will fix my issue. It work great like the new one. excellent customer service!

review_title: Gets rid of the aerosol cans
review_text: Works very well once you get it set-up. At first I struggled with the pump then read the instructions about pumping it up before trying to use it. This is not obvious. I can't comment on durability really because we just got it. If it works it should eliminate the need to by the oil in spray cans.

The first Oil Mister arrived was a faulty, previously used item that was inadvertently sent out from Amazon by mistake. When the seller realized what had happened they sent out a new one immediately. I have not had the opportunity yet, to use it yet with oil or vinegar, but when I washed it with hot soap and water, and tested it - it worked perfectly, as described, with a nice, firm, even mist. Wonderful - this is such a cool invention; so far I am happy with it. I am sure I am going to like using this a lot. It is attractive, and being glass and stainless - so far it seems extremely easy to keep clean.

review_title: Very happy with how this works
review_text: Got tired of struggling with another theoretically well-designed oil mister so threw it away. Was hesitant to pay this much money for possibly yet another over-rated mister, but I am not at all disappointed with this one so far. Not only does it spray a nice fine, consistent mist, it looks classy.

This is not the first olive oil mister I have purchased, but it is the first that I love. It looks elegant. The directions are very clear, and frankly very important to follow. I think if everyone follows the directions to a T they will have the same great experience that I am enjoying!

review_title: It was great until it broke after one month (Replacement to be reviewed later)
review_text: ****They have quick and polite customer service. I'm being sent a new product currently and will update the below review upon arrival***** It was great until it broke after one month. First the compressing tube bent slightly at the tip and was no longer air tight. I found that pumping faster made it work still, but then the whole tube came off the cap. Now it’s useless.

I received the product as a gift but it doesn’t work. I requested a replacement and received it today. I logged into the product website followed all steps to clean and pump to develop pressure read all Q&A and still could not make the pump work. It shouldn’t be this difficult to make a sprayer work if it is made right.

This mister is solidly built, and it works exactly as advertised. Unlike some similar products, the Premium Olive Oil Mister actually produces a mist rather than a spray that is not as fine as it needs to be for our purposes.

After spending WAY too much time reading mister reviews, I settled on this one. I've had two of the metal tube ones in the past, and both failed rather quickly. We'll see what happens here, but my guess is that the filter will prevent such failure. So far, it mists perfectly. Looks great, too. And of course, glass is better than metal for obvious reasons.

review_title: A pain to use and messy
review_text: I do not like this item. You have to pump several times to get a few sprays out of it, then pump again. It sprays very little and is just annoying and if you accidentally hit the pump as you put the lid on, which slides on, then you have olive oil all over the base. Wish I had returned it.

At first I was unsure about this sprayer but once I figured out the pumping action, I love it. It makes my job in the kitchen so much easier when I need to mist a pan or food items. Absolutely love it! This is one of those items that may purchased for a future Christmas gift.

In the beginning, the mister didn't work well and I was a bit disappointed. However, the seller sent me an email asking me if I liked the mister. I explained my problem and she decided to send me a replacement of the sprayer. I got the sprayer and indeed everything works now. I have a beautiful mister spraying olive oil. Thank you Gina and Family.

It operates exactly as advertised and it takes very little effort (pumps) to achieve a fine mist with a good olive oil. Of course, the deciding factor is how long it will do that without clogging. I've had misters in the past that started well and then failed because the filter couldn't handle the density of the olive oil.

We really like this product. We have used several pump oil dispensers and they got clogged all the time. It is also elegantly made. Looks good in any kitchen. We know who to contact if we have any problems with this product and that’s good to know. Thank you for your product.

review_title: I like that I can save money on cooking spray by ...
review_text: I like that I can save money on cooking spray by using this. The thing I don't like about it is that I have to have the perfect amount of oil in it to get a good spray. I thought it was because of how many times I pumped it at first but the only thing to make a difference was the amount of oil in it (not too much but not too little). Overall, though, I like it and I'm not buying chemical laden cooking spray.

Thais little bottle is just perfect when you need a quick bit of olive oil. It is easy to use, convenient and no mess involved. I did not prime the pump and contacted the company. The response was quick and fixed my issue. I will be ordering another one for our son. Excellent product.

I absolutely LOVE this mister. The design is sleek and easy to keep clean. The dome lid houses the pump element and covers the sprayer. I just ordered one for olive oil to use with my Yedi Air Fryer, but I want a second for vinegar or flavored oil. A beautiful addition to any kitchen!

I purchased two of these, and they are great. Hoping they will continue to perform as well as they do now, as they seem to be very well constructed. When contacting the company with a couple of minor questions, I was totally impressed with their fast and friendly customer service and I’m confident that if there are any issues they will do whatever it takes to keep their customers satisfied.

review_title: It'll build up the pressure it needs and sprays just fine.
review_text: A little tricky at first, but I figured it out. If yours doesn't spray, fill it only 3/4 full, pop the cap on, and pump the cap up and down 6-8 times. It'll build up the pressure it needs and sprays just fine.

I really like this mister. I placed olive oil in my mister and have used it to help me create a variety of meals. The spray is fine. I pump it about ten times before I spray. Most recently, it was used when I created a gluten-free pizza and I used it when I made eggrolls.

review_title: Exactly what I was looking for!
review_text: I had been looking for something to use in cooking that didn't put a lot of oil in the pan or dish. This does that. It's nice because it uses air to propel the oil not chemicals. The seller emailed me to let me know how to contact them if I had problems with the mister. So far its been working well.

Sooo attractive! f trouble because I didn’t read the directions carefully. I dropped a note to the company and they answered me almost immediately with a couple of videos that completely solved the issue. My little mister works like a charm. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED and I can use my own choice of olive oil.

review_title: Very well made and works well.
review_text: This is a quality olive oil mister. All the others I have had before clogged up and stopped working. I love that it is made out of glass. Their customer service is also amazing. You must prime with the clear plastic lid in order for this to work. Definitely would recommend.

This oil mister dissapointed. It does not spray as well or as long as the last one I had which I gave to my son & wife. Wish I had bought the same model I gave away; but thought I would try this one. It cost more than my previous mister & does not work as well. I was not planning on reviewing this. I don't often write negative reviews, but tbe company kept sending me emails hounding me to write a review.

The mister was packaged well and I received it promptly. Initially, I wasn’t getting a good spray so I emailed the seller. I received an immediate response with suggestions to try and advised a new sprayer would be sent, if needed. The suggestions worked perfectly and I am now a happy customer! This mister works very well (I’m using olive oil). I love the glass container, and the stainless steel top looks great in my kitchen. Would definitely recommend this product and seller.

I originally rated this product with 2 stars because it stopped working after 4 months. I was bummed because I liked it very much. Very soon after I posted my review, this company sent a replacement and a replacement part. My husband and I were stunned. The customer service that this company showed is rare these days and we are very appreciative. Sometimes products stop working, it happens. But for a company to just go ahead and offer a solution without me asking was so refreshing. This is a truly unique company that I will gladly purchase from again. Thank you.

I have had this product for a couple of weeks and it works pretty well. I pump the device to pressure each time I use it and then release the pressure after I am done (I am not sure if need to actually release the pressure but its just my preference). I like the idea of using this product instead of the regular spray cans you get at the grocery store.

review_title: This sprayer is awesome. Works better than I expected
review_text: This sprayer is awesome. Works better than I expected. A perfect mist no droplets. Made a grilled sandwich and the spray was even with no soggy spots like I got sprinkling from a bottle. Will recommend to friends and family. Tried to use it to spray a casserole dish but the food stuck, no fault of the sprayer it worked fine, but beware olive oil is not as effective as non stick spray

I like the design of this item very much. I had tried to use the mister, but had some trouble with spraying. I contacted the seller and they were very helpful. They gave a few suggestions but ultimately had to send a new sprayer, which arrived quickly and was tested to be sure it would work for us. We are happy now with this item, as well as the great customer service from this company.

review_title: The slit at the end of plastic tube that inserts into top of mister is NOT a defect.
review_text: Customer service is magnificent, thought I was going to end up returning them because of a slit in the bottom of the tube that inserts into the top. After contacting customer service it Turns out it is there on purpose and designed to help pressurize the mister.

I like this oil sprayer. Important to read how to use sprayer directions. Once you do what they say the sprayer works well. Really pay attention to the oil level in the sprayer, I had no problems once I decided to read the directions instead of thinking that I knew better than the manufacture on how to operate the sprayer. LOL!!

Bought this to replace another type that I broke. Good: Glass holder / stainless top - easy to clean double seal to hold pressure Bad: Nozzle pattern sprays on cover. Overall - not worth the hassle, bought another Ideal instead

The top is a plastic shell which is used to pump and pressurize the body, interesting design. Holds about 6oz of oil and creates a fine mist. There are several O rings to the pump, losing one during cleaning could be a risk. Overall a solid pump, nifty design, and a great addition to the kitchen.

review_title: Great product and even better customer service!!
review_text: I was looking for an oil sprayer to use with an air fryer. After looking at several products I decided to order this one based on the reviews. It performs great with canola oil! Upon opening it, I did have trouble getting it to pump as it seemed stuck. I sent an email to the company and within 45 minutes they responded with instructions and videos that helped me as I didn't quite understand how it worked! But they also said they would send a new pump if I didn't get it to work! GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!! I highly recommend this product as it is durable and easy to use...but I would also recommend based on the fact that I know they will stand behind they product!

review_title: First time was confusing. But its all good now!
review_text: I had a difficult time to figure out how to use such a device without reading the questions here. Once I figured out the dome was the part that needed to prime the pump and not the colored cover it was very easy to use. Currently I am needing to track down a source of a leak to figure out how to keep the outside of the device oil free so I don't have to set it on a paper towel all the time.

I really do love this mister, I bought it for my air fyer and it works great. Had an issue with it but the company reached out and fixed it. I definitely recommend this product, would make a great gift for a wedding or for someone who is trying to be more health concious.

review_title: So far we love this mister
review_text: So far we love this mister. Works so much better than the Misto we had. It sprays a finer mist and the spray last longer than the other one which saves us money by using less and is better for the healthy eating we are trying to do. It also is easier to pump and looks good too. We only use extra virgin olive oil in it.

review_title: Great quality, just too fine of a mist for my use.
review_text: this unit gives an extreemely fine mist. Acutally too fine as there is a cloud of oil hovering in the air above my popcorn. It is high quality device, but I think I need one that isn't quite such a fine mist.

review_title: This family-owned CPG company provides the best customer service I have ever seen.
review_text: The Oil Mister is great. While I did experience some difficulty getting it to work, the co-founder of the company responded immediately to my outreach, offered a full refund, and provided a complete product replacement. The product works very well now, and being able to control the distribution and amount of oil I use when cooking has enabled me to have a much more consistent cooking experience than ever before.

Great alternative to cooking oil spray cans that you can buy at the grocery store, which have added propellant ingredients that are of questionable safety to ingest. This product works great but isn’t intuitive if it’s your first time. It’s a family owned business, and they responded very quickly when I reached out to them for help figuring out how to use this product. Wonderful product and wonderful company with excellent customer service.
Excellent product. Very well designed. Superb construction. Customer service is OUTSTANDING! FOLLOW UP: It's less than 6 months and my unit stopped working!!?! I expected much more durability!!!

The pump won't depress even the smallest bit. Tried the warm water to start, didn't work. Went on and tried it with the oil anyway, didn't work. Decreased the amount of oil in the dispenser, didn't work. Now I've got to clean out an oily mess and repackage to return.

I've only used this a couple of times ,so I don't know about long term but so far this mister is amazing. It only takes a few "pumps" to create pressure. The spray is like a real sprayer. I like that it's glass so it's easy to see the volume. It comes apart for easy cleaning. Much better than any I've owned before

review_title: Works Perfectly and Very Easy to Use!
review_text: I checked out other similar products and read many reviews. The Premium Oil Mister seemed like the best option. Very glad I chose this product. It does everything as described. I found the mister very easy to assemble and set up. It worked perfectly without any problems. So far, I love this product, especially for use with my cast iron skillets.

This oil mister works just great! For many years, I used one made by another company until I dropped it and the cap broke. Couldn't get replacement parts for it, so I tried this one, and it's much more substantial and sprays longer after pumping than the old one did. Very satisfied with it!

This product is super handy in the kitchen, really nice alternative to the aerosal cans that people usually use. Easy to use and refill. Pump it up a few times and spray it on stuff, I use it a ton along with my air fryer. After pumping it up, make sure you keep the sprayer depressed until all of the pressure is out though! I kept pressure in mine and the top broke, I had been using it for like 8 months before that with no trouble. This company is great though, they literally sent me a replacement sprayer before I even had time to check my email to see if they had responded to my initial request. Overall very satisfied!

review_title: Very impressed with the olive oil mister!
